```java
    /** One atom: family + integer/double parameters parsed from "FAMILY|k=v,k=v". */
    public static final class Spec {
        public final String family; final Map<String, Double> p = new TreeMap<>(); final Map<String, String> str = new TreeMap<>();
        Spec(String text) {
            int bar = text.indexOf('|'); family = bar < 0 ? text : text.substring(0, bar);
            if (bar >= 0 && bar + 1 < text.length()) for (String kv : text.substring(bar + 1).split(",")) {
                String[] a = kv.split("=");
                try { p.put(a[0], Double.parseDouble(a[1])); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { str.put(a[0], a[1]); }
            }
        }
        int i(String k) { return (int) Math.round(p.get(k)); }
        double d(String k) { return p.get(k); }
        /** Python atom_name / state_name: parameters in key order (string and numeric merged), "order" omitted. */
        public String name() {
            TreeMap<String, String> all = new TreeMap<>(str);
            for (Map.Entry<String, Double> e : p.entrySet()) { double v = e.getValue(); all.put(e.getKey(), v == Math.rint(v) ? String.valueOf((long) v) : String.valueOf(v)); }
            StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(family).append('(');
            boolean first = true;
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : all.entrySet()) {
                if (e.getKey().equals("order")) continue;
                if (!first) b.append(','); first = false;
                b.append(e.getKey()).append('=').append(e.getValue());
            }
            return b.append(')').toString();
        }
    }

    public static final Spec[] CATALOG, STATES;
    static {
        CATALOG = new Spec[SPECS.length]; for (int i = 0; i < SPECS.length; i++) CATALOG[i] = new Spec(SPECS[i]);
        STATES = new Spec[STATE_SPECS.length]; for (int i = 0; i < STATE_SPECS.length; i++) STATES[i] = new Spec(STATE_SPECS[i]);
    }
    public static int size() { return CATALOG.length; }
    public static int states() { return STATES.length; }
    /** Atoms of the R14b catalog (registry + phase); R15 adds GAP statistics and the decomposed XI atoms after them. */
    public static int r14bSize() { int n = 0; for (Spec s : CATALOG) if (!s.family.startsWith("XI_") && !s.family.equals("GAP_MEAN_GAP") && !s.family.equals("GAP_VAR_GAP") && !s.family.equals("GAP_GAP_Z")) n++; return n; }

    final int[][] ring = new int[RING][10];          // 0-based numbers
    long t;                                           // number of draws seen = index of the next target
    final long[][] last = new long[10][10], prev = new long[10][10];   // last two occurrences (GAP / OMISSION)

    public AtomStreamSU2() { for (long[] r : last) Arrays.fill(r, -1_000_000_000L); for (long[] r : prev) Arrays.fill(r, -1_000_000_000L); }

    public long time() { return t; }
    int x(long u, int p) { return ring[(int) (u % RING)][p]; }
    public int lastDraw(int p, int lag) { return t - lag >= 0 ? x(t - lag, p) : -1; }

    public void update(int[] draw) {
        OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraw(draw);
        int[] r = ring[(int) (t % RING)];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { int d = draw[p] - 1; r[p] = d; prev[p][d] = last[p][d]; last[p][d] = t; }
        t++;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ raw values (NaN = missing)
    double[][] freq(int w) {
        double[][] v = new double[10][10];
        if (t < w) { for (double[] r : v) Arrays.fill(r, Double.NaN); return v; }
        int[][] c = new int[10][10];
        for (long u = t - w; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c[p][x(u, p)]++;
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[p][n] = c[p][n] / (double) w;
        return v;
    }

    double[][] raw(Spec s) {
        double[][] v = new double[10][10];
        switch (s.family) {
            case "FREQUENCY": return freq(s.i("window"));
            case "ROLLING_VARIANCE_INDICATOR": {
                double[][] f = freq(s.i("window"));
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[p][n] = f[p][n] * (1 - f[p][n]);
                return v;
            }
            case "FREQUENCY_SLOPE": {
                int w = s.i("window");
                if (t < w) { for (double[] r : v) Arrays.fill(r, Double.NaN); return v; }
                long lo = t - w; long[][] bins = new long[10][10], wt = new long[10][10];
                for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { int a = x(u, p); bins[p][a]++; wt[p][a] += u - lo; }
                double den = w * (w * (double) w - 1.0) / 12;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[p][n] = ((double) wt[p][n] - (w - 1) * (double) bins[p][n] / 2) / den;
                return v;
            }
            case "OMISSION":
            case "OMISSION_RATE": {
                boolean rate = s.family.equals("OMISSION_RATE"); int w = rate ? s.i("window") : 0;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
                    double g = last[p][n] >= 0 ? (double) (t - last[p][n]) : Double.NaN;
                    double o = g - 1;
                    v[p][n] = !rate ? o : (t < w ? Double.NaN : (Double.isNaN(o) ? Double.NaN : Math.min(o, w) / w));
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "HOT_COLD_Z": {
                int r = s.i("recent"), R = s.i("reference");
                double[][] a = freq(r), z = freq(R);
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
                    double var = z[p][n] * (1 - z[p][n]) * (1.0 / r - 1.0 / R);
                    v[p][n] = var > 1e-12 ? (a[p][n] - z[p][n]) / Math.sqrt(Math.max(var, 1e-12)) : Double.NaN;
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "MARKOV_SCORE": {
                int w = s.i("window"); double alpha = s.d("alpha");
                if (t < w + 1) { for (double[] r : v) Arrays.fill(r, Double.NaN); return v; }
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    int from = x(t - 1, p); long[] row = new long[10];
                    for (long j = Math.max(0, t - w - 1); j <= t - 2; j++) if (x(j, p) == from) row[x(j + 1, p)]++;
                    long sum = 0; for (long c : row) sum += c;
                    for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[p][n] = (row[n] + alpha) / (sum + 10 * alpha);
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "LAG_DIGIT_EQ": {
                int l = s.i("lag");
                if (t >= l) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) v[p][x(t - l, p)] = 1.0;
                return v;
            }
            case "GAP_LAST_GAP": {
                int w = s.i("window");
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++)
                    v[p][n] = t >= w && prev[p][n] >= t - w ? (double) (last[p][n] - prev[p][n]) : Double.NaN;
                return v;
            }
            case "PERIODICITY": {
                int w = s.i("window"), L = s.i("period");
                if (t < w + L) { for (double[] r : v) Arrays.fill(r, Double.NaN); return v; }
                long lo = t - w; double nn = w;
                long[][] A = new long[10][10], B = new long[10][10], AB = new long[10][10];
                for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { int cur = x(u, p), lg = x(u - L, p); A[p][lg]++; B[p][cur]++; if (cur == lg) AB[p][cur]++; }
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
                    double a = A[p][n], b = B[p][n], ab = AB[p][n];
                    double den = Math.sqrt(Math.max((a - a * a / nn) * (b - b * b / nn), 0));
                    v[p][n] = den > 1e-12 ? (ab - a * b / nn) / Math.max(den, 1e-12) : Double.NaN;
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "GAP_MEAN_GAP": case "GAP_VAR_GAP": case "GAP_GAP_Z": return gapStats(s.family, s.i("window"));
            case "XI_SUPPORT": {
                float[][][] Z = experts(); int k = s.i("k");
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    int[][] rank = new int[8][];
                    for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) rank[e] = ranks(Z[e][p]);
                    for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double[] in = new double[8]; for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) in[e] = rank[e][n] < k ? 1.0 : 0.0; v[p][n] = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(in, 0, 8) / 8; }
                }
                return v;
            }
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_ATOM_FAMILY " + s.family);
        }
    }

    /** AtomWindowCP4.Window.gap over the occurrences of each number inside [t-w, t) (NaN = Missing). */
    double[][] gapStats(String family, int w) {
        double[][] v = new double[10][10];
        for (double[] r : v) Arrays.fill(r, Double.NaN);
        if (t < w) return v;
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            long[][] occ = new long[10][w]; int[] cnt = new int[10];
            for (long u = t - w; u < t; u++) { int a = x(u, p); occ[a][cnt[a]++] = u; }
            for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
                int n = cnt[k] - 1; if (n < 1) continue;
                long s1 = 0, s2 = 0; for (int i = 1; i < cnt[k]; i++) { long g = occ[k][i] - occ[k][i - 1]; s1 += g; s2 += g * g; }
                double mean = s1 / (double) n, var = Math.max(0.0, s2 / (double) n - mean * mean);
                if (family.equals("GAP_MEAN_GAP")) v[p][k] = mean;
                else if (family.equals("GAP_VAR_GAP")) v[p][k] = var;
                else if (n >= 2 && var >= 1e-12) v[p][k] = ((double) (occ[k][cnt[k] - 1] - occ[k][cnt[k] - 2]) - mean) / Math.sqrt(var);
            }
        }
        return v;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the 8 experts of the user's XI method (hre.ExpertBank)
    private long expT = -1; private float[][][] expZ;
    /** Z[e][p][n] at the current target, hre.ExpertBank dtypes and numpy reductions (windows 12..360, omission, markov720, momentum). */
    public float[][][] experts() {
        if (expT == t) return expZ;
        float[][][] Z = new float[8][10][10];
        int[] wins = {12, 24, 48, 96, 360};
        double[][][] r64 = new double[6][10][10];
        for (int wi = 0; wi < 5; wi++) {
            long lo = Math.max(t - wins[wi], 0); long den = Math.max(t - lo, 1);
            float[][] c = new float[10][10];
            for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c[p][x(u, p)] += 1f;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) r64[wi][p][n] = (double) c[p][n] / (double) den;
        }
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) r64[5][p][n] = r64[1][p][n] - r64[4][p][n];
        float[][] om = new float[10][10], mk = new float[10][10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) om[p][n] = (float) Math.log1p((float) (last[p][n] >= 0 ? t - last[p][n] : t + 1));
        if (t >= 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                float[] row = new float[10]; int prev = x(t - 1, p);
                for (long j = Math.max(0, t - 2 - 719); j <= t - 2; j++) if (x(j, p) == prev) row[x(j + 1, p)] += 1f;
                float sm = XiIncumbentSU2.pairwise10(row);
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) mk[p][n] = (row[n] + 1.0f) / (sm + 10.0f);
            }
        } else for (float[] r : mk) Arrays.fill(r, 0.1f);
        int[] map = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, -1, -2, 5};
        for (int e = 0; e < 8; e++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            if (map[e] >= 0) {
                double[] v = r64[map[e]][p]; double mu = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(v, 0, 10) / 10;
                double[] q = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double d = v[n] - mu; q[n] = d * d; }
                double sd = Math.sqrt(ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(q, 0, 10) / 10) + 1e-6;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) Z[e][p][n] = (float) ((v[n] - mu) / sd);
            } else {
                float[] v = map[e] == -1 ? om[p] : mk[p]; float mu = XiIncumbentSU2.pairwise10(v) / 10f;
                float[] q = new float[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { float d = v[n] - mu; q[n] = d * d; }
                float sd = (float) Math.sqrt(XiIncumbentSU2.pairwise10(q) / 10f) + 1e-6f;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) Z[e][p][n] = (v[n] - mu) / sd;
            }
        }
        expT = t; expZ = Z; return Z;
    }

    /** hre.ExpertBank.Rank: stable argsort of -(Z - n*1e-4) (float32), then the rank of every number. */
    static int[] ranks(float[] z) {
        Integer[] ord = new Integer[10]; float[] key = new float[10];
        for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { ord[n] = n; key[n] = -(z[n] - (float) n * 1e-4f); }
        Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> Float.compare(key[a], key[b]));
        int[] r = new int[10]; for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) r[ord[i]] = i; return r;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ R15 state atoms (atoms_r15.state_series / state_indicator)
    static double entropy(double[] c) { double n = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(c, 0, c.length); if (n == 0) return Double.NaN; double h = 0; for (double v : c) if (v > 0) { double q = v / n; h -= q * Math.log(q); } return h; }
    static double[] probs(double[] c) { double n = 0.5 * c.length; for (double v : c) n += v; double[] o = new double[c.length]; for (int i = 0; i < c.length; i++) o[i] = (c[i] + 0.5) / n; return o; }
    static double js(double[] a, double[] b) {
        double out = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { double hi = Math.max(a[i], b[i]); if (hi == 0) continue; double lm = Math.log(hi) + Math.log1p(Math.min(a[i], b[i]) / hi) - Math.log(2);
            if (a[i] > 0) out += a[i] * (Math.log(a[i]) - lm) / 2; if (b[i] > 0) out += b[i] * (Math.log(b[i]) - lm) / 2; }
        return Math.max(0.0, out);
    }
    static double psi(double[] a, double[] b) { double out = 0; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) out += (a[i] - b[i]) * (Math.log(a[i]) - Math.log(b[i])); return Math.max(0.0, out); }
    double[] countsAt(long u, int w, int p) { double[] c = new double[10]; for (long v = u - w; v < u; v++) c[x(v, p)] += 1; return c; }
    static final String[] REGIMES = {"LOW_ENTROPY", "HIGH_ENTROPY", "TRENDING", "MEAN_REVERTING", "DRIFTING"};

    /** State series value at target u (draws < u), all positions; NaN = Missing. */
    double[] stateAt(Spec s, long u) {
        double[] v = new double[10]; Arrays.fill(v, Double.NaN);
        switch (s.family) {
            case "DELTA_NUMERIC": case "DIRECTION": {
                int l = s.i("lag"); if (u < l + 1) return v;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double d = x(u - 1, p) - x(u - 1 - l, p); v[p] = s.family.equals("DIRECTION") ? Math.signum(d) : d; }
                return v;
            }
            case "ENTROPY": case "ROLLING_MEAN_DIGIT": case "ROLLING_VARIANCE_DIGIT": {
                int w = s.i("window"); if (u < w) return v;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    double[] c = countsAt(u, w, p);
                    if (s.family.equals("ENTROPY")) { v[p] = entropy(c); continue; }
                    double m = 0; for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) m += d * c[d]; m /= w;
                    if (s.family.equals("ROLLING_MEAN_DIGIT")) { v[p] = m; continue; }
                    double q = 0; for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) q += (d - m) * (d - m) * c[d]; v[p] = q / w;
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "CONDITIONAL_ENTROPY": {
                int w = s.i("window"), l = s.i("lag"); if (u < w + l) return v;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    double[][] J = new double[10][10]; for (long q = u - w; q < u; q++) J[x(q - l, p)][x(q, p)] += 1;
                    double h = 0;
                    for (int a = 0; a < 10; a++) { double n = 0; for (int b = 0; b < 10; b++) n += J[a][b]; for (int b = 0; b < 10; b++) { double c = J[a][b]; if (c > 0) h -= c / w * Math.log(c / n); } }
                    v[p] = h;
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "DRIFT_JS": case "DRIFT_PSI": {
                int r = s.i("recent"), R = s.i("reference"); if (u < r + R) return v;
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    double[] rc = countsAt(u, r, p), oc = countsAt(u, r + R, p); for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) oc[k] -= rc[k];
                    double[] a = probs(rc), b = probs(oc); v[p] = s.family.equals("DRIFT_JS") ? js(a, b) : psi(a, b);
                }
                return v;
            }
            case "REGIME_SCORE": {
                int w = s.i("window"); if (u < 2L * w) return v;
                int ri = Arrays.asList(REGIMES).indexOf(s.str.get("regime"));
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    double[] c = countsAt(u, w, p), old = countsAt(u, 2 * w, p); for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) old[k] -= c[k];
                    double h = entropy(c) / Math.log(10), j = js(probs(c), probs(old));
                    double[][] J = new double[10][10]; for (long q = u - (w - 1); q < u; q++) J[x(q - 1, p)][x(q, p)] += 1;
                    double a = 0, b = 0, aa = 0, bb = 0, ab = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) { double n = J[i][k]; a += n * i; b += n * k; aa += n * i * i; bb += n * k * k; ab += n * i * k; }
                    double cnt = w - 1, den = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0, (aa - a * a / cnt) * (bb - b * b / cnt)));
                    double corr = den <= 1e-12 ? 0.0 : (ab - a * b / cnt) / den;
                    double[] lg = {2 * (1 - h), 2 * h, 2 * Math.max(0.0, corr), 2 * Math.max(0.0, -corr), 4 * j};
                    double[] e = new double[5]; double sm = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { e[i] = Math.exp(lg[i]); sm += e[i]; }
                    v[p] = e[ri] / sm;
                }
                return v;
            }
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_STATE_FAMILY " + s.family);
        }
    }

    public static final int MEDIAN_PAST = 300, MEDIAN_MIN = 100;
    private final Map<Integer, double[][]> stateRing = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, long[]> stateTime = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, float[]> stateNow = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, Long> stateNowT = new HashMap<>();

    /** State indicator at the current target: +1 above / -1 not above the median of the previous 300 present values, 0 otherwise. */
    public float[] state(int j) {
        Long nt = stateNowT.get(j); if (nt != null && nt == t) return stateNow.get(j);
        Spec s = STATES[j];
        double[][] ring = stateRing.computeIfAbsent(j, k -> new double[MEDIAN_PAST][]);
        long[] when = stateTime.computeIfAbsent(j, k -> { long[] a = new long[MEDIAN_PAST]; Arrays.fill(a, -1); return a; });
        long lo = Math.max(0, t - MEDIAN_PAST);
        for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) { int k = (int) (u % MEDIAN_PAST); if (when[k] != u) { ring[k] = stateAt(s, u); when[k] = u; } }
        double[] cur = stateAt(s, t);
        float[] out = new float[10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            if (Double.isNaN(cur[p]) || Double.isInfinite(cur[p])) continue;
            double[] col = new double[(int) (t - lo)]; int n = 0;
            for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) { double y = ring[(int) (u % MEDIAN_PAST)][p]; if (!Double.isNaN(y) && !Double.isInfinite(y)) col[n++] = y; }
            if (n < MEDIAN_MIN) continue;
            double[] c2 = Arrays.copyOf(col, n); Arrays.sort(c2);
            double med = n % 2 == 1 ? c2[n / 2] : (c2[n / 2 - 1] + c2[n / 2]) / 2;
            out[p] = cur[p] > med ? 1f : -1f;
        }
        int k = (int) (t % MEDIAN_PAST);
        // the slot of t-300 is no longer needed after this target
        ring[k] = cur; when[k] = t;
        stateNow.put(j, out); stateNowT.put(j, t);
        return out;
    }

    /** Missing -> row mean of present values (all missing -> 0), z-score across numbers; double result. */
    static double[] zrow(double[] row, boolean fill) {
        double[] v = row.clone();
        if (fill) {
            double[] tmp = new double[10]; int cnt = 0;
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { boolean ok = !Double.isNaN(v[n]) && !Double.isInfinite(v[n]); tmp[n] = ok ? v[n] : 0.0; if (ok) cnt++; }
            double mean = cnt > 0 ? ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(tmp, 0, 10) / cnt : Double.NaN;
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { boolean ok = !Double.isNaN(v[n]) && !Double.isInfinite(v[n]); if (!ok) v[n] = mean; if (Double.isNaN(v[n])) v[n] = 0.0; }
        }
        double mu = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(v, 0, 10) / 10;
        double[] sq = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double d = v[n] - mu; sq[n] = d * d; }
        double sd = Math.sqrt(ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(sq, 0, 10) / 10) + 1e-6;
        double[] out = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[n] = (v[n] - mu) / sd;
        return out;
    }

    static float clipF(float f) { return f < -CLIP ? -CLIP : (f > CLIP ? CLIP : f); }

    /** PHASE_FREQUENCY(period m, window w): share of n at p among the last w draws u < t with u = t (mod m). */
    double[][] phase(int m, int w) {
        double[][] v = new double[10][10];
        long j = t / m, lo = Math.max(j - w, 0), nCnt = j - lo;
        int[][] c = new int[10][10];
        for (long k = lo; k < j; k++) { long u = (t % m) + k * m; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c[p][x(u, p)]++; }
        double den = Math.max(nCnt, 1);
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[p][n] = c[p][n] / den;
        return v;
    }

    /** Atom i for the current target: float [10][10], z-scored per position, clipped. */
    public float[][] atom(int i) {
        Spec s = CATALOG[i]; float[][] out = new float[10][10];
        if (s.family.equals("XI_EXPERT")) {
            float[][] z = experts()[s.i("expert")];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[p][n] = clipF(z[p][n]);
            return out;
        }
        if (s.family.equals("PHASE_FREQUENCY")) {
            double[][] v = phase(s.i("period"), s.i("window"));
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double[] z = zrow(v[p], false); for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double c = z[n] < -CLIP ? -CLIP : (z[n] > CLIP ? CLIP : z[n]); out[p][n] = (float) c; } }
            return out;
        }
        double[][] v = raw(s);
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double[] z = zrow(v[p], true); for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[p][n] = clipF((float) z[n]); }
        return out;
    }

    /** Atom x atom interaction, re-z-scored per position (atomnet.AtomSource.pair). */
    public static float[][] pair(float[][] a, float[][] b) {
        float[][] out = new float[10][10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            double[] v = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) v[n] = (double) a[p][n] * (double) b[p][n];
            double[] z = zrow(v, false);
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double c = z[n] < -CLIP ? -CLIP : (z[n] > CLIP ? CLIP : z[n]); out[p][n] = (float) c; }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static final int[] GROUP_WINDOWS = {10, 50, 200};
    public static final int N_GROUP = 2 * GROUP_WINDOWS.length + 2;

    /** Group atoms [10][10][N_GROUP]: odd/even and big/small share at 3 scales and the last value (atomnet.group_features). */
    public float[][][] group() {
        float[][][] out = new float[10][10][N_GROUP];
        for (int gi = 0; gi < 2; gi++) {
            for (int wi = 0; wi < GROUP_WINDOWS.length; wi++) {
                int w = GROUP_WINDOWS[wi]; long lo = Math.max(t - w, 0); double n = Math.max(t - lo, 1);
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    long sum = 0; for (long u = lo; u < t; u++) sum += sign(gi, x(u, p));
                    double share = t < 1 ? 0.0 : sum / n;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) out[p][k][gi * (GROUP_WINDOWS.length + 1) + wi] = (float) (share * sign(gi, k));
                }
            }
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double lastS = t >= 1 ? sign(gi, x(t - 1, p)) : 0.0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) out[p][k][gi * (GROUP_WINDOWS.length + 1) + GROUP_WINDOWS.length] = (float) (lastS * sign(gi, k));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** +1 for odd (gi=0) / big 6-10 (gi=1) numbers, -1 otherwise; k is 0-based. */
    static int sign(int gi, int k) { int v = k + 1; return gi == 0 ? (v % 2 == 1 ? 1 : -1) : (v >= 6 ? 1 : -1); }

    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
        o.writeLong(t); int keep = (int) Math.min(t, RING); o.writeInt(keep);
        for (long u = t - keep; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) o.writeByte(x(u, p));
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { o.writeLong(last[p][n]); o.writeLong(prev[p][n]); }
    }

    public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        t = in.readLong(); int keep = in.readInt(); if (keep < 0 || keep > RING || keep > t) throw new IOException("SU2_ATOM_STATE");
        for (long u = t - keep; u < t; u++) { int[] r = ring[(int) (u % RING)]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) r[p] = in.readByte(); }
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { last[p][n] = in.readLong(); prev[p][n] = in.readLong(); }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * R14 online temperature calibration of a member's probability table (P36).
 *
 * Diagnosis on known-truth worlds: every model family is 2.5-3x over-confident (its predictive
 * log-likelihood is worse than uniform), which spoils confidence gating and fusion. Calibration:
 *
 *   P_cal(t)[p][n] = softmax_n( beta * log P(t)[p][n] ),   beta in [0, 2],
 *
 * with beta re-estimated every REFIT periods (first at START) by Newton steps on the mean
 * log-likelihood of the realised numbers over the trailing WINDOW periods (all 10 positions);
 * the objective is concave in beta, beta is warm-started from the previous block. Before START the
 * table is uniform. Strictly causal: the beta used for target t is fitted on draws < t.
 * Mirrors foundry14.calibrate (fixture r14_parity; tolerance 1e-6 on the table).
 */
public final class CalibrationSU2 {
    private CalibrationSU2() {}
    public static final int START = 1500, WINDOW = 2500, REFIT = 250, ITERS = 3;

    static double[] logRow(float[] row) { double[] l = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) l[n] = Math.log(Math.min(1.0, Math.max(1e-9, (double) row[n]))); return l; }

    /** Newton update of beta on rows L[i][p][n] with realised numbers y[i][p] (0-based); returns the new beta. */
    static double fitBeta(double[][][] L, int[][] y, int n, double beta) {
        for (int it = 0; it < ITERS; it++) {
            double gs = 0, hs = 0; long cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double[] l = L[i][p]; double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
                for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) mx = Math.max(mx, beta * l[k]);
                double z = 0; double[] e = new double[10];
                for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) { e[k] = Math.exp(beta * l[k] - mx); z += e[k]; }
                double m1 = 0, m2 = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) { double pr = e[k] / z; m1 += pr * l[k]; m2 += pr * l[k] * l[k]; }
                gs += l[y[i][p]] - m1; hs += m2 - m1 * m1; cnt++;
            }
            double g = gs / cnt, h = -hs / cnt;
            if (h > -1e-12) break;
            double nb = Math.min(2.0, Math.max(0.0, beta - g / h));
            if (Math.abs(nb - beta) < 1e-6) { beta = nb; break; }
            beta = nb;
        }
        return beta;
    }

    static float[][] apply(double beta, float[][] row) {
        float[][] out = new float[10][10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            double[] l = logRow(row[p]); double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) mx = Math.max(mx, beta * l[k]);
            double z = 0; double[] e = new double[10];
            for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) { e[k] = Math.exp(beta * l[k] - mx); z += e[k]; }
            for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) out[p][k] = (float) (e[k] / z);
        }
        return out;
    }

    static float[][] uniform() { float[][] u = new float[10][10]; for (float[] r : u) Arrays.fill(r, 0.1f); return u; }

    /** Batch (replay) form over a whole table. */
    public static float[][][] calibrate(float[][][] P, int[][] draws) {
        int T = P.length; float[][][] out = new float[T][][];
        for (int t = 0; t < Math.min(START, T); t++) out[t] = uniform();
        double beta = 1.0;
        for (int t0 = START; t0 < T; t0 += REFIT) {
            int lo = Math.max(0, t0 - WINDOW), n = t0 - lo;
            double[][][] L = new double[n][10][]; int[][] y = new int[n][10];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { L[i][p] = logRow(P[lo + i][p]); y[i][p] = draws[lo + i][p] - 1; }
            beta = fitBeta(L, y, n, beta);
            for (int t = t0; t < Math.min(t0 + REFIT, T); t++) out[t] = apply(beta, P[t]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Incremental (live) form: identical outputs to calibrate(), one period at a time. */
    public static final class Live {
        // raw float tables (logs are recomputed at refit time, bit-identical): 1 MB per member instead of 2 MB
        final float[][][] ring = new float[WINDOW][][]; final byte[][] ringY = new byte[WINDOW][]; int filled; long t; double beta = 1.0;
        /** Calibrated table for the current target (index t), from draws < t only. */
        public float[][] predict(float[][] raw) {
            if (t < START) return uniform();
            if ((t - START) % REFIT == 0) refitIfDue();
            return apply(beta, raw);
        }
        private long fittedAt = -1;
        private void refitIfDue() {
            if (fittedAt == t) return;
            int n = filled; double[][][] L = new double[n][10][]; int[][] y = new int[n][10];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { int j = (int) ((t - n + i) % WINDOW); for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { L[i][p] = logRow(ring[j][p]); y[i][p] = ringY[j][p]; } }
            beta = fitBeta(L, y, n, beta); fittedAt = t;
        }
        /** After the draw of target t is settled (whether or not anything acted). */
        public void settle(float[][] raw, int[] draw) {
            if (t >= START && (t - START) % REFIT == 0) refitIfDue();       // a period skipped by predict still refits
            int j = (int) (t % WINDOW); float[][] l = new float[10][]; byte[] y = new byte[10];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { l[p] = raw[p].clone(); y[p] = (byte) (draw[p] - 1); }
            ring[j] = l; ringY[j] = y; if (filled < WINDOW) filled++; t++;
        }
        public double beta() { return beta; }
        public void write(java.io.DataOutput o) throws java.io.IOException {
            o.writeLong(t); o.writeDouble(beta); o.writeLong(fittedAt); o.writeInt(filled);
            for (int i = 0; i < filled; i++) { int j = (int) ((t - filled + i) % WINDOW); for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { o.writeByte(ringY[j][p]); for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) o.writeFloat(ring[j][p][k]); } }
        }
        public void read(java.io.DataInput in) throws java.io.IOException {
            t = in.readLong(); beta = in.readDouble(); fittedAt = in.readLong(); filled = in.readInt();
            for (int i = 0; i < filled; i++) { int j = (int) ((t - filled + i) % WINDOW); ringY[j] = new byte[10]; ring[j] = new float[10][10];
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { ringY[j][p] = in.readByte(); for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) ring[j][p][k] = in.readFloat(); } }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;

/**
 * Selective certificates for SU2 league members (P27/P28/P29).
 * Issued only from settled LIVE records (never from replay), at the alpha this look
 * may spend (lifetime root 0.05, alpha_k = 0.05/(k(k+1)) per genome), with post-
 * selection calibration of the shown probability (Platt on earlier ACT rows, ECE<=0.04).
 * Valid 24 hours; re-issued daily while the evidence holds. Replaces the SU1
 * requirement "coverage>=0.999", which made every 15-30% strategy uncertifiable.
 */
public final class CertificateSU2 {
    private CertificateSU2() {}
    public static final String PREFIX = "SU2-F-";

    public static final class Authority {
        public final String certificate, genome, program; public final double a, b; public final long issued, expires;
        Authority(String c, String g, String p, double a, double b, long i, long e) { certificate = c; genome = g; program = p; this.a = a; this.b = b; issued = i; expires = e; }
        public String candidate() { return PREFIX + genome; }
    }

    public static Authority read(SQLiteDatabase db, String genome, long now) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT c.certificate_id,c.program_hash,c.calibration_a,c.calibration_b,c.issued_at,c.expires_at,g.canonical_text FROM su2_certificate c JOIN su2_model_genome g ON g.genome_key=c.genome_key "
            + "WHERE c.genome_key=? AND c.issued_at<=? AND c.expires_at>? AND g.state='LEAGUE' ORDER BY c.issued_at DESC LIMIT 1", new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(now), String.valueOf(now)})) {
            if (!c.moveToFirst()) return null;
            if (!HashingSU1.text(c.getString(6)).equals(c.getString(1))) return null;        // certificate bound to the exact program
            return new Authority(c.getString(0), genome, c.getString(1), c.getDouble(2), c.getDouble(3), c.getLong(4), c.getLong(5));
        }
    }

    /** Daily maintenance: evaluate the current mainline member and issue a certificate if the live evidence passes. */
    public static String maintain(DbStore store, long seq) {
        SQLiteDatabase r = store.readable();
        String member = ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(r, seq);
        boolean incumbent = member.startsWith("XI_INCUMBENT:");                  // the old method is certified by the same rule
        if (!member.startsWith("SU2:") && !incumbent) return "SU2_CERT_NO_SU2_MAINLINE";
        String genome = member.substring(member.indexOf(':') + 1);
        if (read(r, genome, System.currentTimeMillis()) != null) return "SU2_CERT_VALID";
        long from = seq - MainlineBridgeSU2.WINDOW;
        boolean[][] me = ModelStoreSU2.record(r, genome, from, seq);
        boolean[][] inc = null;
        if (!incumbent) for (String[] m : ModelStoreSU2.league(r)) if (m[1].equals("XI_INCUMBENT")) inc = ModelStoreSU2.record(r, m[3], from, seq);
        int look; try (Cursor c = r.rawQuery("SELECT looks FROM su2_alpha_look WHERE genome_key=?", new String[]{genome})) { look = (c.moveToFirst() ? c.getInt(0) : 0) + 1; }
        SelectiveEvidenceSU2.Verdict v = SelectiveEvidenceSU2.evaluate(me[0], me[1], null, inc == null ? null : inc[0], inc == null ? null : inc[1], 0, MainlineBridgeSU2.WINDOW,
            look, MainlineBridgeSU2.ROOT_ALPHA, MainlineBridgeSU2.MIN_ACTS, MainlineBridgeSU2.BLOCK_FLOOR, MainlineBridgeSU2.MIN_COVERAGE);
        // calibration from earlier ACT rows (phat recorded at freeze time)
        double[] ph = new double[MainlineBridgeSU2.WINDOW]; boolean[] hh = new boolean[MainlineBridgeSU2.WINDOW]; int n = 0;
        try (Cursor c = r.rawQuery("SELECT phat,hit FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal>=? AND sequence_ordinal<? AND act=1 AND hit IS NOT NULL AND phat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sequence_ordinal",
            new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(from), String.valueOf(seq)})) { while (c.moveToNext() && n < ph.length) { ph[n] = c.getDouble(0); hh[n] = c.getInt(1) == 1; n++; } }
        SelectiveCalibrationSU2.Platt cal = SelectiveCalibrationSU2.fit(ph, hh, n, 10.0);
        double[] adj = new double[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = cal.apply(ph[i]);
        double ece = SelectiveCalibrationSU2.ece(adj, hh, n);
        final int lk = look; final boolean pass = v.pass && ece <= 0.04;
        String program; try (Cursor c = r.rawQuery("SELECT canonical_text FROM su2_model_genome WHERE genome_key=?", new String[]{genome})) { if (!c.moveToFirst()) return "SU2_CERT_GENOME_MISSING"; program = HashingSU1.text(c.getString(0)); }
        final String prog = program; final long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_CERT_LOOK", db -> {
            db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_alpha_look(genome_key,looks) VALUES(?,0)", new Object[]{genome});
            db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_alpha_look SET looks=? WHERE genome_key=? AND looks=?", new Object[]{lk, genome, lk - 1});  // every look spends alpha, pass or fail
            if (pass) {
                String id = HashingSU1.fields("SU2_CERTIFICATE_V1", genome, prog, String.valueOf(from), String.valueOf(seq), String.valueOf(lk), String.valueOf(now));
                db.execSQL("INSERT INTO su2_certificate(certificate_id,genome_key,program_hash,window_start,window_end,acts,hits,lower_bound,coverage,worst_block,paired_upper,look,alpha,calibration_a,calibration_b,ece,issued_at,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    new Object[]{id, genome, prog, from, seq, v.acts, v.hits, v.lower, v.coverage, v.worstBlock, Double.isNaN(v.pairedUpper) ? null : v.pairedUpper, lk, SelectiveEvidenceSU2.alphaForLook(MainlineBridgeSU2.ROOT_ALPHA, lk), cal.a, cal.b, ece, now, now + 86400000L});
            }
            return 0;
        });
        return (pass ? "SU2_CERT_ISSUED" : "SU2_CERT_REFUSED:" + (v.pass ? "ECE_GT_004" : v.reason)) + "|acts=" + v.acts + "|rate=" + String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.4f", v.rate) + "|lower=" + String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.4f", v.lower) + "|look=" + lk;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Live, incremental committee (P37): every period each member program computes its (calibrated) pooled table,
 * the tables are fused by geometric mean, the best position's top-3 is the decision and the confidence gate at
 * the tier frequency decides whether to act (never on a chance-level table). Identical to
 * CommitteeSU2.evaluate on the same draws (CommitteeLiveSU2Test, including save/restore and late birth).
 */
public final class CommitteeLiveSU2 implements LiveStrategySU2 {
    final CommitteeSU2 c; final ModelLiveSU2[] subs; final int startMeta; long t;
    final double[] gsRing = new double[720]; double thr = Double.NaN; boolean thrValid;
    int curP1 = -1; int[] curK3 = new int[3]; double curGs; float[][] lastPooled; long lastPooledT = -1;

    public CommitteeLiveSU2(CommitteeSU2 c, ModelLiveSU2.Hub hub, int startMeta, int window, int refit) {
        this.c = c; this.startMeta = startMeta; subs = new ModelLiveSU2[c.subs.size()];
        for (int k = 0; k < subs.length; k++) subs[k] = new ModelLiveSU2(c.subs.get(k), hub, startMeta, window, refit);
        t = hub.t;
    }

    public String key() { return c.key(); }
    public boolean hasPending() { return curP1 >= 0; }
    public float[][] pendingTable(long tt) { return lastPooledT == tt ? lastPooled : null; }

    public ModelLiveSU2.Decision decide() {
        float[][][] tabs = new float[subs.length][][];
        for (int k = 0; k < subs.length; k++) { subs[k].decide(); tabs[k] = subs[k].lastPooled; }
        float[][] P = CommitteeSU2.fuse(tabs);
        lastPooled = P; lastPooledT = t;
        double[] mass = new double[10]; int[][] top = new int[10][3]; Integer[] ord = new Integer[10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            final float[] row = P[p]; for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) ord[i] = i;
            Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> Double.compare((double) row[b] - b * 1e-12, (double) row[a] - a * 1e-12));
            double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { top[p][i] = ord[i]; s += (double) row[ord[i]]; }
            mass[p] = Math.rint(s * 1e9) / 1e9;
        }
        int p1 = 0; for (int p = 1; p < 10; p++) if (mass[p] > mass[p1]) p1 = p;
        curP1 = p1; curK3 = top[p1].clone(); curGs = mass[p1];
        boolean act = false;
        if (t >= startMeta) {
            if (c.coverage >= .999) act = curGs > ModelReplaySU2.INFORMATIVE;
            else {
                if ((t - startMeta) % 50 == 0) blockThreshold();
                act = thrValid && curGs >= thr && curGs > ModelReplaySU2.INFORMATIVE;
            }
        }
        return new ModelLiveSU2.Decision(t, p1 + 1, (1 << curK3[0]) | (1 << curK3[1]) | (1 << curK3[2]), act, curGs, curGs);
    }

    private void blockThreshold() {
        long lo = Math.max(startMeta - 720, t - 720); int n = (int) (t - lo);
        if (n < 100) { thrValid = false; return; }
        double[] hist = new double[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) hist[i] = gsRing[(int) ((lo + i) % 720)];
        thr = ModelReplaySU2.quantileLinear(hist, 1 - c.coverage); thrValid = true;
    }

    public boolean settle(int[] draw) {
        if (curP1 < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_COMMITTEE_SETTLE_WITHOUT_DECISION");
        for (ModelLiveSU2 s : subs) s.settle(draw);
        int x = draw[curP1] - 1; boolean hit = curK3[0] == x || curK3[1] == x || curK3[2] == x;
        gsRing[(int) (t % 720)] = curGs; curP1 = -1; t++;
        return hit;
    }

    /** A committee born after genesis: replay the stored history through a private hub, then join the shared hub. */
    public static CommitteeLiveSU2 bootstrap(CommitteeSU2 c, ModelLiveSU2.Hub shared, int[][] history, int startMeta, int window, int refit) {
        for (ModelGenomeSU2 g : c.subs) for (ModelGenomeSU2.Member m : g.members) { shared.adopt(m, history); if (g.calibrated) shared.adoptCalibrated(m, history); }
        ModelLiveSU2.Hub own = new ModelLiveSU2.Hub();
        CommitteeLiveSU2 live = new CommitteeLiveSU2(c, own, startMeta, window, refit);
        for (int[] d : history) { live.decide(); live.settle(d); own.update(d); }
        if (own.t != shared.t) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_BOOTSTRAP_DESYNC");
        for (ModelLiveSU2 s : live.subs) s.hub = shared;
        return live;
    }

    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
        o.writeUTF(c.key()); o.writeLong(t); for (double v : gsRing) o.writeDouble(v); o.writeDouble(thr); o.writeBoolean(thrValid);
        for (ModelLiveSU2 s : subs) s.write(o);
    }

    public void readInto(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        if (!c.key().equals(in.readUTF())) throw new IOException("SU2_COMMITTEE_STATE_KEY");
        t = in.readLong(); for (int i = 0; i < gsRing.length; i++) gsRing[i] = in.readDouble(); thr = in.readDouble(); thrValid = in.readBoolean();
        for (ModelLiveSU2 s : subs) s.readInto(in); curP1 = -1;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * R14 committee strategy (P37): the champion of a frequency tier is the fusion of the top programs
 * chosen by the consensus judge (ModelEvolutionSU2), not one lucky winner.
 *
 *   P_committee(t)[p] = normalise( exp( (1/K) * sum_k log P_k(t)[p] ) )      (geometric mean of K tables)
 *   decision          = best position by top-3 mass, its top-3 numbers, confidence gate at the tier frequency
 *
 * On known-truth worlds the committee of the top-5 calibrated programs reached 37.3-37.7% (regime world),
 * 33.2-33.3% (cross), 33.3-33.4% (drift), 33.0-33.4% (mixed) at 15% frequency, against 30.7-33.3% for the
 * single program R13 selection picked (select_study.py). Canonical text is the identity:
 *
 *   SU2C|COV=0.15|G=<member genome text>##<member genome text>##...
 *
 * Mirrors foundry14.Committee / foundry14.table / foundry14.evaluate (fixture r14_parity).
 */
public final class CommitteeSU2 {
    public static final int MAX_MEMBERS = 5;
    public final List<ModelGenomeSU2> subs; public final double coverage;

    public CommitteeSU2(List<ModelGenomeSU2> subs, double coverage) {
        if (subs == null || subs.isEmpty() || subs.size() > MAX_MEMBERS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_MEMBERS");
        if (!(coverage == 0.15 || coverage == 0.30 || coverage == 1.0)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_FREQUENCY");
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (ModelGenomeSU2 g : subs) if (!seen.add(g.text())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_DUPLICATE");
        this.subs = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(subs)); this.coverage = coverage;
    }

    public String text() {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("SU2C|COV=").append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.2f", coverage)).append("|G=");
        for (int i = 0; i < subs.size(); i++) { if (i > 0) b.append("##"); b.append(subs.get(i).text()); }
        return b.toString();
    }

    public String key() { return HashingSU1.text("SU2_COMMITTEE_V1|" + text()); }

    public String formula() {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("P = geometric-mean fusion[");
        for (int i = 0; i < subs.size(); i++) { if (i > 0) b.append(" ; "); String f = subs.get(i).formula(); b.append(f, 0, f.indexOf(" -> ")); }
        return b.append("] -> best position Top3 | confidence gate MASS | target frequency ").append(Math.round(coverage * 100)).append('%').toString();
    }

    public static boolean isCommittee(String text) { return text != null && text.startsWith("SU2C|"); }

    public static CommitteeSU2 parse(String text) {
        if (!isCommittee(text) || text.length() > 8192) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_TEXT");
        int g = text.indexOf("|G=");
        if (g < 0 || !text.startsWith("SU2C|COV=")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_FIELDS");
        double cov = Double.parseDouble(text.substring(9, g));
        List<ModelGenomeSU2> subs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String s : text.substring(g + 3).split("##")) subs.add(ModelGenomeSU2.parse(s));
        CommitteeSU2 c = new CommitteeSU2(subs, cov);
        if (!c.text().equals(text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_COMMITTEE_NOT_CANONICAL");
        return c;
    }

    /** Geometric-mean fusion of tables (numpy-identical reductions). */
    public static float[][] fuse(float[][][] tables) {
        int K = tables.length; float[][] out = new float[10][10]; double[] L = new double[10], E = new double[10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) s += Math.log(Math.min(1.0, Math.max(1e-9, (double) tables[k][p][n]))); L[n] = s / K; mx = Math.max(mx, L[n]); }
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[n] = Math.exp(L[n] - mx);
            double z = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(E, 0, 10);
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[p][n] = (float) (E[n] / z);
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static float[][][] table(CommitteeSU2 c, ModelReplaySU2.Library lib) {
        float[][][][] tabs = new float[c.subs.size()][][][];
        for (int k = 0; k < tabs.length; k++) tabs[k] = ModelReplaySU2.pooledTable(c.subs.get(k), lib);
        int T = tabs[0].length; float[][][] out = new float[T][][]; float[][][] at = new float[tabs.length][][];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) { for (int k = 0; k < tabs.length; k++) at[k] = tabs[k][t]; out[t] = fuse(at); }
        return out;
    }

    public static ModelReplaySU2.Result evaluate(CommitteeSU2 c, ModelReplaySU2.Library lib, int startMeta) {
        return ModelReplaySU2.evaluateTable(table(c, lib), lib.draws(), c.coverage, startMeta);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * P49 atomic continuation & direction matrix (contmat.py in the Python reference), streaming and phone-feasible.
 *
 * Patterns, all formed from draws already settled (causal):
 *   ATOM i TOP / BOTTOM      score atom i (AtomStreamSU2, z-scored per position, clipped) >= +1.645 / <= -1.645 at (p, n)
 *   BIG/SMALL/ODD/EVEN_RUN_k position p showed a big / small / odd / even number in each of the last k draws
 *                            (k = 3, 5, 7, 10) -> active for those numbers at p ("does the streak continue?")
 *   UNDER_W / OVER_W         number n at position p under / over represented over the last W draws (z <= -2 / >= 2),
 *                            W = 100, 200 ("does it catch up / cool down?")
 * For every (pattern, scope = all positions | one position) the matrix keeps, per 500-period block, how many cells were
 * active and how many came out. At every refit a pattern is VERIFIED only when both halves of the settled blocks deviate
 * from 10% in the same direction with |z| >= 2.5 (all positions) / 3.5 (one position), >= 200 cells each. The table for
 * the next block is softmax_n(sum of log(rate / 0.1) over the verified active patterns); nothing verified -> uniform, and
 * the calibrated table never passes the INFORMATIVE guard. verified() is the human-readable continuation / reversal report.
 * State: (verified patterns / 100, largest added logit, share of positions with an active verified pattern).
 */
public final class ContMatSU2 implements OnlineModelsSU2.Model {
    static final int START = 1500, BLOCK = 500, MIN_N = 200, MAX_BLOCKS = 40;   // verification uses the last 40 settled blocks
    static final double Z_ALL = 2.5, Z_POS = 3.5;
    static final float THR = 1.645f;
    static final int[] RUNS = {3, 5, 7, 10};
    static final int[] WINDOWS = {100, 200};
    static final String[] RUN_KINDS = {"BIG", "SMALL", "ODD", "EVEN"};

    final AtomStreamSU2 atoms = new AtomStreamSU2();
    final int nAtoms = AtomStreamSU2.size(), nPat;
    final String[] names;
    final int[][] runLen = new int[4][10];
    final int[][] ring = new int[WINDOWS[WINDOWS.length - 1]][10];
    final int[][][] win = new int[WINDOWS.length][10][10];
    final List<double[]> blkN = new ArrayList<>(), blkK = new ArrayList<>();   // per block: [pattern * 11 + scope]
    int blockBase;                                                               // index of blkN.get(0)
    final List<int[]> verPat = new ArrayList<>();                                // {pattern, scope}
    final List<Double> verLog = new ArrayList<>(), verRate = new ArrayList<>();
    final List<Long> verCells = new ArrayList<>();
    long t;
    boolean[][][] active;                                                        // [pattern][p][n] for the current target
    final double[] zraw = new double[100];

    public ContMatSU2() {
        List<String> n = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++) { n.add("ATOM:" + AtomStreamSU2.CATALOG[i].name() + ":TOP"); n.add("ATOM:" + AtomStreamSU2.CATALOG[i].name() + ":BOTTOM"); }
        for (String k : RUN_KINDS) for (int r : RUNS) n.add(k + "_RUN_" + r);
        for (int w : WINDOWS) { n.add("UNDER_" + w); n.add("OVER_" + w); }
        names = n.toArray(new String[0]); nPat = names.length;
    }
    public int stateWidth() { return 3; }

    static boolean sel(int kind, int n) { return kind == 0 ? n >= 5 : kind == 1 ? n < 5 : kind == 2 ? n % 2 == 0 : n % 2 == 1; }

    private void masks() {
        active = new boolean[nPat][10][10];
        for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++) {
            float[][] a = atoms.atom(i);
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { active[2 * i][p][n] = a[p][n] >= THR; active[2 * i + 1][p][n] = a[p][n] <= -THR; }
        }
        int j = 2 * nAtoms;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) for (int r : RUNS) { for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) if (runLen[k][p] >= r) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) active[j][p][n] = sel(k, n); j++; }
        for (int wi = 0; wi < WINDOWS.length; wi++) {
            int W = WINDOWS[wi];
            if (t >= W) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
                double z = (win[wi][p][n] - W / 10.0) / Math.sqrt(W * 0.09);
                active[j][p][n] = z <= -2; active[j + 1][p][n] = z >= 2;
            }
            j += 2;
        }
    }

    public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
        if (active == null) masks();
        Arrays.fill(zraw, 0.0);
        for (int v = 0; v < verPat.size(); v++) {
            int j = verPat.get(v)[0], sc = verPat.get(v)[1]; double lg = verLog.get(v);
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { if (sc > 0 && p != sc - 1) continue; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) if (active[j][p][n]) zraw[p * 10 + n] += lg; }
        }
        double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; int posAct = 0;
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { boolean any = false; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { mx = Math.max(mx, zraw[p * 10 + n]); any |= zraw[p * 10 + n] != 0; } if (any) posAct++; }
        double[] e = new double[10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) m = Math.max(m, zraw[p * 10 + n]);
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) e[n] = Math.exp(zraw[p * 10 + n] - m);
            double s = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(e, 0, 10);
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[p][n] = (float) (e[n] / s);
        }
        st[0] = (float) (verPat.size() / 100.0); st[1] = (float) mx; st[2] = (float) (posAct / 10.0);
    }

    public void update(int[] d) {
        OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraw(d);
        if (active == null) masks();
        int bi = (int) (t / BLOCK);
        while (blockBase + blkN.size() <= bi) { blkN.add(new double[nPat * 11]); blkK.add(new double[nPat * 11]); }
        double[] bn = blkN.get(bi - blockBase), bk = blkK.get(bi - blockBase);
        for (int j = 0; j < nPat; j++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) if (active[j][p][n]) {
            boolean h = d[p] - 1 == n;
            bn[j * 11] += 1; bn[j * 11 + p + 1] += 1;
            if (h) { bk[j * 11] += 1; bk[j * 11 + p + 1] += 1; }
        }
        // direction state
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            int x = d[p] - 1;
            boolean[] ind = {x >= 5, x < 5, x % 2 == 0, x % 2 == 1};
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) runLen[k][p] = ind[k] ? runLen[k][p] + 1 : 0;
        }
        int R = ring.length;
        for (int wi = 0; wi < WINDOWS.length; wi++) {
            int W = WINDOWS[wi];
            if (t >= W) { int[] old = ring[(int) ((t - W) % R)]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) win[wi][p][old[p] - 1]--; }
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) win[wi][p][d[p] - 1]++;
        }
        System.arraycopy(d, 0, ring[(int) (t % R)], 0, 10);
        atoms.update(d);
        t++;
        while (blockBase < (int) (t / BLOCK) - MAX_BLOCKS - 1) { blkN.remove(0); blkK.remove(0); blockBase++; }   // keep the window + the open block
        if (t >= START + BLOCK && t % BLOCK == 0) refit();
        active = null;
    }

    private void refit() {
        int end = (int) (t / BLOCK), first = Math.max(START / BLOCK, end - MAX_BLOCKS), nbk = end - first, h1 = first + nbk / 2;
        verPat.clear(); verLog.clear(); verRate.clear(); verCells.clear();
        for (int j = 0; j < nPat; j++) for (int sc = 0; sc < 11; sc++) {
            double n1 = 0, k1 = 0, n2 = 0, k2 = 0;
            for (int b = first; b < h1; b++) { n1 += blkN.get(b - blockBase)[j * 11 + sc]; k1 += blkK.get(b - blockBase)[j * 11 + sc]; }
            for (int b = h1; b < end; b++) { n2 += blkN.get(b - blockBase)[j * 11 + sc]; k2 += blkK.get(b - blockBase)[j * 11 + sc]; }
            if (n1 < MIN_N || n2 < MIN_N) continue;
            double z1 = (k1 / n1 - 0.1) / Math.sqrt(0.09 / n1), z2 = (k2 / n2 - 0.1) / Math.sqrt(0.09 / n2), zt = sc == 0 ? Z_ALL : Z_POS;
            if (z1 * z2 > 0 && Math.abs(z1) >= zt && Math.abs(z2) >= zt) {
                double r = (k1 + k2) / (n1 + n2);
                verPat.add(new int[]{j, sc}); verLog.add(Math.log(Math.max(r, 1e-3) / 0.1)); verRate.add(r); verCells.add((long) (n1 + n2));
            }
        }
    }

    /** The current continuation / reversal report: pattern, scope (0 = all positions, p = position p), rate, cells. */
    public List<String> verified() {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int v = 0; v < verPat.size(); v++)
            out.add(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%s|%s|%.4f|%d", names[verPat.get(v)[0]], verPat.get(v)[1] == 0 ? "all" : "pos" + verPat.get(v)[1], verRate.get(v), verCells.get(v)));
        return out;
    }

    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
        o.writeLong(t); atoms.write(o);
        for (int[] r : runLen) for (int v : r) o.writeInt(v);
        for (int[] r : ring) for (int v : r) o.writeByte(v);
        for (int[][] w : win) for (int[] r : w) for (int v : r) o.writeInt(v);
        o.writeInt(blockBase); o.writeInt(blkN.size());
        for (int b = 0; b < blkN.size(); b++) { for (double v : blkN.get(b)) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : blkK.get(b)) o.writeDouble(v); }
        o.writeInt(verPat.size());
        for (int v = 0; v < verPat.size(); v++) { o.writeInt(verPat.get(v)[0]); o.writeInt(verPat.get(v)[1]); o.writeDouble(verLog.get(v)); o.writeDouble(verRate.get(v)); o.writeLong(verCells.get(v)); }
    }
    public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        t = in.readLong(); atoms.read(in);
        for (int[] r : runLen) for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) r[i] = in.readInt();
        for (int[] r : ring) for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) r[i] = in.readByte();
        for (int[][] w : win) for (int[] r : w) for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) r[i] = in.readInt();
        blockBase = in.readInt(); int nb = in.readInt(); blkN.clear(); blkK.clear();
        for (int b = 0; b < nb; b++) { double[] a = new double[nPat * 11], c = new double[nPat * 11]; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < c.length; i++) c[i] = in.readDouble(); blkN.add(a); blkK.add(c); }
        int nv = in.readInt(); verPat.clear(); verLog.clear(); verRate.clear(); verCells.clear();
        for (int v = 0; v < nv; v++) { verPat.add(new int[]{in.readInt(), in.readInt()}); verLog.add(in.readDouble()); verRate.add(in.readDouble()); verCells.add(in.readLong()); }
        active = null;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

/** SplitMix64 normals shared bit-for-bit with models.splitmix64_normals (Python reference). */
public final class DeterministicRandomSU2 {
    private DeterministicRandomSU2() {}
    private static final long GOLDEN = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;

    public static double[] normals(long seed, int n) {
        if (n < 0 || n > 1_000_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_RANDOM_COUNT");
        long[] x = {seed * GOLDEN + 0x632BE59BD9B4E019L};
        double[] out = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double u1 = 1.0 - next(x), u2 = next(x);
            out[i] = Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(u1)) * Math.cos(2.0 * Math.PI * u2);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static double next(long[] x) {
        x[0] += GOLDEN;
        long z = x[0];
        z = (z ^ (z >>> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9L;
        z = (z ^ (z >>> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBL;
        z = z ^ (z >>> 31);
        return (z >>> 11) * (1.0 / (1L << 53));
    }
}
```
