```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * P50 on the phone: keeps the information probes running, folds every strategy's settled decisions into bounded
 * sufficient statistics, writes one upgrade diagnosis per 500 settled periods, turns genome-level prescriptions into
 * live shadow challengers and settles them, and applies the retention rules - all from the existing burst job, never in
 * the pre-draw or settlement path. The report export reads the latest diagnosis read-only (report()).
 *
 * Bounded by construction (P50 retention table, docs/18):
 *   su2_track_block      per member: the latest 40 closed 500-period blocks + one lifetime row (exact totals)
 *   su2_diag_state       one ledger text <= 256 KB (<= 256 issues, <= 512 generation-curve points)
 *   su2_diag_snapshot    the latest 8 snapshots, each <= 16 KB
 *   su2_diag_shadow      at most MAX_SHADOWS active shadow challengers
 *   su2_live_state       owner 'PROBE' (~10 MB raw, fixed); stale owners removed
 *   su2_live_daily       90 days; su2_mainline_binding 10,080 targets; su2_mainline_choice: every switch + latest 2,000;
 *   su2_certificate      30 days after expiry
 */
public final class DiagnosisStoreSU2 {
    private DiagnosisStoreSU2() {}
    public static final int BLOCK = 500, KEEP_BLOCKS = 40, MAX_SHADOWS = 4, DAILY_DAYS = 90, BINDINGS = 10080, CHOICES = 2000;
    public static final long PROBE_SLICE_NANOS = 2_000_000_000L, CERT_KEEP_MS = 30L * 86400000L;
    static final String PROBE_OWNER = "PROBE";             // literal 'PROBE' in the retention SQL

    /** Called from the burst job after retention. Never throws into the scheduler. */
    public static String maintain(DbStore store, String target) {
        try {
            SQLiteDatabase r = store.readable();
            if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(r)) return "SU2_DIAG_SCHEMA_PENDING";
            EventFrameSU1 frame = EventFrameBuilderSU1.capture(store, target);
            final int[][] h = frame.history();
            final long first = TargetIssueResolver.sequenceOrdinalSU1(String.valueOf(frame.issue(0)));
            final long seq = first + h.length;                                   // next target; everything below is settled
            // 1. information probes: continue from the checkpoint, at most PROBE_SLICE_NANOS per call
            long[] through = new long[1]; byte[] blob = ModelStoreSU2.liveBlob(r, PROBE_OWNER, through);
            InformationProbeSU2 bank = new InformationProbeSU2(); long done = first - 1;
            if (blob != null && through[0] >= first - 1 && through[0] < seq) {
                try { bank.read(new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(ModelStoreSU2.gunzip(blob)))); done = through[0]; }
                catch (IOException | RuntimeException unusable) { bank = new InformationProbeSU2(); done = first - 1; }
            }
            long started = System.nanoTime();
            while (done < seq - 1 && System.nanoTime() - started < PROBE_SLICE_NANOS) { done++; bank.step(h[(int) (done - first)]); }
            final InformationProbeSU2 fb = bank; final long fdone = done; final long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            ByteArrayOutputStream bo = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); DataOutputStream o = new DataOutputStream(bo); fb.write(o); o.flush();
            final byte[] probeBlob = ModelStoreSU2.gzip(bo.toByteArray());
            final ModelEvolutionSU2.State evo = ModelStoreSU2.loadEvolution(r);
            return store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_DIAGNOSIS", db -> {
                ModelStoreSU2.saveLive(db, PROBE_OWNER, fdone, probeBlob, now);
                foldTrackBlocks(db, seq);
                settleShadows(db);
                retention(db, seq, now);
                if (fdone < seq - 1) return "SU2_DIAG_PROBES_CATCHING_UP:" + fdone;
                long last = diagnosedSequence(db);
                if (last >= 0 && seq / BLOCK == last / BLOCK) return "SU2_DIAG_UP_TO_DATE";
                String snap = snapshot(db, seq, fb, evo);
                UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Snapshot S = UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.parse(snap);
                UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Diagnosis D = UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.diagnose(S);
                UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger L = loadLedger(db);
                L.update(D.findings, seq);
                openShadows(db, D, L, seq);
                saveLedger(db, L, seq, now);
                saveSnapshot(db, seq, snap, now);
                return "SU2_DIAG_DONE:" + D.verdict + ":" + D.findings.size();
            });
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
            return "SU2_DIAG_FAILED:" + failure.getClass().getSimpleName() + ":" + failure.getMessage();
        }
    }

    /** The report export (read-only snapshot connection): {UPGRADE_DIAGNOSIS.md, UPGRADE_DIAGNOSIS.json}. */
    public static String[] report(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        try {
            String snap = null;
            try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT snapshot FROM su2_diag_snapshot ORDER BY report_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", null)) { if (c.moveToFirst()) snap = c.getString(0); }
            if (snap == null) return new String[]{"# 升级诊断书\n\n尚无诊断：信息探针需要至少 2,000 期已结算开奖，之后每 500 期生成一次。\n", "{\"version\":\"" + UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.VERSION + "\",\"verdict\":null}\n"};
            UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Diagnosis D = UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.diagnose(UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.parse(snap));
            UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger L = loadLedger(db);
            return new String[]{UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.render(D, L), UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.toJson(D, L)};
        } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
            return new String[]{"# 升级诊断书\n\n诊断读取失败：" + failure.getClass().getSimpleName() + "\n", "{\"error\":true}\n"};
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ sufficient statistics
    static void foldTrackBlocks(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq) {
        long hi = (seq / BLOCK) * BLOCK, lo = Math.max(0, hi - (long) (KEEP_BLOCKS + 1) * BLOCK);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_track_block(member_id,block_index,periods,actions,hits,phat_sum,phat_n) "
            + "SELECT genome_key,sequence_ordinal/500,count(*),sum(act),sum(CASE WHEN act=1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN act=1 AND phat IS NOT NULL THEN phat END),0),"
            + "sum(CASE WHEN act=1 AND phat IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM su2_live_decision WHERE hit IS NOT NULL AND sequence_ordinal>=? AND sequence_ordinal<? "
            + "GROUP BY genome_key,sequence_ordinal/500", new Object[]{lo, hi});
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_track_block(member_id,block_index,periods,actions,hits,phat_sum,phat_n) "
            + "SELECT 'MAINLINE',d.sequence_ordinal/500,count(*),sum(d.act),sum(CASE WHEN d.act=1 THEN d.hit ELSE 0 END),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN d.act=1 AND d.phat IS NOT NULL THEN d.phat END),0),"
            + "sum(CASE WHEN d.act=1 AND d.phat IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM su2_live_decision d JOIN su2_league l ON l.genome_key=d.genome_key "
            + "WHERE d.hit IS NOT NULL AND d.sequence_ordinal>=? AND d.sequence_ordinal<? AND l.member_id=(SELECT c.member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice c WHERE c.from_sequence<=d.sequence_ordinal ORDER BY c.from_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) "
            + "GROUP BY d.sequence_ordinal/500", new Object[]{lo, hi});
        long cut = seq / BLOCK - KEEP_BLOCKS;              // blocks below cut leave into the lifetime row (exact totals)
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_track_block(member_id,block_index,periods,actions,hits,phat_sum,phat_n) "
            + "SELECT DISTINCT member_id,-1,0,0,0,0,0 FROM su2_track_block WHERE block_index>=0 AND block_index<?", new Object[]{cut});
        db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_track_block SET "
            + "periods=periods+(SELECT coalesce(sum(b.periods),0) FROM su2_track_block b WHERE b.member_id=su2_track_block.member_id AND b.block_index>=0 AND b.block_index<?),"
            + "actions=actions+(SELECT coalesce(sum(b.actions),0) FROM su2_track_block b WHERE b.member_id=su2_track_block.member_id AND b.block_index>=0 AND b.block_index<?),"
            + "hits=hits+(SELECT coalesce(sum(b.hits),0) FROM su2_track_block b WHERE b.member_id=su2_track_block.member_id AND b.block_index>=0 AND b.block_index<?),"
            + "phat_sum=phat_sum+(SELECT coalesce(sum(b.phat_sum),0) FROM su2_track_block b WHERE b.member_id=su2_track_block.member_id AND b.block_index>=0 AND b.block_index<?),"
            + "phat_n=phat_n+(SELECT coalesce(sum(b.phat_n),0) FROM su2_track_block b WHERE b.member_id=su2_track_block.member_id AND b.block_index>=0 AND b.block_index<?) "
            + "WHERE block_index=-1", new Object[]{cut, cut, cut, cut, cut});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_track_block WHERE block_index>=0 AND block_index<?", new Object[]{cut});
        // statistics of genomes that no longer exist at all (pruned research genomes) leave with them
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_track_block WHERE member_id<>'MAINLINE' AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT genome_key FROM su2_model_genome)");
    }

    /** P50 retention for the per-period tables and live states (each statement bounded, short transaction). */
    static void retention(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq, long now) {
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_live_daily WHERE day_key<?", new Object[]{seq / 1440 - DAILY_DAYS});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_mainline_binding WHERE target_issue<(SELECT max(target_issue) FROM su2_mainline_binding)-?", new Object[]{BINDINGS});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_mainline_choice WHERE from_sequence<(SELECT min(from_sequence) FROM (SELECT from_sequence FROM su2_mainline_choice ORDER BY from_sequence DESC LIMIT ?)) "
            + "AND member_id=(SELECT p.member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice p WHERE p.from_sequence<su2_mainline_choice.from_sequence ORDER BY p.from_sequence DESC LIMIT 1)", new Object[]{CHOICES});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_certificate WHERE expires_at<?", new Object[]{now - CERT_KEEP_MS});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_live_state WHERE owner NOT IN ('HUB','PROBE') AND substr(owner,1,4)<>'CAL:' "
            + "AND owner NOT IN (SELECT genome_key FROM su2_model_genome WHERE state IN ('LEAGUE','HALL_OF_FAME'))");
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_live_state WHERE substr(owner,1,4)='CAL:' AND through_sequence<(SELECT through_sequence FROM su2_live_state WHERE owner='HUB')");
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_diag_snapshot WHERE report_sequence NOT IN (SELECT report_sequence FROM su2_diag_snapshot ORDER BY report_sequence DESC LIMIT ?)", new Object[]{UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.SNAP_KEEP});
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ snapshot from the database
    static String snapshot(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq, InformationProbeSU2 probes, ModelEvolutionSU2.State evo) {
        StringBuilder o = new StringBuilder("SU2DIAG\t1\ndataset\tLIVE\nseq\t").append(seq).append('\n');
        track(db, o, "MAINLINE", "MAINLINE");
        track(db, o, "XI", IncumbentLoopSU2.KEY);
        Map<String, String> champs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String tier : new String[]{"F15", "F30", "F100"}) {
            try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT g.genome_key,g.formula FROM su2_model_genome g JOIN su2_league l ON l.genome_key=g.genome_key WHERE g.state='LEAGUE' AND g.tier=? "
                + "AND g.origin_op<>'INCUMBENT' AND l.state='ACTIVE' AND l.name NOT LIKE '影子%' ORDER BY l.joined_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", new String[]{tier})) {
                if (c.moveToFirst()) { champs.put(tier, c.getString(0)); track(db, o, tier, c.getString(0)); o.append("formula\t").append(tier).append('\t').append(clean(c.getString(1), 240)).append('\n'); }
            }
        }
        xiShare(db, o, seq);
        if (probes != null) {
            o.append(probes.snapshotLines());
            int refits = (int) Math.max(0, seq / BLOCK - (InformationProbeSU2.START + BLOCK) / BLOCK + 1);
            o.append(probes.contmatLine(refits, previousContmatMax(db)));
        }
        generations(db, o, seq);
        if (evo != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, double[]> e : evo.opStats.entrySet()) if (e.getValue()[0] > 0) o.append("op\t").append(e.getKey()).append('\t').append(e.getValue()[1] / e.getValue()[0]).append('\n');
            for (Map.Entry<String, double[]> e : evo.kindStats.entrySet()) if (e.getValue()[0] > 0) o.append("fam\t").append(e.getKey()).append('\t').append(e.getValue()[1] / e.getValue()[0]).append('\n');
            int n = 0, k = 0;
            for (String note : evo.repairNotes) {
                int a = note.indexOf("|parentDev="), b = note.indexOf("|childDev=");
                if (a < 0 || b < 0) continue;
                n++; if (Double.parseDouble(note.substring(b + 10)) > Double.parseDouble(note.substring(a + 11, b))) k++;
            }
            if (n > 0) o.append("repair\t").append(n).append('\t').append(k).append('\n');
        }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT category,measured_bytes,cap_bytes FROM su2_storage_budget WHERE measured_at>0 ORDER BY category", null)) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) o.append("storage\t").append(c.getString(0)).append('\t').append(c.getLong(1)).append('\t').append(c.getLong(2)).append('\n');
        }
        String s = o.toString();
        byte[] b = s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (b.length > UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.SNAP_MAX_BYTES) { int nl = UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.lastNewline(b, UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.SNAP_MAX_BYTES); s = new String(b, 0, nl + 1, StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }
        return s;
    }

    static String clean(String s, int n) { s = s.replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' '); return s.length() > n ? s.substring(0, n) : s; }

    static void track(SQLiteDatabase db, StringBuilder o, String name, String member) {
        long periods = 0; StringBuilder bl = new StringBuilder();
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT periods,actions,hits FROM (SELECT block_index,periods,actions,hits FROM su2_track_block WHERE member_id=? AND block_index>=0 ORDER BY block_index DESC LIMIT "
            + KEEP_BLOCKS + ") ORDER BY block_index", new String[]{member})) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) { periods += c.getLong(0); if (bl.length() > 0) bl.append(','); bl.append(c.getLong(1)).append(':').append(c.getLong(2)); }
        }
        if (periods > 0) o.append("track\t").append(name).append('\t').append(periods).append('\t').append(bl).append('\n');
    }

    /** Share of the window's periods on XI, and the one-sided test "mainline worse than XI" (normal approximation). */
    static void xiShare(SQLiteDatabase db, StringBuilder o, long seq) {
        long from = Math.max(0, (seq / BLOCK - KEEP_BLOCKS) * BLOCK), onXi = 0, total = 0, cur = from; String member = null;
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice WHERE from_sequence<=? ORDER BY from_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", new String[]{String.valueOf(from)})) { if (c.moveToFirst()) member = c.getString(0); }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT from_sequence,member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice WHERE from_sequence>? AND from_sequence<? ORDER BY from_sequence", new String[]{String.valueOf(from), String.valueOf(seq)})) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) { long s = c.getLong(0); if (member != null) { total += s - cur; if (member.equals(IncumbentLoopSU2.MEMBER)) onXi += s - cur; } cur = s; member = c.getString(1); }
        }
        if (member != null) { total += seq - cur; if (member.equals(IncumbentLoopSU2.MEMBER)) onXi += seq - cur; }
        long[] m = totals(db, "MAINLINE"), x = totals(db, IncumbentLoopSU2.KEY);
        if (total <= 0 || m[0] == 0 || x[0] == 0) return;
        double rm = (double) m[1] / m[0], rx = (double) x[1] / x[0], p = (double) (m[1] + x[1]) / (m[0] + x[0]);
        double se = Math.sqrt(Math.max(1e-12, p * (1 - p) * (1.0 / m[0] + 1.0 / x[0])));
        o.append("xishare\t").append(onXi).append('\t').append(total).append('\t').append(phi((rm - rx) / se)).append('\n');
    }

    static long[] totals(SQLiteDatabase db, String member) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT coalesce(sum(actions),0),coalesce(sum(hits),0) FROM su2_track_block WHERE member_id=? AND block_index>=0", new String[]{member})) {
            return c.moveToFirst() ? new long[]{c.getLong(0), c.getLong(1)} : new long[]{0, 0};
        }
    }

    /** Standard normal CDF (Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26, |error| < 1.5e-7). */
    static double phi(double z) {
        double x = Math.abs(z) / Math.sqrt(2), t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x);
        double erf = 1 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * Math.exp(-x * x);
        return z >= 0 ? 0.5 * (1 + erf) : 0.5 * (1 - erf);
    }

    /** "一代比一代强": each new tier champion against the one it replaced, on the same live periods since it joined. */
    static void generations(SQLiteDatabase db, StringBuilder o, long seq) {
        for (String tier : new String[]{"F15", "F30"}) {
            List<long[]> js = new ArrayList<>(); List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
            try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT l.genome_key,l.joined_sequence FROM su2_league l JOIN su2_model_genome g ON g.genome_key=l.genome_key WHERE g.tier=? "
                + "AND g.origin_op<>'INCUMBENT' AND l.name NOT LIKE '影子%' ORDER BY l.joined_sequence", new String[]{tier})) {
                while (c.moveToNext()) { keys.add(c.getString(0)); js.add(new long[]{c.getLong(1)}); }
            }
            for (int i = Math.max(1, keys.size() - 6); i < keys.size(); i++) {
                long a = js.get(i)[0], b = i + 1 < keys.size() ? js.get(i + 1)[0] : seq;
                if (b - a < 100) continue;
                long[] old = rec(db, keys.get(i - 1), a, b), nu = rec(db, keys.get(i), a, b);
                o.append("gen\t").append(a).append('\t').append(tier).append('\t').append(old[0] > 0 ? String.valueOf((double) old[1] / old[0]) : "-").append('\t').append(old[0])
                 .append('\t').append(nu[0] > 0 ? String.valueOf((double) nu[1] / nu[0]) : "-").append('\t').append(nu[0]).append('\t').append(ModelFoundryJobSU2.GENERATIONS - 1).append('\n');
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] rec(SQLiteDatabase db, String genome, long a, long b) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT coalesce(sum(act),0),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN act=1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END),0) FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal>=? AND sequence_ordinal<? AND hit IS NOT NULL",
            new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(a), String.valueOf(b)})) { return c.moveToFirst() ? new long[]{c.getLong(0), c.getLong(1)} : new long[]{0, 0}; }
    }

    static int previousContmatMax(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT snapshot FROM su2_diag_snapshot ORDER BY report_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", null)) {
            if (!c.moveToFirst()) return 0;
            for (String l : c.getString(0).split("\n")) if (l.startsWith("contmat\t")) return Integer.parseInt(l.split("\t", -1)[3]);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ledger, snapshots, shadows
    static long diagnosedSequence(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT diagnosed_sequence FROM su2_diag_state WHERE singleton=1", null)) { return c.moveToFirst() ? c.getLong(0) : -1; }
    }
    static UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger loadLedger(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        String text = "";
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT ledger_text FROM su2_diag_state WHERE singleton=1", null)) { if (c.moveToFirst()) text = c.getString(0); }
        List<Object[]> snaps = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT report_sequence,snapshot FROM su2_diag_snapshot ORDER BY report_sequence", null)) { while (c.moveToNext()) snaps.add(new Object[]{c.getLong(0), c.getString(1)}); }
        return UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger.fromText(text, snaps);
    }
    static void saveLedger(SQLiteDatabase db, UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger L, long seq, long now) {
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO su2_diag_state(singleton,ledger_text,diagnosed_sequence,updated_at) VALUES(1,?,?,?)", new Object[]{L.text(), seq, now});
    }
    static void saveSnapshot(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq, String snap, long now) {
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO su2_diag_snapshot(report_sequence,snapshot,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?)", new Object[]{seq, snap, now});
        db.execSQL("DELETE FROM su2_diag_snapshot WHERE report_sequence NOT IN (SELECT report_sequence FROM su2_diag_snapshot ORDER BY report_sequence DESC LIMIT ?)", new Object[]{UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.SNAP_KEEP});
    }

    /** New genome-level prescriptions become shadow challengers (frozen, settled live like any league member). */
    static void openShadows(SQLiteDatabase db, UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Diagnosis D, UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger L, long seq) {
        int active;
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT count(*) FROM su2_diag_shadow WHERE state='ACTIVE'", null)) { active = c.moveToFirst() ? c.getInt(0) : 0; }
        for (UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Finding f : D.findings) {
            if (active >= MAX_SHADOWS) break;
            UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Entry e = L.entries.get(f.code + "|" + f.scope);
            if (e == null || e.since != seq || !"PENDING".equals(e.outcome)) continue;
            String tier = f.presc.startsWith("TIER_COVERAGE") ? f.presc.split(" ")[1] : "F15";
            String baseKey = null, baseText = null;
            try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT g.genome_key,g.canonical_text FROM su2_model_genome g JOIN su2_league l ON l.genome_key=g.genome_key WHERE g.state='LEAGUE' AND g.tier=? "
                + "AND l.state='ACTIVE' AND l.name NOT LIKE '影子%' ORDER BY l.joined_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", new String[]{tier})) { if (c.moveToFirst()) { baseKey = c.getString(0); baseText = c.getString(1); } }
            String shadow = UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.shadowText(f.presc, baseText);
            if (shadow == null) continue;
            CommitteeSU2 sc = CommitteeSU2.parse(shadow);
            ModelStoreSU2.saveCommittee(db, sc, tier, "SHADOW", seq, -9, System.currentTimeMillis());
            ModelStoreSU2.joinLeague(db, "SU2:" + sc.key(), "SU2", "影子·" + f.code + (f.scope.isEmpty() ? "" : "·" + f.scope), sc.key(), seq);
            db.execSQL("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO su2_diag_shadow(issue_key,shadow_key,base_key,since_sequence,state) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'ACTIVE')", new Object[]{e.key(), sc.key(), baseKey, seq});
            active++;
        }
    }

    /** Shadow vs its base on the same settled periods; a harmful shadow is retired, an effective one stays for IPM. */
    static void settleShadows(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        List<String[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT issue_key,shadow_key,base_key,since_sequence FROM su2_diag_shadow WHERE state='ACTIVE'", null)) { while (c.moveToNext()) rows.add(new String[]{c.getString(0), c.getString(1), c.getString(2), String.valueOf(c.getLong(3))}); }
        if (rows.isEmpty()) return;
        UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Ledger L = loadLedger(db); long seq = diagnosedSequence(db);
        for (String[] r : rows) {
            long since = Long.parseLong(r[3]);
            long[] s = rec(db, r[1], since, Long.MAX_VALUE), b = rec(db, r[2], since, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.Entry e = L.entries.get(r[0]); if (e == null) continue;
            e.sacts = 0; e.shits = 0; e.bacts = 0; e.bhits = 0; L.shadow(r[0], s[0], s[1], b[0], b[1]);
            if (e.outcome.equals("HARMFUL") || e.outcome.equals("NO_EFFECT")) {     // judged: free the live slot (EFFECTIVE stays for IPM)
                db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_diag_shadow SET state='RETIRED' WHERE issue_key=?", new Object[]{r[0]});
                db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_league SET state='RETIRED' WHERE genome_key=?", new Object[]{r[1]});
                db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_model_genome SET state='RETIRED' WHERE genome_key=?", new Object[]{r[1]});
            }
        }
        saveLedger(db, L, seq, System.currentTimeMillis());
    }
}
```

项目 P03 · 52 行 · sha256 `3cd47c10748e627aed8473bfaabe48fb0c0f527d0217a8cab90db08dd8d51906`

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;

/**
 * The user's original cross-intersection method runs every period as the league's
 * protected INCUMBENT (P03). Its decision for the next target is computed in the quiet
 * time right after settlement (the burst job), frozen like every other decision, and
 * settled by ModelStoreSU2.settle. A decision not ready before the cutoff is MISSING and
 * counts against the incumbent exactly as it would against a challenger.
 */
public final class IncumbentLoopSU2 {
    private IncumbentLoopSU2() {}
    public static final String KEY = XiIncumbentSU2.GENOME_KEY, MEMBER = "XI_INCUMBENT:" + KEY;
    /** Pooled table of the frozen decision for the pending target (ranks the other 1,199 actions in the certified lane). */
    private static volatile long pendingSeq = -1; private static volatile float[][] pendingTable;
    public static float[][] pendingTable(long seq) { float[][] t = pendingTable; return pendingSeq == seq && t != null ? t : null; }
    private static final java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService WORKER = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(r -> { Thread t = new Thread(r, "su2-incumbent"); t.setDaemon(true); t.setPriority(Thread.MIN_PRIORITY); return t; });

    /** Called right after settlement of `settledIssue`: the next target's decision is computed off the settlement thread. */
    public static void scheduleAfterSettlement(DbStore store, String settledIssue) {
        if (!TargetIssueResolver.isValid(settledIssue)) return;
        final String target = TargetIssueResolver.next(settledIssue).targetIssue;
        final long seq = TargetIssueResolver.sequenceOrdinalSU1(target);
        WORKER.execute(() -> { try { freezeNext(store, target, seq); } catch (RuntimeException failure) { StrategyRuntimeSU1.failure(store, "SU2_INCUMBENT_FAILED", failure); } });
    }

    public static void seed(DbStore store, long seq) {
        store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_INCUMBENT_SEED", db -> {
            // the incumbent is certified, chosen and bound exactly like any league member: one genome row for its program
            db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_model_genome(genome_key,canonical_text,formula,tier,origin_op,parent_key,repair_note,born_campaign,born_sequence,dev_fitness,val_fitness,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                new Object[]{KEY, XiIncumbentSU2.CANONICAL, "XI = 用户原方法：8 专家 Top6/7/8/9 交叉交集支持度 -> 岭回归 Logistic 适用门 -> 25% 基池 -> 15% 出手", "F15", "INCUMBENT", null, "", "INCUMBENT", seq, null, null, "LEAGUE", System.currentTimeMillis()});
            ModelStoreSU2.joinLeague(db, MEMBER, "XI_INCUMBENT", "用户原方法·多位置多号码交叉交集", KEY, seq); return 0; });
    }

    /** Freeze the incumbent's decision for `target` (sequence seq) if not yet frozen. */
    public static String freezeNext(DbStore store, String target, long seq) {
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(store.readable())) return "SU2_SCHEMA_PENDING";
        try (Cursor c = store.readable().rawQuery("SELECT 1 FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal=?", new String[]{KEY, String.valueOf(seq)})) { if (c.moveToFirst()) return "ALREADY_FROZEN"; }
        EventFrameSU1 frame = EventFrameBuilderSU1.capture(store, target);
        XiIncumbentSU2.Decision x = XiIncumbentSU2.decideNextFull(frame.history());
        if (x == null) return "INCUMBENT_HISTORY_SHORT";
        final ModelLiveSU2.Decision d = new ModelLiveSU2.Decision(seq, x.position, x.mask(), x.act, Double.NaN, x.phat);   // phat feeds post-selection calibration
        pendingTable = x.table; pendingSeq = seq;
        final long open = frame.targetOpenTime;
        return store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_INCUMBENT_FREEZE", db -> {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis(); if (now >= open) return "MISSING_AFTER_OPEN";
            ModelStoreSU2.insertDecision(db, KEY, seq, d, now, open); return d.act ? "FROZEN_ACT" : "FROZEN_ABSTAIN";
        });
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * P50 information probes (diagnosis_probe.py): nine representative online models, one per mathematical family, run
 * every period exactly like a live strategy - model -> online temperature calibration (CalibrationSU2.Live) -> best
 * position's top-3 -> causal confidence gate at 15% and 30% (quantile of the last 720 confidences, refreshed every 50
 * periods, INFORMATIVE guard: a uniform table never acts). They answer the diagnosis' first question - is there anything
 * in the draws a family can use, and which family - independently of what evolution happened to choose.
 *
 * Bounded by construction: per probe only the sufficient statistics of the last 40 closed 500-period blocks
 * (n, sum and sum of squares of the log-likelihood gain over uniform, acts / hits / predicted hits at both gates, the
 * REGMEM "no structure" posterior) plus lifetime totals; RAM = the models + one 2,500-period calibration ring each.
 * Java == Python on the real report data (InformationProbeSU2Test, fixture r16_probe).
 */
public final class InformationProbeSU2 {
    public static final int START = 1500, BLOCK = 500, STEP = 50, PAST = 720, MIN_HISTORY = 100, KEEP_BLOCKS = 40;
    static final double INFORMATIVE = ModelReplaySU2.INFORMATIVE;
    /** family -> parameters (every parameter explicit; identical to diagnosis_probe.PROBES). */
    public static final String[][] PROBES = {
        {"MSDIR", "alpha=1.0,scales=(0.9, 0.97, 0.99, 0.997, 1.0),share=0.01"},
        {"BOCPD", "R=160,alpha=0.5,hazard=0.005"},
        {"HMM", "K=3,lr=0.01,seed=1,stay=0.995,temper=0.6"},
        {"LOGLIN", "l2=0.0001,lr=0.05,sources=((0, 1), (1, 1), (5, 1))"},
        {"RELBAYES", "decay=0.995,kappa=100.0,lags=(1,)"},
        {"KALMAN", "horizon=1.0,q_level=2e-05,q_slope=2e-08,temp=12.0"},
        {"REGMEM", "K=3,lr=0.01,seed=1,stay=0.995,temper=0.6"},
        {"RELMEM", "K=1,l2=0.0001,lags=(1,),lr=0.02,seed=1,sources=(),stay=0.995,temper=0.6"},
        {"CONTMAT", ""},
    };

    static Map<String, String> params(String s) {
        Map<String, String> m = new TreeMap<>();
        if (!s.isEmpty()) for (String kv : ModelGenomeSU2.splitTop(s)) { int eq = kv.indexOf('='); m.put(kv.substring(0, eq), kv.substring(eq + 1)); }
        return m;
    }

    /** One probe: model, calibrator, gate state, the open block's buffers and the closed blocks. */
    public static final class Probe {
        public final String family, params; final OnlineModelsSU2.Model model; final CalibrationSU2.Live cal = new CalibrationSU2.Live();
        final float[][] raw = new float[10][10]; final float[] st;
        final double[] ring = new double[PAST]; int ringN; double thr15 = Double.NaN, thr30 = Double.NaN;
        // open block
        int openIndex = -1; final double[] bLlr = new double[BLOCK], bSt0 = new double[BLOCK], bP15 = new double[BLOCK], bP30 = new double[BLOCK];
        int bn, ba15, bh15, ba30, bh30;
        /** closed blocks: {index, n, llr, llr2, a15, h15, p15, a30, h30, p30, st0 (NaN = none)}; lifetime totals likewise. */
        public final ArrayDeque<double[]> blocks = new ArrayDeque<>(); public final double[] lifetime = new double[11];
        Probe(String family, String params) {
            this.family = family; this.params = params;
            this.model = ModelReplaySU2.build(family, InformationProbeSU2.params(params));
            this.st = new float[model.stateWidth()];
        }
    }

    public final List<Probe> probes = new ArrayList<>();
    long t;

    public InformationProbeSU2() { for (String[] p : PROBES) probes.add(new Probe(p[0], p[1])); }

    /** One settled period: every probe decides for period t (draws < t only), is scored on `draw`, then learns it. */
    public void step(int[] draw) {
        OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraw(draw);
        for (Probe p : probes) stepProbe(p, draw);
        t++;
    }

    private void stepProbe(Probe p, int[] draw) {
        p.model.predict(p.raw, p.st);
        float[][] pc = p.cal.predict(p.raw);
        // picks: top-3 per position by (value desc, number asc), best position by mass (first maximum)
        int p1 = 0; double best = -1; int[] top = new int[3]; int[] bestTop = new int[3];
        for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) {
            top3(pc[q], top);
            double m = 0; m += pc[q][top[0]]; m += pc[q][top[1]]; m += pc[q][top[2]];
            if (m > best) { best = m; p1 = q; System.arraycopy(top, 0, bestTop, 0, 3); }
        }
        double conf = best;
        if (t >= START && (t - START) % STEP == 0) {           // refresh the causal gate from the last 720 confidences
            if (p.ringN >= MIN_HISTORY) { p.thr15 = quantile(p, 1 - 0.15); p.thr30 = quantile(p, 1 - 0.30); }
            else { p.thr15 = Double.NaN; p.thr30 = Double.NaN; }
        }
        if (t >= START) {
            int bi = (int) (t / BLOCK);
            if (bi != p.openIndex) { closeBlock(p); p.openIndex = bi; }
            int x = draw[p1] - 1; boolean hit = bestTop[0] == x || bestTop[1] == x || bestTop[2] == x;
            double[] l = new double[10];
            for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) l[q] = Math.log(Math.min(1.0, Math.max(1e-9, (double) pc[q][draw[q] - 1])) / 0.1);
            p.bLlr[p.bn] = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(l, 0, 10);
            p.bSt0[p.bn] = p.family.equals("REGMEM") ? (double) p.st[0] : Double.NaN;
            boolean inf = conf > INFORMATIVE;
            if (inf && !Double.isNaN(p.thr15) && conf >= p.thr15) { p.bP15[p.ba15++] = conf; if (hit) p.bh15++; }
            if (inf && !Double.isNaN(p.thr30) && conf >= p.thr30) { p.bP30[p.ba30++] = conf; if (hit) p.bh30++; }
            p.bn++;
        }
        p.ring[p.ringN < PAST ? p.ringN : (int) (t % PAST)] = conf;          // ring holds the last 720 confidences
        if (p.ringN < PAST) p.ringN++;
        p.cal.settle(p.raw, draw);
        p.model.update(draw);
    }

    static void top3(float[] row, int[] out) {
        out[0] = out[1] = out[2] = -1;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            int bi = -1;
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) {
                if (n == out[0] || n == out[1]) continue;
                if (bi < 0 || row[n] > row[bi]) bi = n;
            }
            out[k] = bi;
        }
    }

    /** numpy.quantile(h, q) (linear) over the ring in time order. */
    static double quantile(Probe p, double q) {
        int n = p.ringN; double[] a = new double[n];
        if (n < PAST) System.arraycopy(p.ring, 0, a, 0, n); else System.arraycopy(p.ring, 0, a, 0, PAST);
        Arrays.sort(a);
        double vi = (n - 1) * q; if (vi >= n - 1) return a[n - 1];
        int g = (int) Math.floor(vi); double fr = vi - g, A = a[g], B = a[g + 1], d = B - A;
        return fr >= 0.5 ? B - d * (1 - fr) : A + d * fr;
    }

    static void closeBlock(Probe p) {
        if (p.openIndex < 0 || p.bn == 0) return;
        double[] b = blockRow(p);
        p.blocks.addLast(b);
        for (int i = 1; i < 10; i++) p.lifetime[i] += b[i];
        while (p.blocks.size() > KEEP_BLOCKS) p.blocks.removeFirst();
        p.bn = p.ba15 = p.bh15 = p.ba30 = p.bh30 = 0;
    }

    static double[] blockRow(Probe p) {
        double[] sq = new double[p.bn]; for (int i = 0; i < p.bn; i++) sq[i] = p.bLlr[i] * p.bLlr[i];
        boolean st = p.family.equals("REGMEM");
        return new double[]{p.openIndex, p.bn, ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(p.bLlr, 0, p.bn), ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(sq, 0, p.bn), p.ba15, p.bh15,
            ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(p.bP15, 0, p.ba15), p.ba30, p.bh30, ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(p.bP30, 0, p.ba30), st ? ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(p.bSt0, 0, p.bn) : Double.NaN};
    }

    /** Closed blocks plus the open one (as the diagnosis sees it at this moment). */
    public List<double[]> rows(Probe p) {
        List<double[]> out = new ArrayList<>(p.blocks);
        if (p.bn > 0) out.add(blockRow(p));
        return out.subList(Math.max(0, out.size() - KEEP_BLOCKS), out.size());
    }

    /** The snapshot lines (UpgradeDiagnosisSU2.parse format). */
    public String snapshotLines() {
        StringBuilder o = new StringBuilder();
        for (Probe p : probes) {
            o.append("probe\t").append(p.family).append('\t').append(p.params.isEmpty() ? "-" : p.params).append('\t');
            List<double[]> rs = rows(p);
            for (int i = 0; i < rs.size(); i++) { double[] b = rs.get(i); if (i > 0) o.append(',');
                o.append((long) b[1]).append(':').append(b[2]).append(':').append(b[3]).append(':').append((long) b[4]).append(':').append((long) b[5]).append(':').append(b[6])
                 .append(':').append((long) b[7]).append(':').append((long) b[8]).append(':').append(b[9]).append(':').append(Double.isNaN(b[10]) ? "-" : String.valueOf(b[10])); }
            o.append('\n');
        }
        return o.toString();
    }

    /** Continuation-matrix line for the snapshot (the CONTMAT probe is the live continuation / reversal matrix). */
    public String contmatLine(int refits, int maxVerified) {
        for (Probe p : probes) if (p.model instanceof ContMatSU2) {
            List<String> v = ((ContMatSU2) p.model).verified();
            return "contmat\t" + refits + "\t" + v.size() + "\t" + Math.max(maxVerified, v.size()) + "\t" + String.join(" ; ", v.subList(0, Math.min(6, v.size()))) + "\n";
        }
        return "";
    }

    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
        o.writeLong(t);
        for (Probe p : probes) {
            p.model.write(o); p.cal.write(o);
            o.writeInt(p.ringN); for (int i = 0; i < p.ringN; i++) o.writeDouble(p.ring[i]); o.writeDouble(p.thr15); o.writeDouble(p.thr30);
            o.writeInt(p.openIndex); o.writeInt(p.bn); o.writeInt(p.ba15); o.writeInt(p.bh15); o.writeInt(p.ba30); o.writeInt(p.bh30);
            for (int i = 0; i < p.bn; i++) { o.writeDouble(p.bLlr[i]); o.writeDouble(p.bSt0[i]); }
            for (int i = 0; i < p.ba15; i++) o.writeDouble(p.bP15[i]);
            for (int i = 0; i < p.ba30; i++) o.writeDouble(p.bP30[i]);
            o.writeInt(p.blocks.size()); for (double[] b : p.blocks) for (double v : b) o.writeDouble(v);
            for (double v : p.lifetime) o.writeDouble(v);
        }
    }

    public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        t = in.readLong();
        for (Probe p : probes) {
            p.model.read(in); p.cal.read(in);
            p.ringN = in.readInt(); for (int i = 0; i < p.ringN; i++) p.ring[i] = in.readDouble(); p.thr15 = in.readDouble(); p.thr30 = in.readDouble();
            p.openIndex = in.readInt(); p.bn = in.readInt(); p.ba15 = in.readInt(); p.bh15 = in.readInt(); p.ba30 = in.readInt(); p.bh30 = in.readInt();
            for (int i = 0; i < p.bn; i++) { p.bLlr[i] = in.readDouble(); p.bSt0[i] = in.readDouble(); }
            for (int i = 0; i < p.ba15; i++) p.bP15[i] = in.readDouble();
            for (int i = 0; i < p.ba30; i++) p.bP30[i] = in.readDouble();
            int nb = in.readInt(); p.blocks.clear(); for (int b = 0; b < nb; b++) { double[] r = new double[11]; for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) r[i] = in.readDouble(); p.blocks.addLast(r); }
            for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) p.lifetime[i] = in.readDouble();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Three boards (P03/P30): research (history replay), shadow (live frozen, not REAL) and
 * real (bound to the mainline). Every row shows N, rate, lower bound, frequency, longest
 * miss and the time range, so a figure measured on 72 periods can never look like one
 * measured on 3,000. The "display" caliber of the old reports (best of many on a short
 * window) is shown next to the forward caliber for the same strategies.
 */
public final class LeagueBoardSU2 {
    private LeagueBoardSU2() {}

    /** Dashboard entry: the board as of the newest frozen period. */
    public static String render(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(db)) return "";
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT coalesce(max(sequence_ordinal),0) FROM su2_live_decision WHERE hit IS NOT NULL", null)) {
            return render(db, c.moveToFirst() ? c.getLong(0) + 1 : 1);
        }
    }

    public static String render(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq) {
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(db)) return "SU2 未就绪\n";
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder("\n【策略联赛（SU2）】当前主链选择：").append(ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(db, seq)).append('\n');
        long from = seq - MainlineBridgeSU2.WINDOW;
        for (String[] m : ModelStoreSU2.league(db)) {
            boolean[][] r = m[1].equals("SU2") || m[1].equals("XI_INCUMBENT") ? ModelStoreSU2.record(db, m[3], from, seq) : MainlineBridgeSU2.su1Record(db, m[0].substring(m[0].indexOf(':') + 1), from, seq);
            int n = 0, k = 0, run = 0, worst = 0, periods = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < r[0].length; t++) { periods++; if (r[0][t]) { n++; if (r[1][t]) { k++; run = 0; } else { run++; worst = Math.max(worst, run); } } }
            double rate = n == 0 ? 0 : k / (double) n, lower = SelectiveEvidenceSU2.hoeffdingLower(k, n, 0.025);
            b.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%s%-28s 实时影子 N=%d 命中=%d 胜率=%.2f%% 下界=%.2f%% 频率=%.1f%% 最长连挂=%d 区间=最近%d期%n",
                m[1].equals("XI_INCUMBENT") ? "★" : " ", m[2], n, k, rate * 100, lower * 100, 100.0 * n / Math.max(1, periods), worst, periods));
        }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT genome_key,acts,hits,lower_bound,coverage,issued_at,expires_at FROM su2_certificate ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT 3", null)) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) b.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "证书 %s… N=%d 胜率=%.2f%% 下界=%.2f%% 频率=%.1f%%%n", c.getString(0).substring(0, 12), c.getInt(1), 100.0 * c.getInt(2) / Math.max(1, c.getInt(1)), c.getDouble(3) * 100, c.getDouble(4) * 100));
        }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='LEAGUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='HALL_OF_FAME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM su2_model_genome", null)) {
            if (c.moveToFirst()) b.append("已创造策略 ").append(c.getInt(0)).append("（联赛 ").append(c.getInt(1)).append("，名人堂 ").append(c.getInt(2)).append("）\n");
        }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT note FROM su2_lineage WHERE note<>'' LIMIT 3", null)) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) b.append("反馈修复：").append(c.getString(0)).append('\n');
        }
        return b.toString();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Legacy high-score records (P02): three evidence tiers and the effective-mechanism
 * audit that explains where an old 40%+ figure came from.
 *
 *   LEGACY_REPORTED  a figure printed by an old report (kept, shown, never deleted)
 *   ROW_VERIFIED     the per-period frozen predictions/labels were recovered and recount
 *   REPLAY_VERIFIED  the original VM + features were replayed and reproduce the rows
 *
 * The audit replays a genome's score program over a probe of periods and records
 * whether its score, its action and its state actually change. A genome whose score
 * is constant contributes nothing; its displayed figure belongs to the shared outer
 * selection rule and is attributed to that rule (not to the genome).
 */
public final class LegacyAuditSU2 {
    private LegacyAuditSU2() {}
    public enum Tier { LEGACY_REPORTED, ROW_VERIFIED, REPLAY_VERIFIED }

    public static final class Probe { public final boolean scoreChanges, actionChanges, stateChanges; public final double scoreRange;
        Probe(boolean s, boolean a, boolean st, double r) { scoreChanges = s; actionChanges = a; stateChanges = st; scoreRange = r; } }

    public interface Program { double score(int t); int action(int t); long stateHash(int t); }

    public static Probe probe(Program p, int from, int to) {
        double lo = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, hi = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; Set<Integer> actions = new HashSet<>(); Set<Long> states = new HashSet<>();
        for (int t = from; t < to; t++) { double s = p.score(t); lo = Math.min(lo, s); hi = Math.max(hi, s); actions.add(p.action(t)); states.add(p.stateHash(t)); }
        double range = hi - lo;
        return new Probe(range > 1e-12, actions.size() > 1, states.size() > 1, range);
    }

    /** Chance that the best of `count` exactly-30% strategies shows >= k hits in n acting periods (display-caliber check). */
    public static double bestOfChance(int count, int n, int k) {
        double tail = 0; double p = 0.3;
        // exact binomial upper tail via log-pmf
        for (int i = k; i <= n; i++) tail += Math.exp(logChoose(n, i) + i * Math.log(p) + (n - i) * Math.log(1 - p));
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - Math.min(1, tail), count);
    }
    static double logChoose(int n, int k) { double s = 0; for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) s += Math.log(n - k + i) - Math.log(i); return s; }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

/** Ridge logistic regression by Newton iterations (hre._fit_logistic); intercept unpenalised. */
public final class LogisticRidgeSU2 {
    private LogisticRidgeSU2() {}

    public static double[] fit(double[][] X, double[] y, int rows, double C, int iters) {
        int d = X[0].length, k = d + 1;
        double[] w = new double[k];
        double lam = 1.0 / Math.max(C, 1e-6);
        double[] g = new double[k];
        double[][] H = new double[k][k];
        double[] xb = new double[k];
        for (int it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(g, 0);
            for (double[] r : H) java.util.Arrays.fill(r, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                xb[0] = 1; System.arraycopy(X[i], 0, xb, 1, d);
                double z = 0; for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) z += xb[j] * w[j];
                z = Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, z));
                double p = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-z)), q = p * (1 - p), e = p - y[i];
                for (int a = 0; a < k; a++) { g[a] += xb[a] * e; double qa = q * xb[a]; for (int b = 0; b < k; b++) H[a][b] += qa * xb[b]; }
            }
            for (int a = 1; a < k; a++) g[a] += lam * w[a];
            for (int a = 0; a < k; a++) H[a][a] += (a == 0 ? 0 : lam) + 1e-9;
            double[] step = solve(H, g);
            double mx = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < k; a++) { w[a] -= step[a]; mx = Math.max(mx, Math.abs(step[a])); }
            if (mx < 1e-8) break;
        }
        return w;
    }

    static double[] solve(double[][] A0, double[] b0) {
        int n = b0.length;
        double[][] A = new double[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A0[i].clone();
        double[] b = b0.clone();
        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
            int piv = c; for (int r = c + 1; r < n; r++) if (Math.abs(A[r][c]) > Math.abs(A[piv][c])) piv = r;
            double[] tr = A[c]; A[c] = A[piv]; A[piv] = tr; double tb = b[c]; b[c] = b[piv]; b[piv] = tb;
            if (Math.abs(A[c][c]) < 1e-300) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_LOGISTIC_SINGULAR");
            for (int r = c + 1; r < n; r++) { double f = A[r][c] / A[c][c]; if (f == 0) continue; for (int j = c; j < n; j++) A[r][j] -= f * A[c][j]; b[r] -= f * b[c]; }
        }
        double[] x = new double[n];
        for (int r = n - 1; r >= 0; r--) { double s = b[r]; for (int j = r + 1; j < n; j++) s -= A[r][j] * x[j]; x[r] = s / A[r][r]; }
        return x;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Exact SU2 projection into the existing R974 certified lane (P30). Mirrors
 * MainlineAdapterSU1.prepare: the chosen league member's frozen ACT decision is the
 * rank-one action; the other 1,199 K3 actions are ranked by the same pooled table
 * that produced the decision; the shown probability is the certificate's calibrated
 * value. ABSTAIN or a missing table returns null: the mainline simply does not act.
 */
public final class MainlineAdapterSU2 {
    private MainlineAdapterSU2() {}
    public static final String CONTRACT = HashingSU1.text("SU2_MAINLINE_V1|LEAGUE_CHOICE|FROZEN_ACT_ONLY|SELECTIVE_CERT|PLATT_CAL|ONE_REAL_PER_PERIOD");

    public static final class Prepared {
        public final CertificateSU2.Authority authority; public final V51Models.PositionAction[] actions; public final V51Models.PositionAction rankOne; public final String recipe; public final double selectedHitP;
        Prepared(CertificateSU2.Authority a, V51Models.PositionAction[] x, V51Models.PositionAction r, String recipe, double p) { authority = a; actions = x; rankOne = r; this.recipe = recipe; selectedHitP = p; }
    }

    public static Prepared prepare(DbStore store, V51Models.PredictionContext context, V51Models.PositionAction[] actions) {
        K3ActionSpaceEngine.validateOrThrow(actions);
        long seq = TargetIssueResolver.sequenceOrdinalSU1(context.targetIssue);
        String member = ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(store.readable(), seq);
        boolean incumbent = member.startsWith("XI_INCUMBENT:");
        if (!member.startsWith("SU2:") && !incumbent) return null;
        String genome = member.substring(member.indexOf(':') + 1);
        CertificateSU2.Authority a = CertificateSU2.read(store.readable(), genome, System.currentTimeMillis());
        if (a == null) return null;
        int position, mask; double phat; boolean act;
        try (Cursor c = store.readable().rawQuery("SELECT position,number_mask,act,phat FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal=? AND hit IS NULL", new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(seq)})) {
            if (!c.moveToFirst()) return null;
            position = c.getInt(0); mask = c.getInt(1); act = c.getInt(2) == 1; phat = c.isNull(3) ? Double.NaN : c.getDouble(3);
        }
        if (!act) return null;                                             // the strategy waits for its window
        float[][] P = incumbent ? IncumbentLoopSU2.pendingTable(seq) : ModelLiveLoopSU2.pendingTable(genome, seq);
        if (P == null) return null;                                         // never re-derive after the freeze
        int[] k = new int[3]; int j = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) if ((mask & (1 << n)) != 0) k[j++] = n + 1;
        int headOrdinal = K3ActionSpaceEngine.globalOrdinal(position, k[0], k[1], k[2]);
        double[] mass = new double[1200]; int headIndex = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 1200; i++) {
            V51Models.PositionAction x = actions[i];
            if (K3ActionSpaceEngine.globalOrdinal(x.position, x.n1, x.n2, x.n3) == headOrdinal) headIndex = i;
            float[] p = P[x.position - 1];
            mass[i] = Math.rint(((double) p[x.n1 - 1] + p[x.n2 - 1] + p[x.n3 - 1]) * 1e9) / 1e9;
        }
        if (headIndex < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_HEAD_NOT_IN_ACTION_SPACE");
        final int hi = headIndex; Integer[] order = new Integer[1200]; for (int i = 0; i < 1200; i++) order[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(order, (x, y) -> { if (x == hi) return y == hi ? 0 : -1; if (y == hi) return 1; int d = Double.compare(mass[y], mass[x]);
            return d != 0 ? d : Integer.compare(K3ActionSpaceEngine.globalOrdinal(actions[x].position, actions[x].n1, actions[x].n2, actions[x].n3), K3ActionSpaceEngine.globalOrdinal(actions[y].position, actions[y].n1, actions[y].n2, actions[y].n3)); });
        double p = Double.isNaN(phat) ? 0.30 : new SelectiveCalibrationSU2.Platt(a.a, a.b).apply(phat);
        String recipe = "{\"contract\":\"" + CONTRACT + "\",\"certificate\":\"" + a.certificate + "\",\"genome\":\"" + genome + "\",\"program\":\"" + a.program + "\",\"target\":\"" + context.targetIssue + "\",\"position\":" + position + ",\"mask\":" + mask + "}";
        String digest = HashingSU1.text(recipe);
        V51Models.PositionAction[] out = new V51Models.PositionAction[1200];
        for (int rank = 0; rank < 1200; rank++) {
            int i = order[rank]; V51Models.PositionAction x = actions[i];
            out[i] = new V51Models.PositionAction(x.position, x.n1, x.n2, x.n3, x.n4, mass[i], mass[i], rank == 1199 ? 0 : Math.max(0, mass[i] - mass[order[rank + 1]]), x.thirdMargin, x.entropy, x.stability, x.metaFeatures, x.fingerprint, rank + 1,
                V51ChecksumEngine.sha256("CERTIFIED_EXACT_K3_R974|" + x.checksum + '|' + digest + '|' + i + '|' + rank + '|' + mass[i]));
        }
        K3ActionSpaceEngine.validateOrThrow(out);
        return new Prepared(a, out, out[headIndex], recipe, p);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * League -> mainline (P03/P27/P30).
 *
 *  1. Every BLOCK periods the mainline choice is re-made from settled live records
 *     (MainlinePolicySU2, IPM): out-of-sample records only (periods >= joined_sequence),
 *     the user's original cross-intersection method is the floor, and a challenger must
 *     beat the current member on the same periods (Bonferroni z-test + 2 of 3 sub-blocks).
 *  2. Each period the chosen member's frozen decision is read: ABSTAIN means the
 *     mainline does not act (a selective strategy is allowed to wait for its window);
 *     ACT is forwarded to the existing single DecisionGate / settlement owner only if
 *     the member holds a valid selective certificate (SelectiveEvidenceSU2);
 *     otherwise the choice is shown as SHADOW with the failing gate named.
 *  The absolute per-period probability floors of DecisionGateEngine (0.39-0.42) do
 *  not apply to this lane: they are unreachable for any calibrated K3 (P04).
 */
public final class MainlineBridgeSU2 {
    private MainlineBridgeSU2() {}
    public static final int BLOCK = 250, WINDOW = 4000, MIN_ACTS = 600;
    public static final double ROOT_ALPHA = 0.05, BLOCK_FLOOR = 0.28, MIN_COVERAGE = 0.15;

    static boolean[][] su1Record(SQLiteDatabase db, String strategy, long from, long to) {
        int n = (int) (to - from); boolean[] act = new boolean[n], hit = new boolean[n];
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT sequence_ordinal,hit FROM su1_live_shadow WHERE strategy_id=? AND sequence_ordinal>=? AND sequence_ordinal<? AND hit IS NOT NULL",
            new String[]{strategy, String.valueOf(from), String.valueOf(to)})) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) { int i = (int) (c.getLong(0) - from); act[i] = true; hit[i] = c.getInt(1) == 1; }
        }
        return new boolean[][]{act, hit};
    }

    static List<MainlinePolicySU2.Member> members(SQLiteDatabase db, long from, long to) {
        List<MainlinePolicySU2.Member> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String[] m : ModelStoreSU2.league(db)) {
            boolean[][] r = m[1].equals("SU2") || m[1].equals("XI_INCUMBENT") ? ModelStoreSU2.record(db, m[3], from, to) : su1Record(db, m[0].substring(m[0].indexOf(':') + 1), from, to);
            int birth = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(to - from, Long.parseLong(m[4]) - from));   // out-of-sample from joining
            out.add(new MainlinePolicySU2.Member(m[0], m[2], m[1].equals("XI_INCUMBENT"), r[0], r[1], birth));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Called after settlement of sequence seq-1; returns the active member id. */
    public static String chooseIfDue(DbStore store, long seq) {
        SQLiteDatabase r = store.readable();
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(r)) return "";
        String current = ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(r, seq);
        if (!current.isEmpty() && seq % BLOCK != 0) return current;
        long from = seq - WINDOW;
        List<MainlinePolicySU2.Member> league = members(r, from, seq);
        if (league.isEmpty()) return current;
        // indices are relative to `from`; the policy scores [max(birth, 0), WINDOW)
        final MainlinePolicySU2.Choice ch = MainlinePolicySU2.choose(league, current, WINDOW, WINDOW);
        store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_MAINLINE_CHOICE", db -> { ModelStoreSU2.recordChoice(db, seq, ch, from, System.currentTimeMillis()); return 0; });
        return ch.member.id;
    }

    public static final class Intent {
        public final String memberId, genomeKey, gate; public final int position, mask; public final double phat; public final boolean real;
        Intent(String m, String g, int p, int mask, double phat, boolean real, String gate) { memberId = m; genomeKey = g; position = p; this.mask = mask; this.phat = phat; this.real = real; this.gate = gate; }
    }

    /**
     * The mainline intent for target `seq`, or null when the chosen strategy abstains
     * (or has no frozen decision - MISSING is never turned into an action).
     */
    public static Intent intent(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq) {
        String member = ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(db, seq);
        // SU2 members and the XI incumbent use this lane (XI's frozen pick IS the mainline pick when IPM keeps it);
        // selective SU1 members keep their existing lane
        if (!member.startsWith("SU2:") && !member.startsWith("XI_INCUMBENT:")) return null;
        String genome = member.substring(member.indexOf(':') + 1);
        int position, mask; double phat; boolean act;
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT position,number_mask,act,phat FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal=? AND hit IS NULL", new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(seq)})) {
            if (!c.moveToFirst()) return null;
            position = c.getInt(0); mask = c.getInt(1); act = c.getInt(2) == 1; phat = c.isNull(3) ? Double.NaN : c.getDouble(3);
        }
        if (!act) return null;
        // REAL needs a valid selective certificate (issued by CertificateSU2.maintain from live evidence)
        CertificateSU2.Authority cert = CertificateSU2.read(db, genome, System.currentTimeMillis());
        return new Intent(member, genome, position, mask, phat, cert != null, cert != null ? "CERTIFIED:" + cert.certificate : "NO_VALID_SU2_CERTIFICATE_SHADOW_ONLY");
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Incumbent-Protected Mainline, IPM (P03b + P30) - "never worse than the old version" as a rule.
 *
 * Defect fixed (R13 v2 verification): the earlier policy scored every member on the last W
 * settled periods and took the best. A tier champion is selected on draws before it joins the
 * league, so a window that reaches back before its birth is in-sample for it (winner's curse),
 * while the user's cross-intersection method (XI) is always out-of-sample. Challengers always
 * "won" and the mainline fell below XI on the 5.4.3 report data (26.5% vs 35.1%).
 *
 * Rule (bit-identical to reference/replay/mainline_ipm.py, fixture r13_ipm):
 *  1. out-of-sample only: a member is scored on periods >= birth (su2_league.joined_sequence);
 *  2. XI is the floor: the mainline starts as XI and returns to XI when the current challenger
 *     is significantly worse than XI - or significantly below the 30% baseline - on the last
 *     DEMOTE_WINDOW periods (one-sided z, alpha 0.02)
 *     or loses the frequency floor there (short window = fast reaction);
 *  3. a challenger C replaces the current member U only on the same periods
 *     [max(birth_C, birth_U, c-W), c): >= 1000 periods, >= 250 acts, coverage >= 0.15,
 *     one-sided two-proportion z with p <= alpha/k (Bonferroni over k eligible challengers),
 *     C better in >= 2 of 3 equal sub-blocks, not below XI's point estimate when U != XI, and
 *     not demotable itself right now (hysteresis);
 *     the largest z wins, ties by member id.
 * Indices are relative to the caller's window start; births are clamped to >= 0.
 */
public final class MainlinePolicySU2 {
    private MainlinePolicySU2() {}
    public static final int MIN_PERIODS = 1000, MIN_ACTS = 250, DEMOTE_WINDOW = 1500;
    /** From the repeated-look error budget, checked on known-truth leagues (reference/replay/ipm_oc.py). */
    public static final double MIN_COVERAGE = 0.15, ALPHA_SWITCH = 0.02, ALPHA_DEMOTE = 0.02, BASE = 0.30;

    public static final class Member {
        public final String id, name; public final boolean incumbent; public final boolean[] act, hit; public final int birth;
        public Member(String id, String name, boolean incumbent, boolean[] act, boolean[] hit, int birth) {
            if (id == null || name == null || act == null || hit == null || act.length != hit.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_LEAGUE_MEMBER");
            this.id = id; this.name = name; this.incumbent = incumbent; this.act = act; this.hit = hit; this.birth = Math.max(0, birth);
        }
    }

    public static final class Choice {
        public final Member member; public final double score, incumbentScore; public final String reason;
        Choice(Member m, double s, double inc, String reason) { member = m; score = s; incumbentScore = inc; this.reason = reason; }
    }

    /** Numerical Recipes erfcc, |relative error| < 1.2e-7 (identical in the Python reference). */
    static double erfcc(double x) {
        double z = Math.abs(x), t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.5 * z);
        double r = t * Math.exp(-z * z - 1.26551223 + t * (1.00002368 + t * (0.37409196 + t * (0.09678418 + t * (
            -0.18628806 + t * (0.27886807 + t * (-1.13520398 + t * (1.48851587 + t * (-0.82215223 + t * 0.17087277)))))))));
        return x >= 0 ? r : 2.0 - r;
    }
    static double normSf(double z) { return 0.5 * erfcc(z / Math.sqrt(2.0)); }

    static int[] nk(Member m, int a, int b) {
        int n = 0, k = 0;
        for (int t = Math.max(0, a); t < b; t++) if (m.act[t]) { n++; if (m.hit[t]) k++; }
        return new int[]{n, k};
    }
    static double rate(int n, int k) { return (k + 0.5) / (n + 1.0); }

    /** One-sided z for "C hits more often than U" (unpooled, continuity-shrunk). */
    static double zBetter(int nc, int kc, int nu, int ku) {
        if (nc == 0 || nu == 0) return 0.0;
        double pc = rate(nc, kc), pu = rate(nu, ku), se = Math.sqrt(pc * (1 - pc) / nc + pu * (1 - pu) / nu);
        return se > 0 ? (pc - pu) / se : 0.0;
    }

    static int blocksWon(Member c, Member u, int a, int b) {
        int won = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < 3; f++) {
            int x = a + (b - a) * f / 3, y = a + (b - a) * (f + 1) / 3;
            int[] cc = nk(c, x, y), uu = nk(u, x, y);
            if (uu[0] == 0) uu = nk(u, a, b);
            if (cc[0] > 0 && uu[0] > 0 && cc[1] / (double) cc[0] > uu[1] / (double) uu[0]) won++;
        }
        return won;
    }

    static boolean eligible(Member m, int c, int window) {
        int a = Math.max(m.birth, c - window);
        if (c - a < MIN_PERIODS) return false;
        int[] x = nk(m, a, c);
        return x[0] >= MIN_ACTS && x[0] / (double) (c - a) >= MIN_COVERAGE;
    }

    /** Significantly worse than XI, or significantly below the 30% baseline, on the last DEMOTE_WINDOW periods,
     *  or below the frequency floor there.
     *  Used to demote the current member and to refuse promoting such a member (hysteresis). */
    static boolean demotable(Member m, Member xi, int c) {
        int a = Math.max(Math.max(m.birth, xi.birth), c - DEMOTE_WINDOW);
        int[] cc = nk(m, a, c), xx = nk(xi, a, c);
        boolean ok = c - a >= MIN_PERIODS && cc[0] >= MIN_ACTS && cc[0] / (double) (c - a) >= MIN_COVERAGE;
        if (!ok) return true;
        double belowBase = (BASE - cc[1] / (double) cc[0]) / Math.sqrt(BASE * (1 - BASE) / cc[0]);   // below the 30% baseline
        return normSf(zBetter(xx[0], xx[1], cc[0], cc[1])) <= ALPHA_DEMOTE || normSf(belowBase) <= ALPHA_DEMOTE;
    }

    /** Choose the member for the block starting at c (all evidence strictly before c). */
    public static Choice choose(List<Member> league, String currentId, int c, int window) {
        if (league.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_LEAGUE_EMPTY");
        Member xi = null, cur = null;
        for (Member m : league) {
            if (m.act.length < c) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_LEAGUE_HISTORY_SHORT:" + m.id);
            if (m.incumbent && xi == null) xi = m;
            if (m.id.equals(currentId)) cur = m;
        }
        if (cur == null) cur = xi != null ? xi : league.get(0);
        String reason = "KEEP";
        if (xi != null && cur != xi && demotable(cur, xi, c)) { cur = xi; reason = "DEMOTE_TO_INCUMBENT"; }
        List<Member> cands = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Member m : league) if (m != cur && eligible(m, c, window)) cands.add(m);
        int k = cands.size(); Member best = null; double bz = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
        for (Member m : cands) {
            int a = Math.max(Math.max(m.birth, cur.birth), c - window);
            if (c - a < MIN_PERIODS) continue;
            int[] cc = nk(m, a, c), uu = nk(cur, a, c);
            if (cc[0] < MIN_ACTS || cc[0] / (double) (c - a) < MIN_COVERAGE) continue;
            double z = zBetter(cc[0], cc[1], uu[0], uu[1]);
            if (normSf(z) > ALPHA_SWITCH / k) continue;
            if (blocksWon(m, cur, a, c) < 2) continue;
            if (xi != null && m != xi && demotable(m, xi, c)) continue;
            if (xi != null && cur != xi && m != xi) {
                int ax = Math.max(Math.max(m.birth, xi.birth), c - window);
                int[] n1 = nk(m, ax, c), n2 = nk(xi, ax, c);
                if (n2[0] > 0 && n1[0] > 0 && n1[1] / (double) n1[0] < n2[1] / (double) n2[0]) continue;
            }
            if (best == null || z > bz || (z == bz && m.id.compareTo(best.id) < 0)) { best = m; bz = z; }
        }
        double incScore = Double.NaN;
        if (xi != null) { int a = Math.max(xi.birth, c - window); int[] x = nk(xi, a, c); incScore = x[0] == 0 ? Double.NaN : x[1] / (double) x[0]; }
        if (best != null) return new Choice(best, bz, incScore, best.incumbent ? "SWITCH_TO_INCUMBENT" : "SWITCH_CHALLENGER_BEATS_CURRENT");
        int a = Math.max(cur.birth, c - window); int[] x = nk(cur, a, c);
        return new Choice(cur, x[0] == 0 ? 0.0 : x[1] / (double) x[0], incScore, reason);
    }
}
```
