项目 P06, P08, P37, P50 · 196 行 · sha256 `6361f4898201e8e0a82104421360eda506ddd7037db6e13a388b7bdaa0f1c906`

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Every-period live loop for SU2 strategies (P06/P07/P09).
 *
 *   capture(target)    before the draw: every live strategy decides (act or not),
 *                      all decisions are frozen in one transaction before open time;
 *   settleWithin(...)  inside the settlement owner transaction: every decision of the
 *                      period gets its label, then every strategy and every shared
 *                      model trains on the settled draw.
 *
 * Runtime state is the exact continuation of a replay that started at the runtime
 * genesis (ModelLiveSU2Test proves live == replay). It is checkpointed every
 * CHECKPOINT_EVERY periods and rebuilt from the retained history (<=5000 draws)
 * at most once per REGENESIS_EVERY periods, so a strategy born later can always
 * bootstrap from draws that are still stored.
 */
public final class ModelLiveLoopSU2 {
    private ModelLiveLoopSU2() {}
    public static final int CHECKPOINT_EVERY = 240, REGENESIS_EVERY = 1440, START_META = 1500, WINDOW = 2500, REFIT = 250;
    /** P08: pre-draw compute budget for all SU2 decisions together; strategies not reached are MISSING. */
    public static final long PREDRAW_BUDGET_NANOS = 1_500_000_000L;

    static final class Runtime {
        long genesisSeq, through = -1; ModelLiveSU2.Hub hub = new ModelLiveSU2.Hub();
        final LinkedHashMap<String, LiveStrategySU2> lives = new LinkedHashMap<>();   // programs and R14 committees
        long pendingSeq = -1;
    }
    private static Runtime RT;

    static long sequence(String issue) { return TargetIssueResolver.sequenceOrdinalSU1(issue); }

    /** Pooled table of a live strategy's pending decision for `seq`, or null (then the mainline abstains). */
    public static synchronized float[][] pendingTable(String genomeKey, long seq) {
        Runtime rt = RT; if (rt == null || rt.pendingSeq != seq) return null;
        LiveStrategySU2 l = rt.lives.get(genomeKey); if (l == null) return null;
        float[][] P = l.pendingTable(seq - rt.genesisSeq); if (P == null) return null;
        float[][] out = new float[10][]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) out[p] = P[p].clone(); return out;
    }

    /** P50 memory budget: at most 32 live strategies and 48 distinct calibrated members (~1 MB calibration ring each). */
    public static final int MAX_LIVE = 32, MAX_HUB_CALIBRATORS = 48;

    /**
     * Live set: SU2 league members - programs and R14 committees; the XI incumbent runs in IncumbentLoopSU2. P50: the
     * current mainline member first, then the newest members, while the hub stays within MAX_HUB_CALIBRATORS
     * calibration rings (RAM and the HUB checkpoint stay bounded however many champions the league accumulates).
     */
    static List<String> liveGenomes(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        List<String> cand = new ArrayList<>(); String main = null;
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice ORDER BY from_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", null)) { if (c.moveToFirst()) main = c.getString(0); }
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT g.canonical_text,'SU2:'||g.genome_key FROM su2_model_genome g WHERE g.state='LEAGUE' AND g.origin_op<>'INCUMBENT' ORDER BY g.born_sequence DESC,g.genome_key LIMIT 96", null)) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) { if (c.getString(1).equals(main)) cand.add(0, c.getString(0)); else cand.add(c.getString(0)); }
        }
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(); Set<String> cals = new HashSet<>();
        for (String text : cand) {
            if (out.size() >= MAX_LIVE) break;
            Set<String> mine = calibratedMembers(text); Set<String> union = new HashSet<>(cals); union.addAll(mine);
            if (union.size() > MAX_HUB_CALIBRATORS) continue;
            cals = union; out.add(text);
        }
        return out;
    }

    static Set<String> calibratedMembers(String text) {
        Set<String> out = new HashSet<>();
        List<ModelGenomeSU2> gs = CommitteeSU2.isCommittee(text) ? CommitteeSU2.parse(text).subs : Collections.singletonList(ModelGenomeSU2.parse(text));
        for (ModelGenomeSU2 g : gs) if (g.calibrated) for (ModelGenomeSU2.Member m : g.members) out.add(m.modelKey());
        return out;
    }

    static String keyOf(String text) { return CommitteeSU2.isCommittee(text) ? CommitteeSU2.parse(text).key() : ModelGenomeSU2.parse(text).key(); }

    static LiveStrategySU2 make(String text, ModelLiveSU2.Hub hub) {
        return CommitteeSU2.isCommittee(text) ? new CommitteeLiveSU2(CommitteeSU2.parse(text), hub, START_META, WINDOW, REFIT)
            : new ModelLiveSU2(ModelGenomeSU2.parse(text), hub, START_META, WINDOW, REFIT);
    }

    /** Rebuild the runtime from the retained history window (exact replay). */
    static Runtime genesis(List<String> genomes, int[][] history, long firstSeq) {
        Runtime rt = new Runtime(); rt.genesisSeq = firstSeq;
        for (String g : genomes) rt.lives.put(keyOf(g), make(g, rt.hub));
        for (int[] d : history) { for (LiveStrategySU2 l : rt.lives.values()) { l.decide(); l.settle(d); } rt.hub.update(d); }
        rt.through = firstSeq + history.length - 1;
        return rt;
    }

    static synchronized Runtime ensure(DbStore store, EventFrameSU1 frame, long seq) {
        int[][] h = frame.history(); long first = sequence(String.valueOf(frame.issue(0))), last = sequence(String.valueOf(frame.issue(h.length - 1)));
        if (last != seq - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_LIVE_FRAME_NOT_CONTIGUOUS");
        for (int i = 1; i < h.length; i++) if (sequence(String.valueOf(frame.issue(i))) != first + i) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_LIVE_HISTORY_GAP");
        List<String> genomes = liveGenomes(store.readable());
        boolean rebuild = RT == null || RT.genesisSeq < first || seq - RT.genesisSeq > (long) h.length + REGENESIS_EVERY || !RT.lives.keySet().containsAll(keys(genomes));
        if (!rebuild && RT.through > seq - 1) rebuild = true;                 // source revision went backwards
        if (rebuild) {
            Runtime restored = restore(store.readable(), genomes, h, first);
            RT = restored != null ? restored : genesis(genomes, h, first);
        }
        for (long s = RT.through + 1; s <= seq - 1; s++) {                      // catch up missed settlements exactly
            int[] d = h[(int) (s - first)];
            for (LiveStrategySU2 l : RT.lives.values()) { l.decide(); l.settle(d); }
            RT.hub.update(d); RT.through = s;
        }
        return RT;
    }

    static Set<String> keys(List<String> gs) { Set<String> s = new HashSet<>(); for (String g : gs) s.add(keyOf(g)); return s; }

    /** Restore from the last checkpoint and replay forward; null if the checkpoint is unusable. */
    static Runtime restore(SQLiteDatabase db, List<String> genomes, int[][] h, long first) {
        try {
            long[] through = new long[1]; byte[] hubBlob = ModelStoreSU2.liveBlob(db, "HUB", through);
            if (hubBlob == null) return null;
            DataInputStream hin = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(ModelStoreSU2.gunzip(hubBlob)));
            long genesisSeq = hin.readLong();
            if (genesisSeq < first) return null;                                   // checkpoint older than retained draws
            Runtime rt = new Runtime(); rt.genesisSeq = genesisSeq;
            for (String g : genomes) rt.lives.put(keyOf(g), make(g, rt.hub));
            rt.hub.readModelsInto(hin);                                            // P50: calibration rings are separate rows
            for (String k : rt.hub.calKeys()) {
                long[] ct = new long[1]; byte[] cb = ModelStoreSU2.liveBlob(db, ModelLiveSU2.Hub.calOwner(k), ct);
                if (cb == null || ct[0] != through[0]) return null;
                rt.hub.readCal(k, new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(ModelStoreSU2.gunzip(cb))));
            }
            for (LiveStrategySU2 l : rt.lives.values()) {
                long[] t = new long[1]; byte[] b = ModelStoreSU2.liveBlob(db, l.key(), t);
                if (b == null || t[0] != through[0]) return null;
                l.readInto(new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(ModelStoreSU2.gunzip(b))));
            }
            rt.through = through[0];
            return rt;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unusable) { return null; }
    }

    static void checkpoint(SQLiteDatabase db, Runtime rt, long now) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream hb = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); DataOutputStream ho = new DataOutputStream(hb);
        ho.writeLong(rt.genesisSeq); rt.hub.writeModels(ho); ho.flush();
        ModelStoreSU2.saveLive(db, "HUB", rt.through, ModelStoreSU2.gzip(hb.toByteArray()), now);
        for (String k : rt.hub.calKeys()) {                                        // P50: one row per calibration ring (each ~1 MB < 16 MB)
            ByteArrayOutputStream cb = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); DataOutputStream co = new DataOutputStream(cb); rt.hub.writeCal(k, co); co.flush();
            ModelStoreSU2.saveLive(db, ModelLiveSU2.Hub.calOwner(k), rt.through, ModelStoreSU2.gzip(cb.toByteArray()), now);
        }
        for (LiveStrategySU2 l : rt.lives.values()) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream b = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); DataOutputStream o = new DataOutputStream(b); l.write(o); o.flush();
            ModelStoreSU2.saveLive(db, l.key(), rt.through, ModelStoreSU2.gzip(b.toByteArray()), now);
        }
    }

    /** Before the draw. Returns the number of frozen decisions. */
    public static synchronized int capture(DbStore store, String target) {
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(store.readable())) return 0;
        long seq = sequence(target);
        EventFrameSU1 frame = EventFrameBuilderSU1.capture(store, target);
        Runtime rt = ensure(store, frame, seq);
        if (rt.pendingSeq == seq) return 0;
        final Map<String, ModelLiveSU2.Decision> decisions = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        long started = System.nanoTime();
        // rotate the start so a budget overrun never starves the same strategies (P08)
        List<Map.Entry<String, LiveStrategySU2>> order = new ArrayList<>(rt.lives.entrySet());
        if (!order.isEmpty()) Collections.rotate(order, (int) (seq % order.size()));
        for (Map.Entry<String, LiveStrategySU2> e : order) {
            if (System.nanoTime() - started > PREDRAW_BUDGET_NANOS || SettlementExecutionGateR819.isActive()) break;   // rest are MISSING
            decisions.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().decide());
        }
        rt.pendingSeq = seq;
        final long open = frame.targetOpenTime;
        return store.coordinatorForResearchR952().runAtomicWriteOrThrowF01("SU2_LIVE_FREEZE", db -> {
            if (!EventFrameBuilderSU1.unchanged(store, frame)) return 0;
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis(); if (now >= open) return 0;      // never freeze after open
            int n = 0; for (Map.Entry<String, ModelLiveSU2.Decision> e : decisions.entrySet()) { ModelStoreSU2.insertDecision(db, e.getKey(), seq, e.getValue(), now, open); n++; }
            return n;
        });
    }

    /** Inside the original settlement owner transaction (same place as LiveShadowLoopSU1.settleWithin). */
    public static synchronized int settleWithin(SQLiteDatabase db, Models.Draw draw, long completedAt) throws IOException {
        if (!StrategySchemaSU2.ready(db)) return 0;
        long seq = sequence(draw.issue);
        int[] d = new int[10]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) d[p] = draw.getNumberAtPosition(p + 1);
        int labelled = ModelStoreSU2.settle(db, seq, d, completedAt);
        Runtime rt = RT;
        if (rt != null && rt.pendingSeq == seq && rt.through == seq - 1) {
            for (LiveStrategySU2 l : rt.lives.values()) { if (!l.hasPending()) l.decide(); l.settle(d); }   // MISSING ones still train
            rt.hub.update(d); rt.through = seq; rt.pendingSeq = -1;
            if (seq % CHECKPOINT_EVERY == 0) checkpoint(db, rt, completedAt);
        }
        // a process restart between capture and settle simply catches up from history at the next capture
        return labelled;
    }
}
```

```java
 * settled every period whether it acts or not, its applicability learner keeps

    public static final class Decision {

        public Decision(long t, int position, int mask, boolean act, double gscore, double phat) { this.t = t; this.position = position; this.mask = mask; this.act = act; this.gscore = gscore; this.phat = phat; }

    final ModelGenomeSU2 g; Hub hub; final int startMeta, window, refit, M, F;
    final String[] keys; final double[] w; final double[] bmaLogw; final ModelOpsSU2.GatedState gated;

    private float[][] pooled() {

    /** Before draw t: compute the strategy, its gate score and whether it acts. Pure w.r.t. persisted state. */

    private double rollingZ(double v) {

    public boolean hasPending() { return curP1 >= 0; }

    /** After draw t is settled: label, feedback, gate history; then the hub updates the shared models. */
    public boolean settle(int[] draw) {

        OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraw(draw);

        c1 += conf; c2 += conf * conf;

    /** A strategy born after genesis: replay the stored history through a private hub, then join the shared hub. */
    public static ModelLiveSU2 bootstrap(ModelGenomeSU2 g, Hub shared, int[][] history, int startMeta, int window, int refit) {
        for (ModelGenomeSU2.Member m : g.members) { shared.adopt(m, history); if (g.calibrated) shared.adoptCalibrated(m, history); }
        Hub own = new Hub();
        ModelLiveSU2 live = new ModelLiveSU2(g, own, startMeta, window, refit);
        for (int[] d : history) { live.decide(); live.settle(d); own.update(d); }
        if (own.t != shared.t) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_BOOTSTRAP_DESYNC");

    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
        o.writeUTF(g.key()); o.writeLong(t);
        for (double v : bmaLogw) o.writeDouble(v);
        for (double[] r : feat) for (double v : r) o.writeDouble(v);
        for (boolean b : lab) o.writeBoolean(b);
        for (double v : gsRing) o.writeDouble(v);
        for (double v : c1Ring) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : c2Ring) o.writeDouble(v); o.writeDouble(c1); o.writeDouble(c2);
        o.writeDouble(ema12); o.writeDouble(ema48); o.writeDouble(ema200); o.writeDouble(thr); o.writeBoolean(thrValid);
        o.writeBoolean(wt != null); if (wt != null) { for (double v : wt) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : mu) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : sd) o.writeDouble(v); }
        o.writeLong(last);
        if (gated != null) gated.write(o);
        if (teacher != null) teacher.write(o);
    }

    public void readInto(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        if (!g.key().equals(in.readUTF())) throw new IOException("SU2_LIVE_STATE_GENOME");
        t = in.readLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < bmaLogw.length; i++) bmaLogw[i] = in.readDouble();
        for (double[] r : feat) for (int j = 0; j < F; j++) r[j] = in.readDouble();
        for (int i = 0; i < lab.length; i++) lab[i] = in.readBoolean();
        for (int i = 0; i < gsRing.length; i++) gsRing[i] = in.readDouble();
        for (int i = 0; i < c1Ring.length; i++) c1Ring[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < c2Ring.length; i++) c2Ring[i] = in.readDouble(); c1 = in.readDouble(); c2 = in.readDouble();
        ema12 = in.readDouble(); ema48 = in.readDouble(); ema200 = in.readDouble(); thr = in.readDouble(); thrValid = in.readBoolean();
        if (in.readBoolean()) { wt = new double[F + 1]; mu = new double[F]; sd = new double[F]; for (int i = 0; i <= F; i++) wt[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) mu[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) sd[i] = in.readDouble(); } else wt = null;
        last = in.readLong(); curP1 = -1;
        if (gated != null) gated.read(in);
        if (teacher != null) teacher.read(in);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

/** Permutation consistency and pooling of member models (P17). Mirrors models.sink/pool_static/pool_bma. */
public final class ModelOpsSU2 {
    private ModelOpsSU2() {}
    static final double EPS = 1e-6;

    /** Doubly-stochastic projection: in one draw every number appears exactly once over the 10 positions. */
    public static float[][][] sink(float[][][] P, int iters) {
        int T = P.length;
        float[][][] out = new float[T][10][10];
        double[][] M = new double[10][10];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) M[p][n] = (double) P[t][p][n] + 1e-9;
            for (int it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double s = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) s += M[p][n]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) M[p][n] /= s; }
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double s = 0; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) s += M[p][n]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) M[p][n] /= s; }
            }
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double s = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) s += M[p][n]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[t][p][n] = (float) (M[p][n] / s); }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Static log-linear pool: P ~ prod_m P_m^w_m. */
    public static float[][][] poolStatic(float[][][][] Ps, double[] w) {
        int T = Ps[0].length, M = Ps.length;
        float[][][] out = new float[T][10][10];
        double[] L = new double[10];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) v += w[m] * Math.log(Math.max((double) Ps[m][t][p][n], EPS)); L[n] = v; mx = Math.max(mx, v); }
            double s = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { L[n] = Math.exp(L[n] - mx); s += L[n]; }
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[t][p][n] = (float) (L[n] / s);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Online Bayesian model averaging with forgetting and fixed share; weights for t use settled draws < t. */
    public static float[][][] poolBma(float[][][][] Ps, int[][] d, double share, double decay) {
        int T = Ps[0].length, M = Ps.length;
        double[][] logw = new double[M][10], w = new double[M][10];
        float[][][] out = new float[T][10][10];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) mx = Math.max(mx, logw[m][p]);
                double z = 0; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { w[m][p] = Math.exp(logw[m][p] - mx); z += w[m][p]; }
                for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) w[m][p] /= z;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) v += w[m][p] * (double) Ps[m][t][p][n]; out[t][p][n] = (float) v; }
            }
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                int x = d[t][p] - 1;
                for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) logw[m][p] = decay * logw[m][p] + Math.log(Math.max((double) Ps[m][t][p][x], EPS));
                double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) mx = Math.max(mx, logw[m][p]);
                double z = 0; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { w[m][p] = Math.exp(logw[m][p] - mx); z += w[m][p]; }
                for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { w[m][p] = (1 - share) * (w[m][p] / z) + share / M; logw[m][p] = Math.log(w[m][p]); }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** numpy-style pairwise summation (8 accumulators for blocks <= 128, recursive halves above). */
    static double pairwise(double[] a, int off, int n) {
        if (n < 8) { double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s += a[off + i]; return s; }
        if (n <= 128) {
            double[] r = new double[8]; for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) r[j] = a[off + j];
            int i = 8; for (; i < n - (n % 8); i += 8) for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) r[j] += a[off + i + j];
            double res = ((r[0] + r[1]) + (r[2] + r[3])) + ((r[4] + r[5]) + (r[6] + r[7]));
            for (; i < n; i++) res += a[off + i];
            return res;
        }
        int n2 = n / 2; n2 -= n2 % 8;
        return pairwise(a, off, n2) + pairwise(a, off + n2, n - n2);
    }

    /**
     * State-gated mixture of experts (P17): log P(n) = sum_m (a_m + v_m . s_t) log P_m(n), weights learned
     * online by AdaGrad on the settled log-loss; s_t = the members' own causal states, standardised online.
     * Mirrors models.pool_gated (reduction order may differ from BLAS in the last bits; parity tolerance 1e-5).
     */
    public static float[][][] poolGated(float[][][][] Ps, float[][][] STs, int[][] d, double lr, double l2) {
        GatedState g = new GatedState(Ps.length, STs);
        int T = Ps[0].length; float[][][] out = new float[T][][];
        float[][][] cur = new float[Ps.length][][]; float[][] st = new float[Ps.length][];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            for (int m = 0; m < Ps.length; m++) { cur[m] = Ps[m][t]; st[m] = STs[m][t]; }
            out[t] = g.predict(cur, st);
            g.update(cur, st, d[t], lr, l2);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Incremental form used identically by replay and by the live loop. */
    public static final class GatedState {
        final int M, S, D; final double[] W, G, mu, var; long cnt; double[] f; double[][] lp; double[] q;
        public GatedState(int M, float[][][] STs) { this(M, width(STs)); }
        static int width(float[][][] STs) { int s = 0; for (float[][] x : STs) s += x[0].length; return s; }
        public GatedState(int M, int S) {
            this.M = M; this.S = S; D = 1 + S; W = new double[M * D]; G = new double[M * D]; mu = new double[S]; var = new double[S];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(G, 1e-3); java.util.Arrays.fill(var, 1.0); for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) W[m * D] = 1.0 / M;
        }
        double[] stateVector(float[][] st) { double[] s = new double[S]; int j = 0; for (float[] x : st) for (float v : x) s[j++] = v; return s; }
        public float[][] predict(float[][][] P, float[][] st) {
            double[] s = stateVector(st); f = new double[D]; f[0] = 1.0;
            for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) { double z = (s[k] - mu[k]) / Math.sqrt(var[k] + 1e-9); f[k + 1] = Math.max(-5, Math.min(5, z)); }
            double[] a = new double[M]; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { double v = 0; for (int k = 0; k < D; k++) v += W[m * D + k] * f[k]; a[m] = v; }
            lp = new double[M][100]; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) lp[m][p * 10 + n] = Math.log(Math.max((double) P[m][p][n], EPS));
            q = new double[100]; float[][] out = new float[10][10];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double[] L = new double[10]; double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) v += a[m] * lp[m][p * 10 + n]; L[n] = v; mx = Math.max(mx, v); }
                double z = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { L[n] = Math.exp(L[n] - mx); z += L[n]; }
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { q[p * 10 + n] = L[n] / z; out[p][n] = (float) q[p * 10 + n]; }
            }
            return out;
        }
        public void update(float[][][] P, float[][] st, int[] draw, double lr, double l2) {
            if (f == null) predict(P, st);
            double[] gm = new double[M], prod = new double[100];
            for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) prod[p * 10 + n] = (q[p * 10 + n] - (draw[p] - 1 == n ? 1.0 : 0.0)) * lp[m][p * 10 + n]; gm[m] = pairwise(prod, 0, 100); }
            for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) for (int k = 0; k < D; k++) { int i = m * D + k; double g = gm[m] * f[k] + l2 * W[i]; G[i] += g * g; W[i] -= lr * g / Math.sqrt(G[i]); }
            double[] s = stateVector(st); cnt++; double div = Math.min(cnt, 2000);
            for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) { double delta = s[k] - mu[k]; mu[k] += delta / div; var[k] += (delta * (s[k] - mu[k]) - var[k]) / div; }
            f = null;
        }
        public void write(java.io.DataOutput o) throws java.io.IOException { for (double v : W) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : G) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : mu) o.writeDouble(v); for (double v : var) o.writeDouble(v); o.writeLong(cnt); }
        public void read(java.io.DataInput in) throws java.io.IOException { for (int i = 0; i < W.length; i++) W[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < G.length; i++) G[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < mu.length; i++) mu[i] = in.readDouble(); for (int i = 0; i < var.length; i++) var[i] = in.readDouble(); cnt = in.readLong(); f = null; }
    }
}
```

## `app/src/main/java/com/ethk3/novaonepro/strategyv2/ModelReplaySU2.java`

项目 P05, P19, P26, P36, P39, P48, P49 · 277 行 · sha256 `52456df9522bffeeeb98c4c7ed23f9651b2b535420947a862bd24915dc1e6d5c`

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Complete R13 strategy replay (P18/P19): members -> pool -> optional Sinkhorn ->
 * best position Top3 -> gate (MASS or the META applicability learner) -> block-causal
 * frequency threshold. Every period is computed and settled (hit is defined for
 * every t), which is what the applicability learner trains on.
 *
 * Mirrors foundry13.evaluate() in the Python reference.
 */
public final class ModelReplaySU2 {
    private ModelReplaySU2() {}

    public static final double INFORMATIVE = 0.3 + 1e-6;

    public static final class Result {
        public final boolean[] act, hit; public final int[] position, mask; public final double[] gscore, phat;
        Result(int n) { act = new boolean[n]; hit = new boolean[n]; position = new int[n]; mask = new int[n]; gscore = new double[n]; phat = new double[n]; Arrays.fill(phat, Double.NaN); }
        public int actions(int a, int b) { int n = 0; for (int t = a; t < b; t++) if (act[t]) n++; return n; }
        public int hits(int a, int b) { int n = 0; for (int t = a; t < b; t++) if (act[t] && hit[t]) n++; return n; }
    }

    /** Caches every (kind, parameters) model once per dataset; bounded by bytes (P30 budget). */
    public static final class Library {
        final int[][] draws; final long byteCap; long bytes;
        final LinkedHashMap<String, OnlineModelsSU2.Output> cache = new LinkedHashMap<>(16, .75f, true);
        public Library(int[][] draws, long byteCap) { OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraws(draws); this.draws = draws; this.byteCap = byteCap; }
        public OnlineModelsSU2.Output get(ModelGenomeSU2.Member m) {
            String key = m.modelKey();
            OnlineModelsSU2.Output o = cache.get(key);
            if (o != null) return o;
            o = compute(draws, m.kind, m.params);
            cache.put(key, o); bytes += o.bytes();
            Iterator<Map.Entry<String, OnlineModelsSU2.Output>> it = cache.entrySet().iterator();
            while (bytes > byteCap && cache.size() > 1 && it.hasNext()) { Map.Entry<String, OnlineModelsSU2.Output> e = it.next(); if (e.getKey().equals(key)) continue; bytes -= e.getValue().bytes(); it.remove(); }
            return o;
        }
        final Map<Integer, float[][]> stateSeries = new HashMap<>();
        /** R15 (P45): indicator series of registry state atom j over this history (teacher matrix pool). */
        public float[][] states(int j) { return stateSeries.computeIfAbsent(j, k -> TeacherPoolSU2.states(draws, k)); }
        /** R14 (P36): the member's table temperature-calibrated online (CalibrationSU2), cached separately. */
        public OnlineModelsSU2.Output getCal(ModelGenomeSU2.Member m) {
            String key = m.modelKey() + "|CAL";
            OnlineModelsSU2.Output o = cache.get(key);
            if (o != null) return o;
            OnlineModelsSU2.Output raw = get(m);
            o = new OnlineModelsSU2.Output(CalibrationSU2.calibrate(raw.p, draws), raw.state);
            cache.put(key, o); bytes += (long) o.p.length * 400L;
            Iterator<Map.Entry<String, OnlineModelsSU2.Output>> it = cache.entrySet().iterator();
            while (bytes > byteCap && cache.size() > 2 && it.hasNext()) { Map.Entry<String, OnlineModelsSU2.Output> e = it.next(); if (e.getKey().equals(key) || e.getKey().equals(m.modelKey())) continue; bytes -= e.getValue().bytes(); it.remove(); }
            return o;
        }
        public int[][] draws() { return draws; }
    }

    static double d(Map<String, String> p, String k) { String v = p.get(k); if (v == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_PARAM_MISSING:" + k); return Double.parseDouble(v); }
    static double[] tuple(String s) {
        String t = s.replace("(", "").replace(")", "").trim();
        if (t.endsWith(",")) t = t.substring(0, t.length() - 1);
        String[] f = t.split(",");
        double[] out = new double[f.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < f.length; i++) out[i] = Double.parseDouble(f[i].trim());
        return out;
    }
    /** "()" / "(1,)" / "(1, 2)" -> int[] (empty allowed). */
    static int[] ints(String s) {
        String t = s.replace("(", "").replace(")", "").replace(" ", "");
        if (t.endsWith(",")) t = t.substring(0, t.length() - 1);
        if (t.isEmpty()) return new int[0];
        String[] f = t.split(","); int[] out = new int[f.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < f.length; i++) out[i] = Integer.parseInt(f[i]);
        return out;
    }
    static int[][] pairsOrNone(String s) { return s.replace("(", "").replace(")", "").replace(",", "").trim().isEmpty() ? new int[0][] : pairs(s); }
    static int[][] pairs(String s) {
        double[] flat = tuple(s);
        if (flat.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_SOURCES");
        int[][] out = new int[flat.length / 2][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { out[i][0] = (int) flat[2 * i]; out[i][1] = (int) flat[2 * i + 1]; }
        return out;
    }

    public interface Adapter { OnlineModelsSU2.Model build(Map<String, String> params); }
    /** Adapter kinds registered by the app at start (ProgramModelSU2.register()); the core stays pure Java. */
    public static final Map<String, Adapter> ADAPTERS = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    /** Builds the stepwise model named by a member (same constructor the live loop uses). */
    public static OnlineModelsSU2.Model build(String kind, Map<String, String> p) {
        Adapter adapter = ADAPTERS.get(kind);
        if (adapter != null) return adapter.build(p);
        switch (kind) {
            case "MSDIR": return new OnlineModelsSU2.MsDir(tuple(p.get("scales")), d(p, "alpha"), d(p, "share"));
            case "BOCPD": return new OnlineModelsSU2.Bocpd(d(p, "hazard"), d(p, "alpha"), (int) d(p, "R"));
            case "HMM": return new OnlineModelsSU2.Hmm((int) d(p, "K"), d(p, "stay"), d(p, "lr"), (long) d(p, "seed"), d(p, "temper"));
            case "LOGLIN": return new OnlineModelsSU2.LogLin(pairs(p.get("sources")), d(p, "lr"), d(p, "l2"));
            case "ATOMNET": return AtomNetSU2.of(p);
            case "CONTMAT": return new ContMatSU2();
            case "REGMEM": return new OnlineModelsSU2.RegMem((int) d(p, "K"), d(p, "stay"), d(p, "lr"), (long) d(p, "seed"), d(p, "temper"), 0.05);
            case "RELMEM": return new OnlineModelsSU2.RelMem((int) d(p, "K"), ints(p.get("lags")), pairsOrNone(p.get("sources")), d(p, "stay"), d(p, "lr"), d(p, "l2"), 0.999, d(p, "temper"), (long) d(p, "seed"), 0.05);
            case "KALMAN": return new OnlineModelsSU2.Kalman(d(p, "q_level"), d(p, "q_slope"), 0.09, d(p, "horizon"), d(p, "temp"));
            case "RELBAYES": {
                double[] l = tuple(p.get("lags")); int[] lags = new int[l.length]; for (int i = 0; i < l.length; i++) lags[i] = (int) l[i];
                return new OnlineModelsSU2.RelBayes(lags, d(p, "decay"), d(p, "kappa"), true, 1.0);
            }
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_KIND");
        }
    }

    public static OnlineModelsSU2.Output compute(int[][] draws, String kind, Map<String, String> p) {
        return OnlineModelsSU2.run(build(kind, p), draws);
    }

    /** Member tables (calibrated when the genome says so) -> pool -> optional Sinkhorn. R14: STATIC weights normalised. */
    public static float[][][] pooledTable(ModelGenomeSU2 g, Library lib) {
        int M = g.members.size();
        float[][][][] Ps = new float[M][][][]; float[][][] STs = new float[M][][]; double[] w = new double[M]; double ws = 0;
        for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { OnlineModelsSU2.Output o = g.calibrated ? lib.getCal(g.members.get(m)) : lib.get(g.members.get(m)); Ps[m] = o.p; STs[m] = o.state; w[m] = g.members.get(m).weight; ws += w[m]; }
        if (g.calibrated) for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) w[m] /= ws;
        float[][][] P = M == 1 ? Ps[0] : TeacherPoolSU2.isTeacher(g.pool) ? TeacherPoolSU2.pool(Ps, lib.draws, lib.states(TeacherPoolSU2.stateOf(g.pool)))
            : g.pool.equals("BMA") ? ModelOpsSU2.poolBma(Ps, lib.draws, 0.02, 0.995)
            : g.pool.equals("GATED") ? ModelOpsSU2.poolGated(Ps, STs, lib.draws, 0.03, 1e-3) : ModelOpsSU2.poolStatic(Ps, w);
        if (g.sink) P = ModelOpsSU2.sink(P, 20);
        return P;
    }

    /** A probability table used as a strategy with the confidence gate at `coverage` (block-causal threshold). */
    public static Result evaluateTable(float[][][] P, int[][] draws, double coverage, int startMeta) {
        int T = draws.length; Result r = new Result(T); Integer[] ord = new Integer[10];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            double[] mass = new double[10]; int[][] top = new int[10][3];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                final float[] row = P[t][p];
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) ord[i] = i;
                Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> Double.compare((double) row[b] - b * 1e-12, (double) row[a] - a * 1e-12));
                double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { top[p][i] = ord[i]; s += (double) row[ord[i]]; }
                mass[p] = Math.rint(s * 1e9) / 1e9;
            }
            int p1 = 0; for (int p = 1; p < 10; p++) if (mass[p] > mass[p1]) p1 = p;
            r.position[t] = p1 + 1; r.mask[t] = (1 << top[p1][0]) | (1 << top[p1][1]) | (1 << top[p1][2]);
            int x = draws[t][p1] - 1; r.hit[t] = top[p1][0] == x || top[p1][1] == x || top[p1][2] == x;
            r.gscore[t] = mass[p1]; r.phat[t] = mass[p1];
        }
        // R14: a calibrated table at (or below) chance has nothing to say - never act on it
        if (coverage >= .999) { for (int t = startMeta; t < T; t++) r.act[t] = r.gscore[t] > INFORMATIVE; }
        else for (int b = startMeta; b < T; b += 50) {
            int lo = Math.max(startMeta - 720, b - 720); int n = b - lo;
            if (n < 100) continue;
            double thr = quantileLinear(Arrays.copyOfRange(r.gscore, lo, b), 1 - coverage);
            for (int t = b; t < Math.min(b + 50, T); t++) r.act[t] = r.gscore[t] >= thr && r.gscore[t] > INFORMATIVE;
        }
        return r;
    }

    public static Result evaluate(ModelGenomeSU2 g, Library lib, int startMeta, int window, int refit) {
        int T = lib.draws.length;
        int M = g.members.size();
        float[][][][] Ps = new float[M][][][];
        float[][][] STs = new float[M][][];
        for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) { OnlineModelsSU2.Output o = g.calibrated ? lib.getCal(g.members.get(m)) : lib.get(g.members.get(m)); Ps[m] = o.p; STs[m] = o.state; }
        float[][][] P = pooledTable(g, lib);
        Result r = new Result(T);
        int[][] k3 = new int[T][3]; double[] conf = new double[T], margin = new double[T], ent = new double[T];
        Integer[] ord = new Integer[10];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            double[] mass = new double[10]; int[][] top = new int[10][3];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                final float[] row = P[t][p];
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) ord[i] = i;
                Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> Double.compare((double) row[b] - b * 1e-12, (double) row[a] - a * 1e-12));
                double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { top[p][i] = ord[i]; s += (double) row[ord[i]]; }
                mass[p] = Math.rint(s * 1e9) / 1e9;
            }
            int p1 = 0; for (int p = 1; p < 10; p++) if (mass[p] > mass[p1]) p1 = p;
            int p2 = p1 == 0 ? 1 : 0; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) if (p != p1 && mass[p] > mass[p2]) p2 = p;
            k3[t] = top[p1]; r.position[t] = p1 + 1;
            r.mask[t] = (1 << top[p1][0]) | (1 << top[p1][1]) | (1 << top[p1][2]);
            int x = lib.draws[t][p1] - 1;
            r.hit[t] = top[p1][0] == x || top[p1][1] == x || top[p1][2] == x;
            conf[t] = mass[p1]; margin[t] = mass[p1] - mass[p2];
            double e = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = P[t][p1][n]; e -= v * Math.log(v + 1e-12); } ent[t] = e / Math.log(10);
        }
        if (g.gate.equals("META")) {
            List<double[]> cols = new ArrayList<>();
            cols.add(conf); cols.add(margin); cols.add(ent); cols.add(rollingZ(conf, 720));
            for (int k : new int[]{5, 7}) {
                double[] mean = new double[T], min = new double[T];
                for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
                    double s = 0, mn = 1e9; int p1 = r.position[t] - 1;
                    for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) {
                        final float[] row = Ps[m][t][p1];
                        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) ord[i] = i;
                        Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> Float.compare(row[b], row[a]));
                        int in = 0; for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) if (ord[i] == k3[t][j]) { in++; break; }
                        double sup = in / 3.0; s += sup; mn = Math.min(mn, sup);
                    }
                    mean[t] = s / M; min[t] = mn;
                }
                cols.add(mean); cols.add(min);
            }
            for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) for (int j = 0; j < STs[m][0].length; j++) { double[] c = new double[T]; for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) c[t] = STs[m][t][j]; cols.add(c); }
            for (int half : new int[]{12, 48, 200}) cols.add(emaHits(r.hit, half));
            int F = cols.size();
            double[][] X = new double[T][F];
            for (int j = 0; j < F; j++) { double[] c = cols.get(j); for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) X[t][j] = Double.isFinite(c[t]) ? c[t] : 0.0; }
            double[] wt = null, mu = new double[F], sd = new double[F]; int last = Integer.MIN_VALUE / 2;
            for (int t = startMeta; t < T; t++) {
                if (wt == null || t - last >= refit) {
                    int lo = Math.max(0, t - window), n = t - lo;
                    if (n >= 400) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < F; j++) { double s = 0; for (int i = lo; i < t; i++) s += X[i][j]; mu[j] = s / n; double v = 0; for (int i = lo; i < t; i++) { double q = X[i][j] - mu[j]; v += q * q; } sd[j] = Math.sqrt(v / n) + 1e-9; }
                        double[][] Z = new double[n][F]; double[] y = new double[n];
                        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < F; j++) Z[i][j] = (X[lo + i][j] - mu[j]) / sd[j]; y[i] = r.hit[lo + i] ? 1 : 0; }
                        wt = LogisticRidgeSU2.fit(Z, y, n, g.metaC, 12); last = t;
                    }
                }
                if (wt != null) {
                    double z = wt[0]; for (int j = 0; j < F; j++) z += (X[t][j] - mu[j]) / sd[j] * wt[j + 1];
                    z = Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, z));
                    r.phat[t] = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-z));
                }
            }
            for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) r.gscore[t] = Double.isNaN(r.phat[t]) ? -1.0 : r.phat[t];
        } else {
            for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) { r.gscore[t] = conf[t]; r.phat[t] = conf[t]; }
        }
        final boolean chanceGuard = g.calibrated && g.gate.equals("MASS");     // R14: never act on a chance-level table
        if (g.coverage >= .999) { for (int t = startMeta; t < T; t++) r.act[t] = !chanceGuard || r.gscore[t] > INFORMATIVE; }
        else for (int b = startMeta; b < T; b += 50) {
            int lo = Math.max(g.gate.equals("META") ? startMeta : startMeta - 720, b - 720);
            double[] hist = new double[b - lo]; int n = 0;
            for (int t = lo; t < b; t++) if (r.gscore[t] > -1) hist[n++] = r.gscore[t];
            if (n < 100) continue;
            double thr = quantileLinear(Arrays.copyOf(hist, n), 1 - g.coverage);
            for (int t = b; t < Math.min(b + 50, T); t++) r.act[t] = r.gscore[t] >= thr && r.gscore[t] > -1 && (!chanceGuard || r.gscore[t] > INFORMATIVE);
        }
        return r;
    }

    static double quantileLinear(double[] x, double q) {
        Arrays.sort(x); double pos = (x.length - 1) * q; int i = (int) Math.floor(pos);
        return i + 1 < x.length ? x[i] + (pos - i) * (x[i + 1] - x[i]) : x[i];
    }

    static double[] emaHits(boolean[] hit, int half) {
        double a = 1.0 - Math.pow(0.5, 1.0 / half), v = 0.3; double[] out = new double[hit.length];
        for (int t = 0; t < hit.length; t++) { out[t] = v; v = (1 - a) * v + a * (hit[t] ? 1.0 : 0.0); }
        return out;
    }

    static double[] rollingZ(double[] v, int w) {
        int T = v.length; double[] c1 = new double[T + 1], c2 = new double[T + 1], z = new double[T];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) { c1[t + 1] = c1[t] + v[t]; c2[t + 1] = c2[t] + v[t] * v[t]; }
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            int lo = Math.max(t - w, 0), n = Math.max(t - lo, 1);
            double mu = (c1[t] - c1[lo]) / n, var = Math.max((c2[t] - c2[lo]) / n - mu * mu, 1e-12);
            double s = (v[t] - mu) / Math.sqrt(var);
            z[t] = t < 30 ? 0 : Math.max(-6, Math.min(6, s));
        }
        return z;
    }

    /** Frequency-aware stability fitness (P26): shrunk fold rates, mean - 0.25 spread, frequency floor. */
    public static double fitness(Result r, int a, int b, int folds, double minCov, double kappa) {
        double[] v = new double[folds]; int nAll = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < folds; f++) {
            int x = a + (int) Math.floor((b - a) * (double) f / folds), y = a + (int) Math.floor((b - a) * (double) (f + 1) / folds);
            int n = r.actions(x, y), k = r.hits(x, y); nAll += n;
            v[f] = (k + 0.3 * kappa) / (n + kappa);
        }
        double mean = 0, mx = -1, mn = 2; for (double q : v) { mean += q; mx = Math.max(mx, q); mn = Math.min(mn, q); }
        mean /= folds;
        double cov = nAll / (double) (b - a), pen = cov >= minCov ? 0 : (minCov - cov) * 2;
        return mean - 0.25 * (mx - mn) - pen;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Durable form of the continuing evolution (P23): population, Hall of Fame, tier champions, director memory. */
public final class ModelStateCodecSU2 {
    private ModelStateCodecSU2() {}
    /** R16 (P48): same layout as R15; the new magic keeps an R15 build from loading genomes with REGMEM / RELMEM members. */
    static final int MAGIC_R13 = 0x53553213, MAGIC_R14 = 0x53553214, MAGIC_R15 = 0x53553215, MAGIC = 0x53553216, MAX = 4 << 20;

    public static byte[] encode(ModelEvolutionSU2.State s) {
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try (DataOutputStream out = new DataOutputStream(new GZIPOutputStream(bytes))) {
                out.writeInt(MAGIC);
                writeList(out, s.population); writeList(out, s.hallOfFame);
                out.writeInt(s.tiers.size()); for (Map.Entry<String, ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked> e : s.tiers.entrySet()) { out.writeUTF(e.getKey()); writeRanked(out, e.getValue()); }
                out.writeBoolean(s.champion != null); if (s.champion != null) writeRanked(out, s.champion);
                writeStats(out, s.kindStats); writeStats(out, s.opStats);
                out.writeInt(s.effectiveGenerations);
                int notes = Math.min(200, s.repairNotes.size()); out.writeInt(notes);
                for (int i = s.repairNotes.size() - notes; i < s.repairNotes.size(); i++) out.writeUTF(s.repairNotes.get(i));
                out.writeInt(s.committees.size());                            // R14: committee champions per tier
                for (Map.Entry<String, CommitteeSU2> e : s.committees.entrySet()) { out.writeUTF(e.getKey()); writeLong(out, e.getValue().text()); }
                out.writeDouble(s.committeeJudge);
                out.writeInt(s.atomPrior.size());                              // R15: research memory (atom prior)
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, double[]> e : s.atomPrior.entrySet()) { out.writeInt(e.getKey()); out.writeDouble(e.getValue()[0]); out.writeDouble(e.getValue()[1]); }
                out.writeInt(s.priorSeen.size()); for (String k : s.priorSeen) writeLong(out, k);
            }
            byte[] b = bytes.toByteArray();
            if (b.length > MAX) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_EVOLUTION_STATE_TOO_LARGE");
            return b;
        } catch (IOException impossible) { throw new IllegalStateException(impossible); }
    }

    public static ModelEvolutionSU2.State decode(byte[] blob) throws IOException {
        if (blob == null || blob.length > MAX) throw new IOException("SU2_EVOLUTION_STATE_SIZE");
        ModelEvolutionSU2.State s = new ModelEvolutionSU2.State();
        try (DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(blob)))) {
            int magic = in.readInt();
            if (magic != MAGIC && magic != MAGIC_R15 && magic != MAGIC_R14 && magic != MAGIC_R13) throw new IOException("SU2_EVOLUTION_STATE_MAGIC");
            readList(in, s.population); readList(in, s.hallOfFame);
            int n = in.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 3) throw new IOException("SU2_TIERS");
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s.tiers.put(in.readUTF(), readRanked(in));
            if (in.readBoolean()) s.champion = readRanked(in);
            readStats(in, s.kindStats); readStats(in, s.opStats);
            s.effectiveGenerations = in.readInt();
            int notes = in.readInt(); if (notes < 0 || notes > 200) throw new IOException("SU2_NOTES");
            for (int i = 0; i < notes; i++) s.repairNotes.add(in.readUTF());
            if (magic == MAGIC || magic == MAGIC_R15 || magic == MAGIC_R14) {
                int nc = in.readInt(); if (nc < 0 || nc > 3) throw new IOException("SU2_COMMITTEES");
                for (int i = 0; i < nc; i++) s.committees.put(in.readUTF(), CommitteeSU2.parse(readLong(in)));
                s.committeeJudge = in.readDouble();
            }
            if (magic == MAGIC || magic == MAGIC_R15) {
                int np = in.readInt(); if (np < 0 || np > 10000) throw new IOException("SU2_PRIOR");
                for (int i = 0; i < np; i++) { int k = in.readInt(); s.atomPrior.put(k, new double[]{in.readDouble(), in.readDouble()}); }
                int ns = in.readInt(); if (ns < 0 || ns > 100000) throw new IOException("SU2_PRIOR_SEEN");
                for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) s.priorSeen.add(readLong(in));
            }
        }
        return s;
    }

    /** Committee texts can exceed writeUTF's 64 KB-safe range on future sizes; length-prefixed UTF-8. */
    static void writeLong(DataOutput o, String s) throws IOException { byte[] b = s.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8); o.writeInt(b.length); o.write(b); }
    static String readLong(DataInput in) throws IOException { int n = in.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 65536) throw new IOException("SU2_TEXT"); byte[] b = new byte[n]; in.readFully(b); return new String(b, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }

    static void writeRanked(DataOutput o, ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked r) throws IOException { o.writeUTF(r.g.text()); o.writeUTF(r.origin); o.writeUTF(r.parent); o.writeUTF(r.note); }
    static ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked readRanked(DataInput in) throws IOException {
        ModelGenomeSU2 g = ModelGenomeSU2.parse(in.readUTF());
        return new ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked(g, in.readUTF(), in.readUTF(), in.readUTF());
    }
    static void writeList(DataOutput o, List<ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked> l) throws IOException { o.writeInt(l.size()); for (ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked r : l) writeRanked(o, r); }
    static void readList(DataInput in, List<ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked> l) throws IOException { int n = in.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 256) throw new IOException("SU2_LIST"); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) l.add(readRanked(in)); }
    static void writeStats(DataOutput o, Map<String, double[]> m) throws IOException { o.writeInt(m.size()); for (Map.Entry<String, double[]> e : m.entrySet()) { o.writeUTF(e.getKey()); o.writeDouble(e.getValue()[0]); o.writeDouble(e.getValue()[1]); } }
    static void readStats(DataInput in, Map<String, double[]> m) throws IOException { int n = in.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 64) throw new IOException("SU2_STATS"); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) m.put(in.readUTF(), new double[]{in.readDouble(), in.readDouble()}); }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Persistence for SU2 (P06/P07/P23/P30). Every write runs inside the single research writer transaction. */
public final class ModelStoreSU2 {
    private ModelStoreSU2() {}

    static void writer(SQLiteDatabase db) { if (!db.inTransaction()) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_WRITER_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED"); }

    static boolean exists(SQLiteDatabase db, String sql, String... args) { try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery(sql, args)) { return c.moveToFirst(); } }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- genomes / lineage
    /** R14: a committee champion is stored like a genome (its canonical text starts with SU2C|) and joins the league. */
    public static void saveCommittee(SQLiteDatabase db, CommitteeSU2 c, String tier, String campaign, long seq, double judge, long now) {
        writer(db);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_model_genome(genome_key,canonical_text,formula,tier,origin_op,parent_key,repair_note,born_campaign,born_sequence,dev_fitness,val_fitness,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            new Object[]{c.key(), c.text(), c.formula(), tier, "COMMITTEE", null, "", campaign, seq, null, judge, "LEAGUE", now});
    }

    public static void saveGenome(SQLiteDatabase db, ModelEvolutionSU2.Ranked r, String campaign, long seq, double dev, double val, String state, long now) {
        writer(db);
        // minSdk 21 ships SQLite 3.8: no UPSERT. Insert once, then update scores; LEAGUE/RETIRED are sticky.
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_model_genome(genome_key,canonical_text,formula,tier,origin_op,parent_key,repair_note,born_campaign,born_sequence,dev_fitness,val_fitness,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            new Object[]{r.g.key(), r.g.text(), r.g.formula(), ModelEvolutionSU2.tierOf(r.g), r.origin, r.parent.isEmpty() ? null : r.parent,
                r.note.length() > 512 ? r.note.substring(0, 512) : r.note, campaign, seq, dev, val, state, now});
        db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_model_genome SET dev_fitness=?,val_fitness=?,state=CASE WHEN state IN ('RETIRED','LEAGUE') THEN state ELSE ? END WHERE genome_key=?",
            new Object[]{dev, val, state, r.g.key()});
        if (!r.parent.isEmpty()) db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_lineage(child_key,parent_key,op,campaign_id,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", new Object[]{r.g.key(), r.parent, r.origin, campaign, r.note});
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- evolution state
    public static ModelEvolutionSU2.State loadEvolution(SQLiteDatabase db) throws IOException {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT state_blob FROM su2_evolution_state WHERE singleton=1", null)) {
            return c.moveToFirst() ? ModelStateCodecSU2.decode(c.getBlob(0)) : new ModelEvolutionSU2.State();
        }
    }
    public static void saveEvolution(SQLiteDatabase db, String campaign, ModelEvolutionSU2.State s, long now) {
        writer(db); byte[] b = ModelStateCodecSU2.encode(s);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO su2_evolution_state(singleton,campaign_id,state_blob,byte_count,updated_at) VALUES(1,?,?,?,?)", new Object[]{campaign, b, b.length, now});
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- live states (checkpointed, P06)
    public static byte[] liveBlob(SQLiteDatabase db, String owner, long[] through) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT through_sequence,state_blob FROM su2_live_state WHERE owner=?", new String[]{owner})) {
            if (!c.moveToFirst()) return null; through[0] = c.getLong(0); return c.getBlob(1);
        }
    }
    public static void saveLive(SQLiteDatabase db, String owner, long through, byte[] blob, long now) {
        writer(db);
        if (blob.length > 16 << 20) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_LIVE_STATE_TOO_LARGE:" + owner);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO su2_live_state(owner,through_sequence,state_blob,byte_count,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", new Object[]{owner, through, blob, blob.length, now});
    }
    public static byte[] gzip(byte[] raw) { try { ByteArrayOutputStream b = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); try (GZIPOutputStream z = new GZIPOutputStream(b)) { z.write(raw); } return b.toByteArray(); } catch (IOException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); } }
    public static byte[] gunzip(byte[] z) throws IOException { try (GZIPInputStream in = new GZIPInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(z)); ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) { byte[] buf = new byte[65536]; int n; while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) { out.write(buf, 0, n); if (out.size() > 64 << 20) throw new IOException("SU2_LIVE_STATE_INFLATE_LIMIT"); } return out.toByteArray(); } }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- decisions (every period, acted or not)
    public static void insertDecision(SQLiteDatabase db, String genome, long seq, ModelLiveSU2.Decision d, long frozenAt, long openTime) {
        writer(db);
        if (frozenAt >= openTime) throw new IllegalStateException("SU2_DECISION_AFTER_OPEN");
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_live_decision(genome_key,sequence_ordinal,position,number_mask,act,gscore,phat,frozen_at,target_open_time) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            new Object[]{genome, seq, d.position, d.mask, d.act ? 1 : 0, Double.isNaN(d.gscore) ? -1.0 : d.gscore, Double.isNaN(d.phat) ? null : d.phat, frozenAt, openTime});
    }
    /** Inside the settlement owner transaction: every frozen decision of this period gets its label. */
    public static int settle(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq, int[] draw, long completedAt) {
        writer(db);
        Object[] a = new Object[13]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) a[p] = draw[p]; a[10] = completedAt; a[11] = seq; a[12] = completedAt;
        db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_live_decision SET hit=(number_mask>>(CASE position WHEN 1 THEN ? WHEN 2 THEN ? WHEN 3 THEN ? WHEN 4 THEN ? WHEN 5 THEN ? WHEN 6 THEN ? WHEN 7 THEN ? WHEN 8 THEN ? WHEN 9 THEN ? ELSE ? END-1))&1,settled_at=? WHERE sequence_ordinal=? AND hit IS NULL AND target_open_time<=?", a);
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT changes()", null)) { return c.moveToFirst() ? c.getInt(0) : 0; }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- league
    public static void joinLeague(SQLiteDatabase db, String memberId, String kind, String name, String genome, long seq) {
        writer(db);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_league(member_id,kind,name,genome_key,joined_sequence) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", new Object[]{memberId, kind, name, genome, seq});
        if (genome != null) db.execSQL("UPDATE su2_model_genome SET state='LEAGUE' WHERE genome_key=? AND state<>'RETIRED'", new Object[]{genome});
    }
    public static List<String[]> league(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        List<String[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT member_id,kind,name,coalesce(genome_key,''),joined_sequence FROM su2_league WHERE state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY member_id", null)) { while (c.moveToNext()) out.add(new String[]{c.getString(0), c.getString(1), c.getString(2), c.getString(3), String.valueOf(c.getLong(4))}); }
        return out;
    }
    /** act/hit arrays indexed by (sequence - from); missing periods are "not acted" (MISSING is reported separately). */
    public static boolean[][] record(SQLiteDatabase db, String genome, long from, long to) {
        int n = (int) (to - from); boolean[] act = new boolean[n], hit = new boolean[n];
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT sequence_ordinal,act,hit FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal>=? AND sequence_ordinal<? AND hit IS NOT NULL",
            new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(from), String.valueOf(to)})) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) { int i = (int) (c.getLong(0) - from); act[i] = c.getInt(1) == 1; hit[i] = c.getInt(2) == 1; }
        }
        return new boolean[][]{act, hit};
    }
    public static void recordChoice(SQLiteDatabase db, long from, MainlinePolicySU2.Choice ch, long windowStart, long now) {
        writer(db);
        db.execSQL("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO su2_mainline_choice(from_sequence,member_id,score,incumbent_score,reason,window_start,chosen_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            new Object[]{from, ch.member.id, ch.score, Double.isNaN(ch.incumbentScore) ? null : ch.incumbentScore, ch.reason, windowStart, now});
    }
    public static String currentChoice(SQLiteDatabase db, long seq) {
        try (Cursor c = db.rawQuery("SELECT member_id FROM su2_mainline_choice WHERE from_sequence<=? ORDER BY from_sequence DESC LIMIT 1", new String[]{String.valueOf(seq)})) { return c.moveToFirst() ? c.getString(0) : ""; }
    }
}
```
