```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * R13 online mathematical models (P13-P17), stepwise.
 *
 * Every model is a state machine with two operations:
 *   predict(p, st)  - probability table for the NEXT draw and a causal state
 *                     description, from draws already settled;
 *   update(draw)    - training/settlement/feedback with the settled draw.
 * The phone calls predict() before the draw and update() inside the settlement
 * transaction - every period, for every model, whether or not anything acts.
 * Historical replay uses exactly the same code (batch = predict/update loop), so
 * history training and live training cannot diverge.
 *
 * Bit-level contract with reference/replay/models.py (double intermediates,
 * float storage). Parity: OnlineModelsSU2Test; live==replay: ModelLiveSU2Test.
 */
public final class OnlineModelsSU2 {
    private OnlineModelsSU2() {}

    public interface Model {
        int stateWidth();
        void predict(float[][] p, float[] st);
        void update(int[] draw);
        void write(DataOutput out) throws IOException;
        void read(DataInput in) throws IOException;
    }

    public static final class Output {
        public final float[][][] p; public final float[][] state;
        Output(int t, int s) { p = new float[t][10][10]; state = new float[t][s]; }
        Output(float[][][] p, float[][] state) { this.p = p; this.state = state; }
        public long bytes() { return (long) p.length * 100L * 4L + (long) state.length * state[0].length * 4L; }
    }

    static void requireDraws(int[][] d) {
        if (d == null || d.length < 1 || d.length > 20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_MODEL_DRAWS");
        for (int[] row : d) requireDraw(row);
    }
    static void requireDraw(int[] row) {
        if (row == null || row.length != 10) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_MODEL_DRAW_WIDTH");
        int seen = 0;
        for (int v : row) { if (v < 1 || v > 10 || (seen & (1 << v)) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_MODEL_DRAW_PERMUTATION"); seen |= 1 << v; }
    }

    public static Output run(Model m, int[][] d) {
        requireDraws(d);
        Output out = new Output(d.length, m.stateWidth());
        for (int t = 0; t < d.length; t++) { m.predict(out.p[t], out.state[t]); m.update(d[t]); }
        return out;
    }

    static void writeArr(DataOutput o, double[] a) throws IOException { o.writeInt(a.length); for (double v : a) o.writeDouble(v); }
    static void readArr(DataInput in, double[] a) throws IOException { if (in.readInt() != a.length) throw new IOException("SU2_MODEL_STATE_SHAPE"); for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] = in.readDouble(); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ MSDIR
    /** Multi-scale forgetting Dirichlet-categorical, Bayesian averaging + fixed share over memory scales. */
    public static final class MsDir implements Model {
        final double[] scales, mem; final double alpha, share; final int S;
        final double[] c, logw;            // c[s][p][n] flattened, logw[s][p]
        final double[] pred, w;
        public MsDir(double[] scales, double alpha, double share) {
            this.scales = scales.clone(); this.alpha = alpha; this.share = share; S = scales.length;
            if (S < 1 || S > 8) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_MSDIR_SCALES");
            c = new double[S * 100]; logw = new double[S * 10]; pred = new double[S * 100]; w = new double[S * 10];
            Arrays.fill(logw, -Math.log(S));
            mem = new double[S];
            for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) mem[s] = scales[s] < 1 ? 1.0 / Math.max(1e-9, 1.0 - scales[s]) : 5000.0;
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private void computePred() {
            for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double sum = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) sum += c[s * 100 + p * 10 + n];
                double den = sum + 10 * alpha;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) pred[s * 100 + p * 10 + n] = (c[s * 100 + p * 10 + n] + alpha) / den;
            }
        }
        private void normalise() {
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) m = Math.max(m, logw[s * 10 + p]);
                double z = 0; for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { w[s * 10 + p] = Math.exp(logw[s * 10 + p] - m); z += w[s * 10 + p]; }
                for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) w[s * 10 + p] /= z;
            }
        }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            computePred(); normalise();
            double ent = 0, lm = 0, pmax = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double e = 0, m = 0;
                for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { double ws = w[s * 10 + p]; e -= ws * Math.log(ws + 1e-12); m += ws * mem[s]; }
                ent += e; lm += Math.log(m);
                double best = -1;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) v += w[s * 10 + p] * pred[s * 100 + p * 10 + n]; out[p][n] = (float) v; best = Math.max(best, (float) v); }
                pmax += best;
            }
            st[0] = (float) (ent / 10.0 / Math.log(S)); st[1] = (float) (lm / 10.0); st[2] = (float) (pmax / 10.0);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            computePred(); normalise();
            for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) logw[s * 10 + p] += Math.log(pred[s * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1]);
            normalise();
            for (int i = 0; i < S * 10; i++) { w[i] = (1 - share) * w[i] + share / S; logw[i] = Math.log(w[i]); }
            for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) c[s * 100 + i] *= scales[s];
                for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c[s * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1] += 1.0;
            }
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, c); writeArr(o, logw); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, c); readArr(in, logw); }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ BOCPD
    /** Adams-MacKay change-point detection, Dirichlet-categorical per position, run length truncated at R. */
    public static final class Bocpd implements Model {
        final double hazard, alpha; final int R;
        double[] r, C, nC; final double[] l;
        public Bocpd(double hazard, double alpha, int R) {
            if (R < 8 || R > 512 || !(hazard > 0 && hazard < 1)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_BOCPD_PARAMS");
            this.hazard = hazard; this.alpha = alpha; this.R = R;
            r = new double[10 * R]; C = new double[10 * R * 10]; nC = new double[10 * R * 10]; l = new double[10 * R];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) r[p * R] = 1.0;
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            double recent = 0, elr = 0, pmax = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double[] acc = new double[10];
                for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) {
                    int base = (p * R + k) * 10; double n = 0; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) n += C[base + v];
                    double den = n + 10 * alpha, rk = r[p * R + k];
                    for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) acc[v] += rk * ((C[base + v] + alpha) / den);
                }
                double best = -1; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { out[p][v] = (float) acc[v]; best = Math.max(best, (float) acc[v]); }
                pmax += best;
                double s10 = 0, e = 0; for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) { if (k < 10) s10 += r[p * R + k]; e += r[p * R + k] * k; }
                recent += s10; elr += Math.log1p(e);
            }
            st[0] = (float) (recent / 10.0); st[1] = (float) (elr / 10.0); st[2] = (float) (pmax / 10.0);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                int x = d[p] - 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) { int base = (p * R + k) * 10; double n = 0; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) n += C[base + v]; l[p * R + k] = (C[base + x] + alpha) / (n + 10 * alpha); }
                double cp = 0; double[] grow = new double[R];
                for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) { double g = r[p * R + k] * l[p * R + k]; cp += g; grow[k] = g * (1 - hazard); }
                cp *= hazard;
                double[] nr = new double[R]; nr[0] = cp; for (int k = 1; k < R; k++) nr[k] = grow[k - 1]; nr[R - 1] += grow[R - 1];
                double z = 0; for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) z += nr[k];
                for (int k = 0; k < R; k++) r[p * R + k] = nr[k] / z;
                for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) nC[(p * R) * 10 + v] = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k < R; k++) for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) nC[(p * R + k) * 10 + v] = C[(p * R + k - 1) * 10 + v];
                for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) nC[(p * R + R - 1) * 10 + v] += C[(p * R + R - 1) * 10 + v];
                for (int k = 1; k < R; k++) nC[(p * R + k) * 10 + x] += 1.0;
            }
            double[] tmp = C; C = nC; nC = tmp;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, r); writeArr(o, C); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, r); readArr(in, C); }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------- HMM
    /** Whole-draw hidden regime model: K states with own 10x10 emissions, online EM with forgetting. */
    public static final class Hmm implements Model {
        final int K; final double stay, lr, temper; final double[] E, A, a, pi, ll;
        public Hmm(int K, double stay, double lr, long seed, double temper) {
            if (K < 2 || K > 6) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_HMM_K");
            this.K = K; this.stay = stay; this.lr = lr; this.temper = temper;
            double[] z = DeterministicRandomSU2.normals(seed, K * 100);
            E = new double[K * 100];
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double sum = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] = 0.1 * Math.exp(0.05 * z[k * 100 + p * 10 + n]); sum += E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n]; }
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] /= sum;
            }
            A = new double[K * K];
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) A[i * K + j] = i == j ? stay : (1 - stay) / Math.max(1, K - 1);
            a = new double[K]; Arrays.fill(a, 1.0 / K); pi = new double[K]; ll = new double[K];
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private void prior() { for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) { double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) s += a[i] * A[i * K + j]; pi[j] = s; } }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            prior();
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) v += pi[k] * E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n]; out[p][n] = (float) v; }
            double mx = -1, ent = 0; int arg = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { if (pi[k] > mx) { mx = pi[k]; arg = k; } ent -= pi[k] * Math.log(pi[k] + 1e-12); }
            st[0] = (float) mx; st[1] = (float) (ent / Math.log(K)); st[2] = (float) (arg / (double) Math.max(1, K - 1));
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            prior();
            double lmax = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { double s = 0; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) s += Math.log(E[k * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1]); ll[k] = temper * s; lmax = Math.max(lmax, ll[k]); }
            double z = 0; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { a[k] = pi[k] * Math.exp(ll[k] - lmax); z += a[k]; }
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) a[k] /= z;
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { double g = lr * a[k]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] *= (1 - g); E[k * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1] += g; } }
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, E); writeArr(o, a); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, E); readArr(in, a); }
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- R16 regime memory (P48)
    /**
     * REGMEM: hidden regimes with an ANCHORED null state (uniform, never updated) and K learned regime patterns; a
     * pattern moves only with its own posterior, so it survives while its regime is absent and is recognised as soon
     * as it returns (regmem.regmem in the Python reference). State: (null posterior, entropy over the active states,
     * strongest active posterior).
     */
    public static final class RegMem implements Model {
        final int K, S1; final double stay, lr, temper; final double[] E, A, a, pi, ll;
        public RegMem(int K, double stay, double lr, long seed, double temper, double init) {
            if (K < 1 || K > 6) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_REGMEM_K");
            this.K = K; S1 = K + 1; this.stay = stay; this.lr = lr; this.temper = temper;
            double[] z = DeterministicRandomSU2.normals(seed, K * 100);
            E = new double[S1 * 100];
            for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0.1; if (k > 0) v *= Math.exp(init * z[(k - 1) * 100 + p * 10 + n]); E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] = v; }
                sum = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(E, k * 100 + p * 10, 10);
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] /= sum;
            }
            A = new double[S1 * S1];
            for (int i = 0; i < S1; i++) for (int j = 0; j < S1; j++) A[i * S1 + j] = i == j ? stay : (1 - stay) / K;
            a = new double[S1]; Arrays.fill(a, 1.0 / S1); pi = new double[S1]; ll = new double[S1];
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private void prior() { for (int j = 0; j < S1; j++) { double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < S1; i++) s += a[i] * A[i * S1 + j]; pi[j] = s; } }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            prior();
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) v += pi[k] * E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n]; out[p][n] = (float) v; }
            regimeState(pi, K, st);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            prior();
            double lmax = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
            double[] lg = new double[10];
            for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) { for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) lg[p] = Math.log(E[k * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1]); ll[k] = temper * ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(lg, 0, 10); lmax = Math.max(lmax, ll[k]); }
            double z = 0; for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) { a[k] = pi[k] * Math.exp(ll[k] - lmax); z += a[k]; }
            for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) a[k] /= z;
            for (int k = 1; k < S1; k++) { double g = lr * a[k]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] *= (1 - g); E[k * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1] += g; } }
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, E); writeArr(o, a); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, E); readArr(in, a); }
    }

    static void regimeState(double[] pi, int K, float[] st) {
        double s = 0, mx = 0; for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) { s += pi[k]; mx = Math.max(mx, pi[k]); }
        double den = Math.max(1e-12, s), ent = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) { double v = pi[k] / den; ent -= v * Math.log(v + 1e-12); }
        st[0] = (float) pi[0]; st[1] = (float) (ent / Math.log(Math.max(2, K))); st[2] = (float) mx;
    }

    /**
     * RELMEM: relation-regime memory - anchored null state + K active states whose emission is CONDITIONAL on earlier
     * draws: z_k[p,n] = b_k[p,n] + sum_{l,q,f} w_k[p,l,q,f] [n == f(D[t-l,q])] (f = SAME/PLUS1/MINUS1/MIRROR)
     * + sum_s V_k[s,p,D[t-lag_s,p+off_s],n] (arbitrary learned maps for chosen sources). Posterior-weighted,
     * RMS-normalised online gradient (regmem.relmem in the Python reference).
     */
    public static final class RelMem implements Model {
        final int K, S1, L, S, maxlag; final int[] lags; final int[][] sources; final double stay, lr, l2, gd, temper;
        final double[] b, Ab, W, AW, V, AV, A, a, pi, ll, E, g; final int[][] recent; final int[] tg, av; int seen;
        public RelMem(int K, int[] lags, int[][] sources, double stay, double lr, double l2, double gd, double temper, long seed, double init) {
            if (K < 1 || K > 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_RELMEM_K");
            int ml = 0;
            for (int l : lags) { if (l < 1 || l > 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_RELMEM_LAG"); ml = Math.max(ml, l); }
            for (int[] s : sources) { if (s[0] < 0 || s[0] > 9 || s[1] < 1 || s[1] > 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_RELMEM_SOURCE"); ml = Math.max(ml, s[1]); }
            this.K = K; S1 = K + 1; this.lags = lags.clone(); L = lags.length; S = sources.length; maxlag = ml;
            this.sources = new int[S][]; for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) this.sources[i] = sources[i].clone();
            this.stay = stay; this.lr = lr; this.l2 = l2; this.gd = gd; this.temper = temper;
            double[] z = DeterministicRandomSU2.normals(seed, K * 100);
            b = new double[K * 100]; for (int i = 0; i < K * 100; i++) b[i] = init * z[i];
            Ab = new double[K * 100]; Arrays.fill(Ab, 1e-3);
            W = new double[K * 10 * L * 10 * 4]; AW = new double[W.length]; Arrays.fill(AW, 1e-3);
            V = new double[K * S * 1000]; AV = new double[V.length]; Arrays.fill(AV, 1e-3);
            A = new double[S1 * S1];
            for (int i = 0; i < S1; i++) for (int j = 0; j < S1; j++) A[i * S1 + j] = i == j ? stay : (1 - stay) / K;
            a = new double[S1]; Arrays.fill(a, 1.0 / S1); pi = new double[S1]; ll = new double[S1];
            E = new double[K * 100]; g = new double[K * 100];
            recent = new int[Math.max(1, maxlag)][10]; tg = new int[L * 40]; av = new int[S * 10];
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private boolean ready() { return seen >= maxlag; }
        private int[] lagged(int lag) { return recent[(seen - lag) % maxlag]; }
        private void prior() { for (int j = 0; j < S1; j++) { double s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < S1; i++) s += a[i] * A[i * S1 + j]; pi[j] = s; } }
        private void emissions() {
            boolean r = ready();
            if (r) {
                for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) { int[] src = lagged(lags[l]); for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) { int s = src[q] - 1, o = (l * 10 + q) * 4; tg[o] = s; tg[o + 1] = (s + 1) % 10; tg[o + 2] = (s + 9) % 10; tg[o + 3] = 9 - s; } }
                for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { int[] src = lagged(sources[s][1]); for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) av[s * 10 + p] = src[(p + sources[s][0]) % 10] - 1; }
            }
            double[] zz = new double[10];
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) zz[n] = b[k * 100 + p * 10 + n];
                if (r) {
                    double[] add = new double[10];
                    for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) add[tg[(l * 10 + q) * 4 + f]] += W[(((k * 10 + p) * L + l) * 10 + q) * 4 + f];
                    if (L > 0) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) zz[n] += add[n];
                    if (S > 0) { double[] vs = new double[10]; for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { int base = (((k * S + s) * 10 + p) * 10 + av[s * 10 + p]) * 10; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) vs[n] += V[base + n]; } for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) zz[n] += vs[n]; }
                }
                double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) m = Math.max(m, zz[n]);
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] = Math.exp(zz[n] - m);
                double sum = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(E, k * 100 + p * 10, 10);
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] /= sum;
            }
        }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            emissions(); prior();
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = 0; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) v += pi[k + 1] * E[k * 100 + p * 10 + n]; out[p][n] = (float) (pi[0] * 0.1 + v); }
            regimeState(pi, K, st);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            emissions(); prior();
            ll[0] = 10 * Math.log(0.1) * temper; double lmax = ll[0];
            double[] lg = new double[10];
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) lg[p] = Math.log(E[k * 100 + p * 10 + d[p] - 1]); ll[k + 1] = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(lg, 0, 10) * temper; lmax = Math.max(lmax, ll[k + 1]); }
            double z = 0; for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) { a[k] = pi[k] * Math.exp(ll[k] - lmax); z += a[k]; }
            for (int k = 0; k < S1; k++) a[k] /= z;
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { int i = k * 100 + p * 10 + n; g[i] = (E[i] - (n == d[p] - 1 ? 1.0 : 0.0)) * a[k + 1]; }
            for (int i = 0; i < K * 100; i++) { double gb = g[i] + l2 * b[i]; Ab[i] = gd * Ab[i] + gb * gb; b[i] -= lr * gb / Math.sqrt(Ab[i]); }
            if (ready()) {
                for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int l = 0; l < L; l++) for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                    int i = (((k * 10 + p) * L + l) * 10 + q) * 4 + f; double gw = g[k * 100 + p * 10 + tg[(l * 10 + q) * 4 + f]] + l2 * W[i];
                    AW[i] = gd * AW[i] + gw * gw; W[i] -= lr * gw / Math.sqrt(AW[i]);
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                    int base = (((k * S + s) * 10 + p) * 10 + av[s * 10 + p]) * 10;
                    for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double cur = V[base + n], gv = g[k * 100 + p * 10 + n] + l2 * cur; AV[base + n] = gd * AV[base + n] + gv * gv; V[base + n] = cur - lr * gv / Math.sqrt(AV[base + n]); }
                }
            }
            if (maxlag > 0) System.arraycopy(d, 0, recent[seen % maxlag], 0, 10);
            seen++;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
            writeArr(o, b); writeArr(o, Ab); writeArr(o, W); writeArr(o, AW); writeArr(o, V); writeArr(o, AV); writeArr(o, a);
            o.writeInt(seen); for (int[] r : recent) for (int v : r) o.writeByte(v);
        }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException {
            readArr(in, b); readArr(in, Ab); readArr(in, W); readArr(in, AW); readArr(in, V); readArr(in, AV); readArr(in, a);
            seen = in.readInt(); for (int[] r : recent) for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) r[i] = in.readByte();
        }
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- LOGLIN
    /** Cross-position causal log-linear model, online AdaGrad + L2. sources[i] = {offset, lag}. Keeps the last maxlag draws. */
    public static final class LogLin implements Model {
        final int[][] sources; final double lr, l2; final int S, maxlag;
        final double[] b, Gb, W, GW; final int[][] recent; int seen;
        final double[] pr = new double[100]; final int[] idx;
        public LogLin(int[][] sources, double lr, double l2) {
            this.sources = new int[sources.length][]; int ml = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < sources.length; i++) { int[] s = sources[i]; if (s[0] < 0 || s[0] > 9 || s[1] < 1 || s[1] > 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_LOGLIN_SOURCE"); this.sources[i] = s.clone(); ml = Math.max(ml, s[1]); }
            S = sources.length; maxlag = ml; this.lr = lr; this.l2 = l2;
            b = new double[100]; Gb = new double[100]; Arrays.fill(Gb, 1e-3);
            W = new double[S * 1000]; GW = new double[S * 1000]; Arrays.fill(GW, 1e-3);
            recent = new int[maxlag][10]; idx = new int[S * 10];
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private int[] lagged(int lag) { return recent[(seen - lag) % maxlag]; }
        private void probs() {
            boolean have = seen >= maxlag;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double[] z = new double[10];
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) z[n] = b[p * 10 + n];
                if (have) for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { int a = lagged(sources[s][1])[(p + sources[s][0]) % 10] - 1; idx[s * 10 + p] = a; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) z[n] += W[s * 1000 + p * 100 + a * 10 + n]; }
                double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) m = Math.max(m, z[n]);
                double sum = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { pr[p * 10 + n] = Math.exp(z[n] - m); sum += pr[p * 10 + n]; }
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) pr[p * 10 + n] /= sum;
            }
        }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            probs();
            double pm = 0, ent = 0, absW = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { double best = 0, e = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { double v = pr[p * 10 + n]; out[p][n] = (float) v; best = Math.max(best, v); e -= v * Math.log(v); } pm += best; ent += e; }
            for (double v : W) absW += Math.abs(v);
            st[0] = (float) (pm / 10.0); st[1] = (float) (absW / (S * 1000.0) * 100.0); st[2] = (float) (ent / 10.0 / Math.log(10));
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            probs();
            boolean have = seen >= maxlag;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                int x = d[p] - 1; double[] g = new double[10];
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) g[n] = pr[p * 10 + n] - (n == x ? 1.0 : 0.0);
                for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { int i = p * 10 + n; double gb = g[n] + l2 * b[i]; Gb[i] += gb * gb; b[i] -= lr * gb / Math.sqrt(Gb[i]); }
                if (have) for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { int a = idx[s * 10 + p]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { int i = s * 1000 + p * 100 + a * 10 + n; double gw = g[n] + l2 * W[i]; GW[i] += gw * gw; W[i] -= lr * gw / Math.sqrt(GW[i]); } }
            }
            System.arraycopy(d, 0, recent[seen % maxlag], 0, 10); seen++;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, b); writeArr(o, Gb); writeArr(o, W); writeArr(o, GW); o.writeInt(seen); for (int[] r : recent) for (int v : r) o.writeByte(v); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, b); readArr(in, Gb); readArr(in, W); readArr(in, GW); seen = in.readInt(); for (int[] r : recent) for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) r[i] = in.readByte(); }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- RELBAYES
    /** Every relation (target p, source q, lag, map SAME/PLUS1/MINUS1/MIRROR) keeps a forgetting Beta reliability. */
    public static final class RelBayes implements Model {
        final int[] lags; final double decay, kappa, temp; final boolean positiveOnly; final int L, maxlag;
        final double[] s, n; final int[][] recent; int seen; final int[] pred;
        public RelBayes(int[] lags, double decay, double kappa, boolean positiveOnly, double temp) {
            int ml = 0; for (int l : lags) { if (l < 1 || l > 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_REL_LAG"); ml = Math.max(ml, l); }
            this.lags = lags.clone(); L = lags.length; maxlag = ml; this.decay = decay; this.kappa = kappa; this.positiveOnly = positiveOnly; this.temp = temp;
            s = new double[10 * 10 * L * 4]; n = new double[10 * 10 * L * 4]; recent = new int[maxlag][10]; pred = new int[10 * L * 4];
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private boolean preds() {
            if (seen < maxlag) return false;
            for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) for (int li = 0; li < L; li++) {
                int src = recent[(seen - lags[li]) % maxlag][q] - 1, b = (q * L + li) * 4;
                pred[b] = src; pred[b + 1] = (src + 1) % 10; pred[b + 2] = (src + 9) % 10; pred[b + 3] = 9 - src;
            }
            return true;
        }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            double[][] score = new double[10][10];
            if (preds()) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) for (int li = 0; li < L; li++) for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
                int i = ((p * 10 + q) * L + li) * 4 + m;
                double rho = (s[i] + 0.1 * kappa) / (n[i] + kappa), w = Math.log(rho / 0.1) / temp;
                if (positiveOnly) w = Math.max(w, 0.0);
                score[p][pred[(q * L + li) * 4 + m]] += w;
            }
            double smax = 0, pm = 0, ss = 0, nn = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) mx = Math.max(mx, score[p][v]);
                smax += mx; double sum = 0; double[] e = new double[10];
                for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { e[v] = Math.exp(score[p][v] - mx); sum += e[v]; }
                double best = 0; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { out[p][v] = (float) (e[v] / sum); best = Math.max(best, e[v] / sum); }
                pm += best;
            }
            for (double v : s) ss += v; for (double v : n) nn += v;
            st[0] = (float) (smax / 10.0); st[1] = (float) (nn > 0 ? ss / Math.max(nn, 1) : 0.0); st[2] = (float) (pm / 10.0);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            if (preds()) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                int x = d[p] - 1;
                for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) for (int li = 0; li < L; li++) for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++) {
                    int i = ((p * 10 + q) * L + li) * 4 + m;
                    s[i] = decay * s[i] + (pred[(q * L + li) * 4 + m] == x ? 1.0 : 0.0); n[i] = decay * n[i] + 1.0;
                }
            }
            System.arraycopy(d, 0, recent[seen % maxlag], 0, 10); seen++;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { writeArr(o, s); writeArr(o, n); o.writeInt(seen); for (int[] r : recent) for (int v : r) o.writeByte(v); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { readArr(in, s); readArr(in, n); seen = in.readInt(); for (int[] r : recent) for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) r[i] = in.readByte(); }
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- KALMAN
    /** Local-linear-trend Kalman filter (level + slope with uncertainty) on every (position, number) indicator. */
    public static final class Kalman implements Model {
        final double qLevel, qSlope, r, horizon, temp; final double[] lvl = new double[100], slo = new double[100], P11 = new double[100], P12 = new double[100], P22 = new double[100];
        boolean predicted;
        public Kalman(double qLevel, double qSlope, double r, double horizon, double temp) {
            this.qLevel = qLevel; this.qSlope = qSlope; this.r = r; this.horizon = horizon; this.temp = temp;
            Arrays.fill(lvl, 0.1); Arrays.fill(P11, 1e-2); Arrays.fill(P22, 1e-6);
        }
        public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
        private void timeStep() {
            if (predicted) return;
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { lvl[i] += slo[i]; P11[i] = P11[i] + 2 * P12[i] + P22[i] + qLevel; P12[i] = P12[i] + P22[i]; P22[i] = P22[i] + qSlope; }
            predicted = true;
        }
        public void predict(float[][] out, float[] st) {
            timeStep();
            double pm = 0, as = 0, sd = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; double[] f = new double[10];
                for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { f[v] = lvl[p * 10 + v] + horizon * slo[p * 10 + v]; mx = Math.max(mx, f[v]); }
                double sum = 0; double[] e = new double[10];
                for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { e[v] = Math.exp(temp * (f[v] - mx)); sum += e[v]; }
                double best = 0; for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) { out[p][v] = (float) (e[v] / sum); best = Math.max(best, e[v] / sum); }
                pm += best;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) { as += Math.abs(slo[i]); sd += Math.sqrt(P11[i]); }
            st[0] = (float) (as / 100.0 * 1e4); st[1] = (float) (sd / 100.0 * 100); st[2] = (float) (pm / 10.0);
        }
        public void update(int[] d) {
            requireDraw(d);
            timeStep();
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int v = 0; v < 10; v++) {
                int i = p * 10 + v; double y = (d[p] - 1 == v ? 1.0 : 0.0) - lvl[i];
                double S = P11[i] + r, k1 = P11[i] / S, k2 = P12[i] / S;
                lvl[i] += k1 * y; slo[i] += k2 * y; P22[i] = P22[i] - k2 * P12[i]; P12[i] = P12[i] - k2 * P11[i]; P11[i] = P11[i] - k1 * P11[i];
            }
            predicted = false;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { o.writeBoolean(predicted); writeArr(o, lvl); writeArr(o, slo); writeArr(o, P11); writeArr(o, P12); writeArr(o, P22); }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { predicted = in.readBoolean(); readArr(in, lvl); readArr(in, slo); readArr(in, P11); readArr(in, P12); readArr(in, P22); }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * SU1 grammar programs (including the 168 lifted atoms of the 25,350-atom registry and
 * the user's XI selector) as members of SU2 strategies (P10/P18): P = softmax(tau * score).
 * They can then be pooled with the mathematical models, gated by the applicability
 * learner and certified selectively. Parameters: text_hex = UTF-8 hex of the canonical
 * SU1 program (hex keeps SU2 delimiters out of the program text), tau.
 * Programs needing fitted assets (DEEP/GRAPH) are rejected here: those stay SU1 members.
 */
public final class ProgramModelSU2 implements OnlineModelsSU2.Model {
    final ProgramTreeSU1.Node program; final double tau; final List<int[]> history = new ArrayList<>();

    public static void register() { ModelReplaySU2.ADAPTERS.put("SU1PROG", p -> new ProgramModelSU2(unhex(p.get("text_hex")), Double.parseDouble(p.get("tau")))); }

    public static String hex(String text) { StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(); for (byte v : text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) b.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%02x", v & 255)); return b.toString(); }
    static String unhex(String h) { if (h == null || h.length() % 2 != 0 || h.length() > 2048) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_PROGRAM_HEX"); byte[] b = new byte[h.length() / 2]; for (int i = 0; i < b.length; i++) b[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(h.substring(2 * i, 2 * i + 2), 16); return new String(b, StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }

    public ProgramModelSU2(String text, double tau) {
        if (text.contains("DEEP(") || text.contains("GDEEP(") || text.contains("GRAPH(")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_PROGRAM_NEEDS_FITTED_ASSET");
        if (!(tau > 0 && tau <= 5)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_PROGRAM_TAU");
        program = ProgramTreeSU1.parse(ProgramTextSU1.canonical(text)); this.tau = tau;
    }
    public int stateWidth() { return 3; }
    public void predict(float[][] p, float[] st) {
        int[][] h = history.toArray(new int[0][]);
        double[][] s;
        if (h.length < 30) { s = new double[10][10]; }
        else { try (AtomLiftSU1 atoms = new AtomLiftSU1(h)) { s = program.score(new ProgramTreeSU1.Context(h, h.length, atoms, new ScoreHistoryCacheSU1(256), new BudgetTokenSU1(250, 3_000_000, null))); } }
        double pm = 0, spread = 0;
        for (int q = 0; q < 10; q++) {
            double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY, mn = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY; for (double v : s[q]) { mx = Math.max(mx, v); mn = Math.min(mn, v); }
            double z = 0; double[] e = new double[10]; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { e[n] = Math.exp(tau * (s[q][n] - mx)); z += e[n]; }
            double best = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) { p[q][n] = (float) (e[n] / z); best = Math.max(best, e[n] / z); }
            pm += best; spread += mx - mn;
        }
        st[0] = (float) (pm / 10); st[1] = (float) (spread / 10); st[2] = (float) Math.min(1.0, h.length / 5000.0);
    }
    public void update(int[] draw) { OnlineModelsSU2.requireDraw(draw); history.add(draw.clone()); if (history.size() > 6500) history.remove(0); }
    public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException { o.writeInt(history.size()); for (int[] d : history) for (int v : d) o.writeByte(v); }
    public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException { int n = in.readInt(); if (n < 0 || n > 6500) throw new IOException("SU2_PROGRAM_STATE"); history.clear(); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { int[] d = new int[10]; for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) d[j] = in.readByte(); history.add(d); } }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import android.database.Cursor;
import com.ethk3.novaonepro.*;

/**
 * Replaces the compile-time REAL locks for certified selective lanes (P04).
 * Root cause in both repositories: AppConfig.R35_REAL_AUTO_UNLOCK_ENABLED=false and
 * V51NumberModelArtifact/ExpertGate/ActionRanker/SelectedCalibration/PolicySurface
 * PROVEN=false are compile-time constants, so DecisionGateEngine.b12Reject returns
 * MODEL_NOT_PROVEN for every REAL candidate no matter how good it is.
 * Now a REAL action needs, at run time: the user's explicit authorisation switch
 * (default OFF), a valid SU2 selective certificate for the chosen league member, the
 * member's frozen ACT decision for this exact target, and an unopened target.
 */
public final class RealAuthoritySU2 {
    private RealAuthoritySU2() {}
    public static final String USER_SWITCH = "su2_real_authorized_by_user";

    public static boolean allows(DbStore store, String candidate, String certificate, String target, long openTime) {
        if (store == null || candidate == null || !candidate.startsWith(CertificateSU2.PREFIX)) return false;
        if (!"1".equals(store.getState(USER_SWITCH, "0"))) return false;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis(); if (now >= openTime) return false;
        String genome = candidate.substring(CertificateSU2.PREFIX.length());
        CertificateSU2.Authority a = CertificateSU2.read(store.readable(), genome, now);
        if (a == null || !a.certificate.equals(certificate)) return false;
        long seq = TargetIssueResolver.sequenceOrdinalSU1(target);
        String chosen = ModelStoreSU2.currentChoice(store.readable(), seq);
        if (!("SU2:" + genome).equals(chosen) && !("XI_INCUMBENT:" + genome).equals(chosen)) return false;
        try (Cursor c = store.readable().rawQuery("SELECT act FROM su2_live_decision WHERE genome_key=? AND sequence_ordinal=? AND hit IS NULL", new String[]{genome, String.valueOf(seq)})) {
            return c.moveToFirst() && c.getInt(0) == 1;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

/**
 * Post-selection calibration (P29): the probability shown for an ACT period is
 * re-estimated only from earlier ACT periods of the same strategy (Platt scaling
 * on logit(phat) with a ridge toward "calibrated as is"), and the expected
 * calibration error is reported in 10 bins. Selection makes raw phat optimistic;
 * this is what the dashboard and the report must show instead.
 */
public final class SelectiveCalibrationSU2 {
    private SelectiveCalibrationSU2() {}

    public static final class Platt { public final double a, b; Platt(double a, double b) { this.a = a; this.b = b; }
        public double apply(double p) { double z = a * logit(p) + b; return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-z)); } }

    static double logit(double p) { double q = Math.min(1 - 1e-6, Math.max(1e-6, p)); return Math.log(q / (1 - q)); }

    /** Fit on ACT rows < t only (caller guarantees causality). */
    public static Platt fit(double[] phat, boolean[] hit, int n, double ridge) {
        double a = 1, b = 0;
        for (int it = 0; it < 25; it++) {
            double ga = ridge * (a - 1), gb = ridge * b, haa = ridge, hab = 0, hbb = ridge + 1e-9;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                double x = logit(phat[i]), p = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-(a * x + b))), e = p - (hit[i] ? 1 : 0), w = p * (1 - p);
                ga += e * x; gb += e; haa += w * x * x; hab += w * x; hbb += w;
            }
            double det = haa * hbb - hab * hab; if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-12) break;
            double da = (hbb * ga - hab * gb) / det, db = (haa * gb - hab * ga) / det;
            a -= da; b -= db; if (Math.abs(da) + Math.abs(db) < 1e-9) break;
        }
        return new Platt(a, b);
    }

    public static double ece(double[] p, boolean[] hit, int n) {
        double[] s = new double[10], k = new double[10]; int[] c = new int[10];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { int b = Math.min(9, (int) (p[i] * 10)); s[b] += p[i]; k[b] += hit[i] ? 1 : 0; c[b]++; }
        double e = 0; for (int b = 0; b < 10; b++) if (c[b] > 0) e += c[b] / (double) n * Math.abs(s[b] / c[b] - k[b] / c[b]);
        return e;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

/**
 * Evidence for selective strategies (P27/P28): a strategy that acts on 15-30% of
 * periods is judged on the periods it chose, with the calendar kept honest.
 *
 *  - quality:   hits / ACT periods, Hoeffding-style lower bound at the alpha this
 *               look is allowed to spend (alpha_k <= alpha / (k (k+1)), lifetime
 *               root alpha 0.05, so repeated looks can never add up to more);
 *  - frequency: ACT / (ACT + ABSTAIN); MISSING periods (not computed in time)
 *               are counted against the strategy, never silently dropped;
 *  - stability: every one of 4 calendar blocks must keep its rate >= floor;
 *  - parity:    on the SAME periods the challenger must not be significantly
 *               worse than the incumbent (the user's original method): upper
 *               bound of the paired per-period excess-hit difference >= 0.
 * The null baseline is exactly 30% for any K3 on a uniform permutation.
 */
public final class SelectiveEvidenceSU2 {
    private SelectiveEvidenceSU2() {}

    public static final class Verdict {
        public final boolean pass; public final String reason; public final int acts, hits, missing; public final double rate, lower, coverage, worstBlock, pairedUpper;
        Verdict(boolean pass, String reason, int acts, int hits, int missing, double rate, double lower, double coverage, double worstBlock, double pairedUpper) {
            this.pass = pass; this.reason = reason; this.acts = acts; this.hits = hits; this.missing = missing; this.rate = rate; this.lower = lower; this.coverage = coverage; this.worstBlock = worstBlock; this.pairedUpper = pairedUpper;
        }
    }

    public static double alphaForLook(double root, int look) { if (look < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_LOOK"); return root / ((double) look * (look + 1)); }

    /** One-sided Hoeffding lower bound for a Bernoulli mean. */
    public static double hoeffdingLower(int k, int n, double alpha) { if (n == 0) return 0; return k / (double) n - Math.sqrt(Math.log(1 / alpha) / (2.0 * n)); }

    /**
     * act/hit/missing over the evaluation calendar [a,b); incumbentAct/Hit on the same periods (may be null).
     * minActs: minimum ACT periods (e.g. 600); floor: block floor (e.g. 0.28); minCoverage: e.g. 0.15.
     */
    public static Verdict evaluate(boolean[] act, boolean[] hit, boolean[] missing, boolean[] incAct, boolean[] incHit,
                                   int a, int b, int look, double rootAlpha, int minActs, double floor, double minCoverage) {
        int n = 0, k = 0, miss = 0;
        for (int t = a; t < b; t++) { if (missing != null && missing[t]) { miss++; continue; } if (act[t]) { n++; if (hit[t]) k++; } }
        double cov = (n) / (double) Math.max(1, b - a);
        double rate = n == 0 ? 0 : k / (double) n;
        double alpha = alphaForLook(rootAlpha, look);
        // missing periods are scored as acted-and-missed: the strategy cannot hide its absences
        double lower = hoeffdingLower(k, n + miss, alpha);
        double worst = 1; int step = (b - a) / 4;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int bn = 0, bk = 0; int x = a + i * step, y = i == 3 ? b : a + (i + 1) * step;
            for (int t = x; t < y; t++) if (act[t]) { bn++; if (hit[t]) bk++; }
            worst = Math.min(worst, bn == 0 ? 0 : bk / (double) bn);
        }
        double paired = Double.NaN;
        if (incAct != null) {
            // per-period paired difference in hits (each side counts 1 for an acted hit), bounded in [-1,1]
            int m = b - a; double s = 0;
            for (int t = a; t < b; t++) s += (act[t] && hit[t] ? 1 : 0) - (incAct[t] && incHit[t] ? 1 : 0) - 0.3 * ((act[t] ? 1 : 0) - (incAct[t] ? 1 : 0));
            double mean = s / m; paired = mean + Math.sqrt(2 * Math.log(1 / alpha) / m);   // upper bound of the paired excess (range [-1,1])
        }
        String reason = "PASS";
        if (n < minActs) reason = "ACTS_LT_" + minActs;
        else if (cov < minCoverage) reason = "COVERAGE_LT_" + minCoverage;
        else if (!(lower > 0.30)) reason = "LOWER_BOUND_NOT_ABOVE_NULL_30";
        else if (worst < floor) reason = "BLOCK_BELOW_FLOOR";
        else if (incAct != null && paired < 0) reason = "SIGNIFICANTLY_WORSE_THAN_INCUMBENT_ON_SAME_PERIODS";
        return new Verdict(reason.equals("PASS"), reason, n, k, miss, rate, lower, cov, worst, paired);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * P49 stage layer (stagelayer_core.py in the Python reference): recognise the current stage of the draws from its
 * atomic fingerprint, recall how every deployed strategy performs in that stage, and let the best-matched strategy act.
 *
 *   fingerprint   per period from draws < t: at scales 30 and 100, per position the normalised entropy of the number
 *                 counts, the strongest number's frequency z, odd and big shares; repeat / neighbour rates over 30 draws;
 *                 drift |freq20 - freq120|; the regime-memory "no structure" posterior; the per-period means of the eight
 *                 per-position blocks; every candidate's hit rate over its last 50 periods
 *   stage library diagonal Gaussian mixture on standardised 25-period block fingerprints, K = 1..6 by BIC; PC1-quantile
 *                 initialisation (50 power iterations), 60 EM iterations, variance floor 1e-3
 *   sticky filter stay 0.95 over the mixture likelihood of every period
 *   fusion        per candidate a ridge logistic regression (IRLS, 8 Newton steps, lambda 1) of its hit on
 *                 [1, logit confidence, stage posterior, posterior x logit confidence]
 * fit() uses settled periods [a, b) only; apply()/Live run forward one period at a time. The deployment rule (best
 * candidate, causal top-`cov` threshold, validation safeguard against the tier committee) is in the caller.

public final class StageLayerSU2 {
    static final int START = 1500, BLOCK = 25, KMAX = 6, EM_ITERS = 60, PI_ITERS = 50, NEWTON = 8;
    static final double STAY = 0.95, LAMBDA = 1.0;
    static final int BASE_COLS = 92;

    private StageLayerSU2() {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ fingerprint
    /** Fingerprint row of target t (draws D[0..t-1]); st0 = regime-memory null posterior at t; perf = candidates' last-50 hit rates. */
    public static double[] row(int[][] D, int t, double st0, double[] perf) {

            else { double sc = w / (double) Math.max(1, t); for (int u = 0; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) cnt[p][D[u][p] - 1] += 1; for (double[] r : cnt) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) r[n] *= sc; }
            double[][] blocks = new double[4][10];
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double s = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(cnt[p], 0, 10) + 5;
                double[] e = new double[10];

                blocks[0][p] = -ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(e, 0, 10) / Math.log(10);

                blocks[1][p] = (mx - w / 10.0) / Math.sqrt(w * 0.09);
                double odd = 0, big = 0; for (int n = 0; n < 10; n += 2) odd += cnt[p][n]; for (int n = 5; n < 10; n++) big += cnt[p][n];
                blocks[2][p] = odd / w - 0.5; blocks[3][p] = big / w - 0.5;

        }
        double rep30 = 0, nb30 = 0;
        if (t >= 30) for (int u = t - 30; u < t; u++) { if (u < 1) continue; int r = 0, nb = 0; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) { if (D[u][p] == D[u - 1][p]) r++; if (Math.abs(D[u][p] - D[u - 1][p]) == 1) nb++; } rep30 += r / 10.0; nb30 += nb / 10.0; }

        if (t >= 20) for (int u = t - 20; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c20[p][D[u][p] - 1] += 1;
        if (t >= 120) for (int u = t - 120; u < t; u++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) c120[p][D[u][p] - 1] += 1;
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) dr[p * 10 + n] = Math.abs(c20[p][n] / 20 - c120[p][n] / 120);

    /** Batch fingerprints for t = 0..T-1; hits[s][t] = candidate s hit at t; st0[t] from a RegMem model run over D. */
    public static double[][] fingerprints(int[][] D, boolean[][] hits, double[] st0) {
        int T = D.length, S = hits.length; double[][] F = new double[T][];
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            double[] perf = new double[S];
            for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) { if (t < 50) { perf[s] = 0.3; continue; } int k = 0; for (int u = t - 50; u < t; u++) if (hits[s][u]) k++; perf[s] = k / 50.0; }
            F[t] = row(D, t, st0[t], perf);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ mixture
    public static final class Gmm { final double[][] mu, var; final double[] w; final double bic; Gmm(double[][] mu, double[][] var, double[] w, double bic) { this.mu = mu; this.var = var; this.w = w; this.bic = bic; } public int K() { return w.length; } }

    static double[] loglik(double[] x, Gmm g) { return loglik(x, g.mu, g.var, g.w); }
    static double[] loglik(double[] x, double[][] mu, double[][] var, double[] w) {
        int K = w.length, d = x.length; double[] out = new double[K], tmp = new double[d];
        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) { double z = x[j] - mu[k][j]; tmp[j] = z * z / var[k][j] + Math.log(2 * Math.PI * var[k][j]); } out[k] = -0.5 * ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(tmp, 0, d) + Math.log(w[k]); }

    static Gmm gmmFit(double[][] X, int K) {
        int n = X.length, d = X[0].length;
        double[] mean = new double[d]; for (double[] r : X) for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) mean[j] += r[j]; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) mean[j] /= n;
        double[][] C = new double[d][d];
        if (n > 1) for (double[] r : X) for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) { double a = r[i] - mean[i]; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) C[i][j] += a * (r[j] - mean[j]); }
        for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) C[i][j] = n > 1 ? C[i][j] / (n - 1) : (i == j ? 1 : 0);
        double[] v = new double[d]; Arrays.fill(v, 1 / Math.sqrt(d));
        for (int it = 0; it < PI_ITERS; it++) { double[] u = new double[d]; for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) { double s = 0; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) s += C[i][j] * v[j]; u[i] = s; } double nr = 0; for (double a : u) nr += a * a; nr = Math.sqrt(nr) + 1e-12; for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) v[i] = u[i] / nr; }
        double[] proj = new double[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double s = 0; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) s += X[i][j] * v[j]; proj[i] = s; }
        Integer[] ord = new Integer[n]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ord[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(ord, (a, b) -> proj[a] != proj[b] ? Double.compare(proj[a], proj[b]) : Integer.compare(a, b));
        double[][] mu = new double[K][], var = new double[K][d]; double[] w = new double[K];
        double[] colVar = new double[d];

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double[] ll = loglik(X[i], mu, var, w); double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (double a : ll) m = Math.max(m, a); double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { R[i][k] = Math.exp(ll[k] - m); s += R[i][k]; } for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) R[i][k] /= s; }

                for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) { double mm = m1[j] / Nk[k]; mu[k][j] = mm; var[k][j] = Math.max(m2[j] / Nk[k] - mm * mm + 1e-3, 1e-3); }
            }
        }
        double[] rowTot = new double[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double[] ll = loglik(X[i], mu, var, w); double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (double a : ll) m = Math.max(m, a); double s = 0; for (double a : ll) s += Math.exp(a - m); rowTot[i] = m + Math.log(s); }

    static double[] post(Gmm g, double[] x) {
        double[] ll = loglik(x, g); double m = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (double a : ll) m = Math.max(m, a);
        double s = 0; double[] r = new double[ll.length]; for (int k = 0; k < ll.length; k++) { r[k] = Math.exp(ll[k] - m); s += r[k]; } for (int k = 0; k < r.length; k++) r[k] /= s; return r;
    }

    /** One sticky-filter step: a = previous posterior, lik = mixture posterior of this period. */
    static double[] stickyStep(double[] a, double[] lik) {
        int K = lik.length; double[] out = new double[K]; double off = (1 - STAY) / Math.max(1, K - 1), dia = K > 1 ? STAY : 1.0, s = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) { double pj = 0; for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) pj += a[i] * (i == j ? dia : off); out[j] = pj * Math.max(lik[j], 1e-12); s += out[j]; }
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) out[j] /= s;

    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ logistic
    static double logitConf(double c) { c = Math.min(Math.max(c, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6); return Math.log(c / (1 - c)); }
    static double[] design(double[] post, double lc) { int K = post.length; double[] x = new double[2 + 2 * K]; x[0] = 1; x[1] = lc; for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) { x[2 + k] = post[k]; x[2 + K + k] = post[k] * lc; } return x; }
    static double sigm(double z) { return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-Math.min(30, Math.max(-30, z)))); }

    static double[] logitFit(double[][] X, double[] y) {
        int n = X.length, d = X[0].length; double[] w = new double[d];
        for (int it = 0; it < NEWTON; it++) {
            double[] g = new double[d]; double[][] H = new double[d][d];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double z = 0; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) z += X[i][j] * w[j]; double p = sigm(z), r = p - y[i], q = p * (1 - p); for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) { g[j] += X[i][j] * r; for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) H[j][k] += X[i][j] * q * X[i][k]; } }
            for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) { g[j] += LAMBDA * w[j]; H[j][j] += LAMBDA; }
            double[] step = solve(H, g); for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) w[j] -= step[j];
        }

    }

    static double[] solve(double[][] A0, double[] b0) {
        int n = b0.length; double[][] A = new double[n][]; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) A[i] = A0[i].clone(); double[] b = b0.clone();
        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
            int piv = c; for (int r = c + 1; r < n; r++) if (Math.abs(A[r][c]) > Math.abs(A[piv][c])) piv = r;
            double[] tr = A[c]; A[c] = A[piv]; A[piv] = tr; double tb = b[c]; b[c] = b[piv]; b[piv] = tb;
            for (int r = c + 1; r < n; r++) { double f = A[r][c] / A[c][c]; if (f == 0) continue; for (int k = c; k < n; k++) A[r][k] -= f * A[c][k]; b[r] -= f * b[c]; }
        }
        double[] x = new double[n];
        for (int r = n - 1; r >= 0; r--) { double s = b[r]; for (int k = r + 1; k < n; k++) s -= A[r][k] * x[k]; x[r] = s / A[r][r]; }

    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ fit / apply
    public static final class Layer {
        public final Gmm gmm; final double[] mu, sd; final double[][] W; final double[] last;
        Layer(Gmm g, double[] mu, double[] sd, double[][] W, double[] last) { this.gmm = g; this.mu = mu; this.sd = sd; this.W = W; this.last = last; }
        public int stages() { return gmm.K(); }
        double[] z(double[] f) { double[] o = new double[f.length]; for (int j = 0; j < f.length; j++) o[j] = (f[j] - mu[j]) / sd[j]; return o; }
    }

    public static Layer fit(double[][] F, double[][] confs, boolean[][] hits, int a, int b) {
        int d = F[0].length; List<double[]> blocks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = a; i <= b - BLOCK; i += BLOCK) { double[] m = new double[d]; for (int u = i; u < i + BLOCK; u++) for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) m[j] += F[u][j]; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) m[j] /= BLOCK; blocks.add(m); }
        int nb = blocks.size(); double[] mu = new double[d], sd = new double[d];
        for (double[] m : blocks) for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) mu[j] += m[j]; for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) mu[j] /= nb;
        for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) { double s = 0; for (double[] m : blocks) { double e = m[j] - mu[j]; s += e * e; } sd[j] = Math.sqrt(s / nb) + 1e-9; }
        double[][] Z = new double[nb][d]; for (int i = 0; i < nb; i++) for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) Z[i][j] = (blocks.get(i)[j] - mu[j]) / sd[j];
        Gmm best = null;
        for (int K = 1; K <= KMAX; K++) { Gmm g = gmmFit(Z, K); if (best == null || g.bic < best.bic) best = g; }
        Layer tmp = new Layer(best, mu, sd, null, null);
        int K = best.K(), n = b - a; double[][] post = new double[n][];
        double[] at = new double[K]; Arrays.fill(at, 1.0 / K);
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) { at = stickyStep(at, post(best, tmp.z(F[a + u]))); post[u] = at; }
        double[][] W = new double[confs.length][];
        for (int s = 0; s < confs.length; s++) {
            double[][] X = new double[n][]; double[] y = new double[n];
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) { X[u] = design(post[u], logitConf(confs[s][a + u])); y[u] = hits[s][a + u] ? 1 : 0; }
            W[s] = logitFit(X, y);
        }
        return new Layer(best, mu, sd, W, post[n - 1]);
    }

    /** P(hit) [b-a][S] for periods [a, b), filtering forward from the end of the fit. */
    public static double[][] apply(Layer L, double[][] F, double[][] confs, int a, int b) {
        Live live = new Live(L); double[][] out = new double[b - a][];
        for (int u = a; u < b; u++) { double[] c = new double[confs.length]; for (int s = 0; s < confs.length; s++) c[s] = confs[s][u]; out[u - a] = live.step(F[u], c); }
        return out;
    }

    /** One period at a time (the phone): fingerprint row of the target and the candidates' confidences -> P(hit) each. */
    public static final class Live {
        final Layer L; double[] a;
        public Live(Layer L) { this.L = L; this.a = L.last.clone(); }
        public double[] step(double[] fingerprintRow, double[] conf) {
            a = stickyStep(a, post(L.gmm, L.z(fingerprintRow)));
            double[] out = new double[conf.length];
            for (int s = 0; s < conf.length; s++) { double[] x = design(a, logitConf(conf[s])); double z = 0; for (int j = 0; j < x.length; j++) z += x[j] * L.W[s][j]; out[s] = sigm(z); }
            return out;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * R15 (P45) teacher matrix pool: which member ("teacher") is reliable in which observable state, per position
 * (reference/replay/teacher.py; fixture r15_atomnet).
 *
 *   W[m, p, sigma] = softmax_m( sum of member m's log-likelihood at position p over the trailing 2,500 settled periods
 *                               whose state indicator at p was sigma )             sigma in {-1, +1}; 0 = all periods
 *   P[t, p, .]     = sum_m W[m, p, s[t, p]] * P_m[t, p, .]
 *
 * s = registry state atom j (AtomStreamSU2.state). Weights are re-estimated every 250 periods from draws before the
 * block (first at 1,500; equal weights before). Genome pool text: TEACHER:<j>.
 */
public final class TeacherPoolSU2 {
    private TeacherPoolSU2() {}
    public static final int START = 1500, WINDOW = 2500, REFIT = 250;

    public static boolean isTeacher(String pool) { return pool != null && pool.startsWith("TEACHER:"); }
    public static int stateOf(String pool) {
        int j = Integer.parseInt(pool.substring(8));
        if (j < 0 || j >= AtomStreamSU2.states()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SU2_TEACHER_STATE");
        return j;
    }

    /** State indicator series s[t][p] of registry state j over a history (replay). */
    public static float[][] states(int[][] draws, int j) {
        AtomStreamSU2 st = new AtomStreamSU2(); float[][] s = new float[draws.length][];
        for (int t = 0; t < draws.length; t++) { s[t] = st.state(j).clone(); st.update(draws[t]); }
        return s;
    }

    static double ll(float[][] P, int p, int y) { return Math.log(Math.min(1.0, Math.max(1e-9, (double) P[p][y]))); }

    static void weights(double[][] llWin, float[][] sWin, int n, int M, double[][][] W) {
        // llWin[i][m*10+p], sWin[i][p] for the n periods of the window in time order
        double[] sel = new double[n];
        for (int si = 0; si < 3; si++) {
            float sig = si - 1;
            for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
                double[] sc = new double[M]; int cnt = 0;
                for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) {
                    int k = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (sig == 0f || sWin[i][p] == sig) sel[k++] = llWin[i][m * 10 + p];
                    sc[m] = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(sel, 0, k); cnt = k;
                }
                if (cnt == 0) Arrays.fill(sc, 0.0);
                double mx = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; for (double v : sc) mx = Math.max(mx, v);
                double[] e = new double[M]; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) e[m] = Math.exp(sc[m] - mx);
                double z = ModelOpsSU2.pairwise(e, 0, M);
                for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) W[si][p][m] = e[m] / z;
            }
        }
    }

    static float[][] combine(float[][][] tabs, float[] s, double[][][] W) {
        int M = tabs.length; float[][] out = new float[10][10];
        for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) {
            int si = (int) s[p] + 1;
            double[] acc = new double[10];
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) acc[n] = W[si][p][0] * (double) tabs[0][p][n];
            for (int m = 1; m < M; m++) for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) acc[n] = acc[n] + W[si][p][m] * (double) tabs[m][p][n];
            for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) out[p][n] = (float) acc[n];
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Replay form (Python teacher.teacher_pool). */
    public static float[][][] pool(float[][][][] Ps, int[][] draws, float[][] s) {
        int M = Ps.length, T = draws.length; float[][][] out = new float[T][][];
        double[][][] W = new double[3][10][M]; for (double[][] a : W) for (double[] b : a) Arrays.fill(b, 1.0 / M);
        float[][][] at = new float[M][][];
        for (int t0 = 0; t0 < T; t0 += REFIT) {
            if (t0 >= START) {
                int lo = Math.max(0, t0 - WINDOW), n = t0 - lo;
                double[][] L = new double[n][M * 10]; float[][] S = new float[n][];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { int u = lo + i; S[i] = s[u]; for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) L[i][m * 10 + p] = ll(Ps[m][u], p, draws[u][p] - 1); }
                weights(L, S, n, M, W);
            }
            for (int t = t0; t < Math.min(t0 + REFIT, T); t++) { for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) at[m] = Ps[m][t]; out[t] = combine(at, s[t], W); }
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Live form: identical tables to pool(), one period at a time (its own atom stream supplies the state). */
    public static final class Live {
        final int M, j; final AtomStreamSU2 stream = new AtomStreamSU2();
        final double[][] llRing; final float[][] sRing; long t, fittedAt = -1; float[] sNow;
        final double[][][] W;
        public Live(int M, int j) {
            this.M = M; this.j = j; llRing = new double[WINDOW][M * 10]; sRing = new float[WINDOW][];
            W = new double[3][10][M]; for (double[][] a : W) for (double[] b : a) Arrays.fill(b, 1.0 / M);
        }
        public float[][] predict(float[][][] tabs) {
            if (t >= START && t % REFIT == 0 && fittedAt != t) {
                long lo = Math.max(0, t - WINDOW); int n = (int) (t - lo);
                double[][] L = new double[n][]; float[][] S = new float[n][];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { int k = (int) ((lo + i) % WINDOW); L[i] = llRing[k]; S[i] = sRing[k]; }
                weights(L, S, n, M, W); fittedAt = t;
            }
            sNow = stream.state(j);
            return combine(tabs, sNow, W);
        }
        public void settle(float[][][] tabs, int[] draw) {
            if (sNow == null || stream.time() != t) sNow = stream.state(j);
            int k = (int) (t % WINDOW); double[] row = new double[M * 10];
            for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) row[m * 10 + p] = ll(tabs[m], p, draw[p] - 1);
            llRing[k] = row; sRing[k] = sNow.clone(); stream.update(draw); t++; sNow = null;
        }
        public void write(DataOutput o) throws IOException {
            o.writeLong(t); o.writeLong(fittedAt);
            for (double[][] a : W) for (double[] b : a) for (double v : b) o.writeDouble(v);
            int keep = (int) Math.min(t, WINDOW); o.writeInt(keep);
            for (long u = t - keep; u < t; u++) { int k = (int) (u % WINDOW); for (double v : llRing[k]) o.writeDouble(v); for (float v : sRing[k]) o.writeFloat(v); }
            stream.write(o);
        }
        public void read(DataInput in) throws IOException {
            t = in.readLong(); fittedAt = in.readLong();
            for (double[][] a : W) for (double[] b : a) for (int m = 0; m < M; m++) b[m] = in.readDouble();
            int keep = in.readInt(); if (keep < 0 || keep > WINDOW) throw new IOException("SU2_TEACHER_STATE");
            for (long u = t - keep; u < t; u++) { int k = (int) (u % WINDOW); llRing[k] = new double[M * 10]; for (int i = 0; i < M * 10; i++) llRing[k][i] = in.readDouble(); sRing[k] = new float[10]; for (int p = 0; p < 10; p++) sRing[k][p] = in.readFloat(); }
            stream.read(in); sNow = null;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.ethk3.novaonepro.strategyv2;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * P50 upgrade diagnosis (检测报告 = 升级诊断书), the Java twin of reference/replay/diagnosis.py (byte-identical
 * report text on the r16_diag fixtures, UpgradeDiagnosisSU2Test).
 *
 *   snapshot text (bounded, <= 16 KB)  -> diagnose() -> findings + projections -> render() <= 64 KB, toJson() <= 256 KB
 *   Ledger.update(findings, seq)        -> issue ledger (<= 256 entries), generation curve (<= 512 points)
 *
 * The report answers, from the live records only: where the gap to 35% is, which capability is missing, what exactly to
 * do (module / parameter / project), what win rate / frequency / worst block / calibration the upgrade is expected to
 * reach (empirical-Bayes projection, KAPPA = 200 actions toward 30%, 90% interval, Bonferroni for "best of K"), and how
 * it is verified (a shadow challenger settled live, or the next campaign). Texts: DiagnosisTextSU2 (generated).
 * Android access lives in DiagnosisStoreSU2 so this class stays pure Java.
 */
public final class UpgradeDiagnosisSU2 {
    private UpgradeDiagnosisSU2() {}
    public static final String VERSION = "P50-1";
    static final double KAPPA = 200.0, PRIOR_HITS = 60.0, CHANCE = 0.30, TARGET = 0.35, Z90 = 1.6449;
    static final int WINDOW_BLOCKS = 40, MIN_BLOCK_ACTS = 30, MIN_PROBE_BLOCK = 100, MAX_S3 = 2;
    static final double MIN_GAIN = 0.05;

    public static final int MD_MAX_BYTES = 65536, JSON_MAX_BYTES = 262144, MAX_FINDINGS_SHOWN = 24, MAX_LEDGER_SHOWN = 30;
    static final double[] ZK = {1.6449, 1.96, 2.128, 2.2414, 2.3263, 2.394, 2.45, 2.4977, 2.5392, 2.5758, 2.6086, 2.6383, 2.6653, 2.6901, 2.7131,
        2.7344, 2.7543, 2.7729, 2.7905, 2.807, 2.8227, 2.8376, 2.8518, 2.8653, 2.8782, 2.8905, 2.9024, 2.9137, 2.9247,
        2.9352, 2.9454, 2.9552, 2.9646, 2.9738, 2.9827, 2.9913, 2.9997, 3.0078, 3.0157, 3.0233, 3.0308, 3.0381, 3.0452,
        3.0521, 3.0588, 3.0654, 3.0718, 3.0781, 3.0842, 3.0902, 3.0961, 3.1019, 3.1075, 3.113, 3.1184, 3.1237, 3.1289,
        3.134, 3.1391, 3.144, 3.1488, 3.1536, 3.1582, 3.1628};
    static final Map<String, Integer> SEV_ORDER = new HashMap<>();
    static final Map<String, String> BETTER = new HashMap<>();
    static {
        SEV_ORDER.put("P0", 0); SEV_ORDER.put("P1", 1); SEV_ORDER.put("P2", 2); SEV_ORDER.put("INFO", 3);
        for (String c : new String[]{"G1", "G2", "G5", "S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "E1", "E3"}) BETTER.put(c, "high");
        for (String c : new String[]{"G3", "G4", "S9", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "E2", "M1"}) BETTER.put(c, "low");
    }
    static final Map<String, String> T = DiagnosisTextSU2.T;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ formatting
    static String fx(double x, int nd) {
        String s = new BigDecimal(x).setScale(nd, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN).toPlainString();
        if (s.startsWith("-") && Double.parseDouble(s) == 0.0) s = s.substring(1);
        return s;
    }
    static String pct(Double x) { return x == null ? T.get("NA") : fx(x * 100.0, 1) + "%"; }
    static String pts(Double x) { if (x == null) return T.get("NA"); String s = fx(x * 100.0, 1); return s.startsWith("-") ? s : "+" + s; }
    static String num(Double x, int nd) { return x == null ? T.get("NA") : fx(x, nd); }
    static String snum(Double x, int nd) { if (x == null) return T.get("NA"); String s = fx(x, nd); return s.startsWith("-") ? s : "+" + s; }

    /** Single-pass replacement of {name} placeholders (names: a-z 0-9 _); values are never rescanned. */
    static String fillT(String t, Map<String, String> v) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(); int i = 0, n = t.length();
        while (i < n) {
            char c = t.charAt(i);
            if (c == '{') {
                int j = i + 1; while (j < n && isName(t.charAt(j))) j++;
                if (j > i + 1 && j < n && t.charAt(j) == '}') {

    static String fill(String key, String... kv) {
        Map<String, String> m = new HashMap<>(); for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 2) m.put(kv[i], kv[i + 1]);
        return fillT(T.get(key), m);

    static double[] shrink(int k, int n) {

    static Double wilson(int k, int n) {

    static Integer need(Double r, double p0) {

    static double zk(int k) { return ZK[Math.min(Math.max(k, 1), 64) - 1]; }
    static Double r9(Double x) { return x == null ? null : Double.parseDouble(fx(x, 9)); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ snapshot
    public static final class Track { int periods; final List<double[]> blocks = new ArrayList<>(); }      // {0,rate} or {1,a,h}
    public static final class ProbeBlock { int n, a15, h15, a30, h30; double llr, llr2, p15, p30; Double st0; }
```
